monsters.name: 阿兰寇拉鹰人
monsters.description: 阿兰寇拉鹰人居住在高耸的悬崖和山巅的巢穴中，崇尚自由与天空的浩瀚。他们的社会以部族为单位，由最具飞行技巧的长者领袖统领，成员之间以口头誓约和共鸣的歌声维系纽带。尽管外表凶悍，阿兰寇拉鹰人本性善良，常在风暴来临时帮助受困的旅人，或在山谷中守护受伤的野兽。\n\n在与其他种族的交往中，阿兰寇拉鹰人以其卓越的侦察能力和对风的亲和力著称。他们擅长利用高空视野进行情报收集，并以精准的弓术和锐利的爪击在战斗中快速压制敌人。作为中立善良的生物，他们更倾向于避战，除非保护族群或自然栖息地受到威胁。

specialAbilities.name: 飞行 (Fly)
specialAbilities.description: 阿兰寇拉鹰人拥有天然的翅膀，飞行速度为50英尺。即使在拥挤的地形中，也能保持飞行并执行机动动作。

specialAbilities.name: 锐利视觉 (Keen Sight)
specialAbilities.description: 阿兰寇拉鹰人对远距离的观察有优势，具备感知（察觉）检定的优势，尤其在高空俯视时可在30尺范围内看到细微的运动。

specialAbilities.name: 风之冲击 (Wind Burst)
specialAbilities.description: 作为一次行动，阿兰寇拉鹰人可拍动翅膀制造一阵强风，对30尺锥形范围内的所有生物进行一次体质豁免（DC 12），失败者被推开10尺并失去一次移动。此能力每短休可使用一次。

actions.name: 爪击 Talon Strike
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4命中，距离5尺，单一目标。命中时造成1d6+2点挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 弓箭射击 Longbow Shot
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：+5命中，射程150/600尺，单一目标。命中时造成1d8+2点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 俯冲冲击 Dive Attack
actions.description: 如果阿兰寇拉鹰人在其上一回合结束时正处于飞行状态，并在本回合对同一目标进行爪击，则此爪击的伤害额外增加1d6点穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立善良的类人形生物，称为阿兰寇拉鹰人。身高约六尺（约一米八），它将人形与雄伟猛禽的形态融合为一体。其瘦削却结实的身躯专为飞行而生——宽阔的肩膀和深厚的胸腔支撑着两只强有力的翅膀，羽毛自乳白色渐变至锈金色。全身的羽毛色泽从黄褐棕到灰白相间的条纹不等，天然地与岩峦之上的天空相融合。

头部明显呈鸟形，似鹰的轮廓，配有锋利且略带弧度的喙，喙面上有淡淡的风化痕迹。锐利的琥珀色眼睛不停闪动，穿透性地扫描空中与地面。短羽冠在警觉或激动时微微张开，给人一种永不松懈的感觉。四肢线条分明——修长而有力的手臂自然折叠进带翼的关节，双腿以坚硬的爪足收尾，能够紧抓岩壁或精准击打。

它的站姿笔直却步伐轻盈，翅膀半展，仿佛随时准备借风而起。尽管拥有捕食者的体态，却散发出一种宁静而庄严的气度，宛如与天空和谐共生的守护者，而非对人类的猎手——它是山巅的守卫者，而非人类的猎手。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral good humanoid known as an Aarakocra. Standing about six feet tall, this avian being combines the form of a human with that of a majestic raptor. Its lean but muscular frame is built for flight—broad shoulders and a deep chest support two powerful wings, each feather tipping from cream to burnished gold. The plumage across its body ranges from tawny brown to streaks of gray and white, blending naturally with rocky mountain skies.  

The head is distinctly avian, shaped like that of an eagle with a sharp, curved beak marked by faint weathering. Keen amber eyes flick constantly, scanning the air and ground alike with a penetrating gaze. A crown of short feathers flares slightly when it is alert or spirited, giving it an impression of perpetual vigilance. Its limbs are well defined—long, sinewy arms fold seamlessly into winged joints, while its legs end in strong taloned feet capable of gripping crags or striking with precision.  

The creature’s stance is upright yet light on its feet, its wings half-spread as if always ready to take to the wind. Despite its predatory anatomy, there is a calm dignity in its bearing, an aura of harmony with the sky rather than menace—a guardian of the peaks rather than a hunter of men.

monsters.name: 底栖魔鱼
monsters.description: 底栖魔鱼是一种古老而狡诈的水栖异怪，拥有数千年的记忆和对心灵的操控能力。它们栖息在深渊湖泊、沼泽和被遗忘的地下水道中，用黏稠的黏液覆盖整个巢穴，形成一道天然的防御屏障。底栖魔鱼的外貌如同巨大的鳞片覆体的鱼类，拥有多条触手和一对发光的眼睛，能在黑暗的水底中看清一切。\n\n虽然外表看似迟缓，但底栖魔鱼的智慧远超其他水生生物，它们通过精神波动与同类共享记忆，并利用心灵控制术将不慎闯入的冒险者变成傀儡。它们的存在往往预示着附近水域的生态将被彻底改变，水面上会出现奇异的幻象和不安的低语。对付底栖魔鱼，需要同时应对它们的物理攻击、黏液防护以及潜在的精神支配。

specialAbilities.name: 两栖 Amphibious
specialAbilities.description: 鲍洛斯可以呼吸空气和水。

specialAbilities.name: 黏液云 Mucous Cloud
specialAbilities.description: 当在水下时，鲍洛斯被具有变形效果的黏液所环绕。触碰鲍洛斯的生物，或在其5尺内以近战攻击命中它的生物，必须进行一次DC 14的体质豁免。豁免失败则该生物染病1d4小时。染病的生物只能在水下呼吸。

specialAbilities.name: 探查心灵感应 Probing Telepathy
specialAbilities.description: 如果某生物与鲍洛斯以心灵感应交流，且鲍洛斯能看见该生物，则鲍洛斯会知晓该生物最强烈的欲望。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 鲍洛斯进行三次触手攻击。

actions.name: 触手 Tentacle
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+9，触及10尺，单一目标。命中：12（2d6+5）点钝击伤害。如果目标是生物，则其必须成功通过一次DC 14的体质豁免，否则染病。该疾病在1分钟内无效果，并且可由任何能治愈疾病的魔法移除。1分钟后，染病生物的皮肤变得半透明且黏滑；除非其在水下，否则该生物无法回复生命值；且该疾病只能由医疗术（heal）或其他6环或更高环阶的治愈疾病法术移除。当该生物处于水体之外时，除非在10分钟过去前对皮肤施加湿润，否则其每10分钟受到6（1d12）点强酸伤害。

actions.name: 尾击 Tail
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+9，触及10尺，单一目标。命中：15（3d6+5）点钝击伤害。

actions.name: 奴役 Enslave
actions.description:
鲍洛斯指定其30尺内能看见的一个生物作为目标。目标必须成功通过一次DC 14的感知豁免，否则在魔法作用下被鲍洛斯魅惑，持续至鲍洛斯死亡，或直至鲍洛斯与目标不在同一个位面为止。被魅惑的目标受鲍洛斯控制且不能采取反应，并且鲍洛斯与目标可以在任意距离彼此进行心灵感应交流。

每当被魅惑的目标受到伤害时，目标可以重复进行该豁免；若成功，则该效果结束。此外，每24小时最多一次，当目标距离鲍洛斯至少1英里时，目标也可以重复进行该豁免。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混沌中立的异常生物。它的身躯从头到尾约有十尺之长，蛇形的身体在浑浊的水中以惊人的优雅起伏。其形体既强壮又流线，兼具肌肉的厚重与流动的敏捷，覆以光滑的彩虹鳞片——在昏暗光线下会从深靛色变幻为毒绿。脊柱两侧排列着一排微微发光的结节，脉动如同古老智慧的心跳。

它宽阔的头部类似怪鱼，却更加异域——扁平而宽大，拥有三只如沉没灯笼般发光的眼睛，面容毫无表情。下巴下方展开一簇肉质触须，每根都以刻意的精准摆动，感知水中的振动。嘴巴异常张开，排列着同心环状的刺齿，仿佛能够吞噬的不止是血肉，甚至是意志本身。

厚实的鳍和残存的退化肢体帮助它在阴影中灵活移动，身后留下闪烁的黏液痕迹。它的整体气息散发出一种诡异的庄严——既不全然丑陋，也不完全美丽——映射出古老、智慧且极度不可预测的暗渊深处的静默威胁。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration. The creature looms roughly ten feet long from head to tail, its serpentine body undulating through murky water with uncanny grace. Its form is powerful and streamlined, a blend of muscular bulk and fluid agility, sheathed in layers of slick, iridescent scales that shift from deep indigo to poisonous green under dim light. Along its spine runs a row of faintly glowing nodules that pulse like the heartbeat of some ancient intelligence.  

Its broad head resembles that of a monstrous fish, yet far more alien—flat and wide, with three luminous eyes that shine like submerged lanterns, set upon a face devoid of emotion. From beneath its chin unfurl a cluster of fleshy tendrils, each moving with deliberate precision, sensing the water's vibrations. The mouth stretches unnaturally wide, lined with concentric rings of spined teeth, giving the impression it could consume not just flesh but will itself.  

Thick fins and vestigial limbs help it maneuver in the shadows, leaving trails of shimmering mucus in its wake. Its entire presence exudes an eerie majesty—neither wholly hideous nor beautiful—radiating the quiet menace of something ancient, intelligent, and utterly unpredictable within the dark abyssal depths.

legendaryActions.description: 鲍洛斯每轮可采取3次传奇动作，从下列选项中选择。每次只能使用一个传奇动作，且只能在另一生物回合结束时使用。鲍洛斯在其回合开始时恢复已用的传奇动作。

actions.name: 侦测 Detect
actions.description: 鲍洛斯进行一次感知（察觉）检定。

actions.name: 尾扫 Tail Swipe
actions.description: 鲍洛斯进行一次尾击攻击。

actions.name: 精神汲取 Psychic Drain（消耗2次动作）
actions.description: 一个被鲍洛斯魅惑的生物受到10（3d6）点心灵伤害，且鲍洛斯回复等于该生物所受伤害数值的生命值。

monsters.name: 天使
monsters.type: 不朽本质Immortal Nature。天使无需饮食与睡眠。 梵天神侍 Deva 天界生物
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 120 尺,被动察觉 19

specialAbilities.name: 天使武器 Angelic Weapons
specialAbilities.description: 梵天神侍的武器攻击带有魔法。 当梵天神侍以任何武器攻击命中目标时,其武器将额外造成 \( 4\ d8 \) 的光耀伤害 (已包含在攻击项中)

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 Innate Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description: 梵天神侍天生施法的关键属性为魅力 (法术豁免 DC 17),它天生可施展以下法术且仅需语言成分: 随意: 侦测善恶 detect evil and good

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 梵天神侍抵抗法术及其它魔法效应时进行的豁免检定具有优势

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 梵天神侍发动两次近战攻击。

actions.name: 硬头锤 Mace
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+8,触及 5 尺,单一目标。 伤害:7(1d6+4)的钝击伤害,外加 18(4d8)的光耀伤害。

actions.name: 治愈之触 Healing Touch (3/8)
actions.description: 梵天神侍触碰另一生物,被触碰目标将回复 20(4d8+2) 的生命值, 并移除其身上所有诅咒、 疾病、中毒、目盲及耳聋效应。

actions.name: 变形 Change Shape
actions.description: 梵天神侍可以用魔法变形为挑战等级等于或低于其自身的类人生物或野兽, 也可以同样用该动作恢复其真实形态。在死亡时,它也会回复其真实形态。它携带或着装的任何装备都将吸收为新形态的一部分或承载在新形态身上(依照梵天神侍的意愿)。

monsters.appearance:
这是一位守序善良的天界生物——一名中型的德瓦天使，身高约六尺。其躯体既强壮又优雅，四肢修长，光滑分明的肌肉隐匿于无瑕的淡金色皮肤之下，皮肤微微发光，宛若自内而外的光辉。其体格兼具力量与敏捷——动作流畅而从容，每一次举止都显得完美且受控。

两只宽阔的翅膀从肩部展开，羽毛呈银白与柔和蔚蓝的交织光泽，在光线下折射出细腻的彩虹色调。天使的面容对称而宁静，高颧骨、坚毅的下颌线，双眼散发出如熔化白金般柔和的光辉。当它注视生物时，那双眼的强烈光芒似乎能刺穿阴影与虚伪。

其发丝如辐射的银色丝线倾泻而下，微微飘动，仿佛被轻柔的微风轻拂。天使的双手指长而有力，既能握持武器，也能抚慰受创的灵魂。即便在静止时，也散发出一种巨大的力量感，却被完美地控制着。它身着简约却华丽的天界服饰，饰有淡淡发光的符文，德瓦天使散发出沉稳的威严与坚定的使命感，宛如神圣秩序的令人敬畏的守护者。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful good celestial being, a Deva angel of medium size standing about six feet tall. Its body is both powerfully built and graceful, with long limbs and smoothly defined muscles beneath flawless, pale-golden skin that gleams faintly as if lit from within. The creature’s physique conveys both strength and agility—its movements are fluid and deliberate, every motion appearing perfect and controlled.  

Two broad wings extend from its shoulders, each feather a shimmering blend of silver-white and soft azure hues, catching light in subtle, iridescent tones. The angel’s face is symmetrical and serene, with high cheekbones, a strong jawline, and eyes that glow softly like molten platinum. When it gazes upon a creature, the intensity of those eyes seems to pierce through shadow and falsehood alike.  

Its hair falls in a cascade of radiant silver threads, drifting slightly as though stirred by a gentle breeze. The angel’s hands are long-fingered yet strong, suited for grasping both weapon and wounded soul. Even at rest, it emanates a sense of immense power held in perfect control. Clad in simple yet resplendent celestial raiment adorned with faintly luminescent symbols, the Deva radiates calm authority and unyielding purpose, an awe-inspiring guardian of divine order.

monsters.name: 梵天神侍
monsters.description: 梵天神侍（Deva）是来自高等天界的天使般存在，受命于诸神执行慈善与审判的使命。它们拥有光辉的羽翼与灿烂的光环，常在凡间出现，指引迷失的灵魂，驱散黑暗与邪恶。梵天神侍的出现往往预示着重大事件的转折，它们会在战场上为正义的战士提供援助，或在灾难降临时拯救无辜的百姓。\n\n作为守序善良的天界生物，梵天神侍极具智慧与慈悲，擅长使用神圣魔法与治愈之力。它们的力量来源于对神明的忠诚与对宇宙秩序的维护，能够在瞬间感知周围的善恶，并以光明之刃斩断邪恶的根源。尽管外表庄严，它们仍会以温柔的声音安抚受惊的心灵，让希望在绝望中重新燃起。

specialAbilities.name: 天使武器 Angelic Weapons
specialAbilities.description: 代瓦的武器攻击为魔法攻击。每当代瓦以任何武器命中时，该武器额外造成4d8点光辉伤害（已包含在该攻击中）。

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 Innate Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
代瓦的施法关键属性为魅力（法术豁免DC 17）。代瓦可以天生施放下列法术，且仅需语言成分：

随意：侦测善恶（detect evil and good）

每日1次（各）：通神术（commune），死者复活（raise dead）

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 代瓦对抗法术和其他魔法效应的豁免检定具有优势。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 代瓦进行两次近战攻击。

actions.name: 硬头锤 Mace
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+8，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：7（1d6+4）点钝击伤害外加18（4d8）点光辉伤害。

actions.name: 治疗之触 Healing Touch
actions.description: 代瓦触碰另一名生物。目标以魔法方式回复20（4d8+2）点生命值，并解除其身上的任何诅咒、疾病、中毒、目盲或耳聋。

actions.name: 变形 Change Shape
actions.description:
代瓦以魔法变形为一个类人生物或野兽，其挑战等级等于或低于自身，或变回其真实形态。若代瓦死亡，则其变回真实形态。其所穿戴或携带的任何装备会被新形态吸收或由新形态携带（由代瓦选择）。

在新形态下，代瓦保留其游戏数据与说话能力，但其AC、移动方式、力量、敏捷与特殊感官会被新形态的对应数值取代，并获得新形态拥有而自身不具备的任何数据与能力（职业特性、传奇动作与巢穴动作除外）。

monsters.appearance: 这是一位守序善良的天界生物，亦称梵天神侍。它约有六尺高，身形修长却力量充沛，光滑、发光的皮肤微微泛光，宛若沐浴月光的抛光大理石。两只宽大的翅膀从肩部展开，羽毛呈虹彩的白色，带有淡淡的金色和浅蓝色光泽，即使收拢时也动作轻盈优雅。其面容极其对称——高颧骨、贵族般的下颌线，双眼如切割的蓝宝石般闪耀，宁静而又威严。一圈细腻的光环漂浮在其头顶，投射出柔和的光晕，照亮四周。发丝如银金交织的光辉，永不沾染尘埃与时光。双手强壮而优雅，指尖的指甲微微发光，宛若水晶玻璃。它站姿端正，每一个动作都目的明确、精准无误，仿佛受无形的纪律指引。其身周环绕着微光的光线，形成淡淡的纹样，暗示着被凡体束缚的神圣力量。仅凭其在场便令人肃然起敬——这是一张宁静而又强大的天界正义之颜，融合了优雅、力量与坚定不移的纯洁，以对抗世间的阴暗。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful good celestial, known as a Deva. It stands roughly six feet tall, its physique lean yet powerfully built, the contours of muscle visible beneath smooth, luminescent skin that glows faintly like polished marble touched by moonlight. Two expansive wings rise from its shoulders, each feather iridescent white with subtle hints of gold and pale blue, moving with quiet grace even when folded. The creature’s face is strikingly symmetrical — high cheekbones, noble jawline, and eyes that gleam like cut sapphires, calm yet commanding. A delicate circlet of radiant light hovers above its head, casting a soft halo that illuminates its surroundings. 

The Deva’s hair falls in gleaming strands of silver and gold, untouched by time or dust. Its hands are strong and graceful, the fingers tipped with faintly glowing nails resembling crystalline glass. It stands poised, every movement purposeful and precise, as if guided by unseen discipline. Around its body, threads of light shimmer in faint patterns, hinting at divine power restrained by mortal form. The creature’s presence alone compels reverence—a serene yet formidable visage of celestial justice, combining elegance, strength, and unwavering purity against the shadows of the world.

monsters.appearance:
这是一位守序善良的天界生物——星体，身高近十尺。其高耸的身形既令人敬畏又充满优雅，拥有神圣战士的坚实肌肉。宽阔的肩膀和强壮的胸膛向下收束，形成平衡有力的体格，动作流畅而精准。光滑的翡翠色皮肤如同抛光的大理石，泛出细微的内在光辉，随光线闪烁。

两对巨大的羽翼从背部展开，每根羽毛的尖端带有淡淡的银色荧光，展开的幅度足以填满整个大厅。面容高贵而雕刻般完美，对称无瑕——高耸的颧骨、骄傲的下颌线以及凝神的宁静唇形。双眼燃烧着柔和的蓝宝石光辉，平静而锐利，仿佛蕴含无限的领悟。

淡淡的银绿长发在身后飘动，似被天界之风轻拂而起。双手强壮而稳固，指尖修长而有力，既能挥舞巨剑，也能施以仁慈。每一次动作都散发出纪律与目的的光辉。

星体保持警戒姿态，笼罩在淡淡的雾光之中，光环般勾勒出其轮廓。其存在既具保护性又充满威严，承载着天堂审判的重量与绝对正义的宁静。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful good celestial being, a Planetar standing nearly ten feet tall. Its towering form is both awe‑inspiring and graceful, built with the sturdy musculature of a divine warrior. Broad shoulders and a powerful chest taper into a strong, balanced frame that moves with fluid precision. Smooth emerald‑toned skin gleams like polished marble, catching light with a subtle, inner glow.  

Two vast, feathered wings rise from its back, each feather tipped with faint silver luminescence, spreading wide enough to fill a hall. The face is noble and chiseled, with flawless symmetry—high cheekbones, a proud jawline, and lips set in serene focus. Its eyes burn with soft sapphire light, calm yet piercing, giving an impression of infinite understanding.  

Long strands of pale silvery‑green hair flow behind it, shifting as though stirred by a celestial wind. Its hands are strong and steady, the fingers elongated and firm, suited equally for wielding a mighty blade or offering mercy. Every movement radiates discipline and purpose.  

The Planetar stands poised and watchful, wrapped in faint misty light that outlines its form like a halo. Its presence is both protective and commanding, carrying the weight of heaven’s judgment and the serenity of absolute righteousness.

据称, 现存的炽天神侍只有二十四位。其中少数服从于特定的神祇, 其它个体则在某处静静观察, 等待世间出现极大危难并需要其力量时, 它们便会以善良之名挺身而出。

monsters.appearance:
守序善良的天界生物。它约有十尺高，肩宽体壮，胸膛、手臂和腿部的肌肉如同雕刻的石块，既坚实又精致。姿态端正平衡，悬浮在地面上一尺之上，展开半展的白金色巨翼；每翼展开近十五尺，层层洁白羽毛在边缘捕捉并散射出温暖的光辉。

其皮肤光彩夺目、光滑如日光沐浴的象牙，带有淡淡的金色光泽，厚实而坚韧，毫无瑕疵。柔和的金色光环环绕在高贵的面容之上：高颧骨、笔直坚毅的鼻梁以及坚定的下颚。翡翠色的双眼在轻拱的眉毛下稳稳发光，目光不动如磐。长而飘逸的发丝——铂金色中掺杂淡金——在肩头无重地轻轻荡漾。

优雅而又威严的双手以方正、洁净的指甲收束，前臂绷紧且线条分明。脚穿凉鞋或镀金护胫，整体装束为洁白金色的板甲，刻有天界纹章与细工花纹。手中轻握一把散发光辉的长弓，身侧漂浮着一把抛光钢制巨剑，剑刃上符文闪烁。整体气场极其圣洁且威严，宁静中带有压倒性的力量，兼具运动的优雅与磅礴的力量感以及旺盛的活力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful good celestial. It stands about ten feet tall, broad-shouldered and powerfully built, with stone-cut musculature along the chest, arms, and legs that looks both robust and refined. Its posture is poised and balanced, hovering a foot above the ground with vast white-gold wings half-spread; each wing spans nearly fifteen feet, layered with immaculate feathers that catch and scatter warm light along their edges.

The skin is luminous and smooth, sunlit ivory with a subtle golden sheen, appearing thick and resilient without a single blemish. A halo of soft, aureate light crowns a noble face: high cheekbones, a straight, strong nose, and a firm jaw. Emerald eyes glow steady and clear beneath gently arched brows, their gaze unwavering. Long, flowing hair—platinum threaded with pale gold—ripples weightlessly around the shoulders.

Elegant yet formidable hands end in clean, square nails; the forearms are corded and defined. Sandaled feet or gilded greaves complete an ensemble of pristine white-and-gold plate etched with celestial sigils and filigree. A radiant longbow rests lightly in one hand, and a greatsword of polished steel floats at its side, runes shimmering along the blade. The overall aura is intensely holy and commanding, serene yet overwhelming, combining athletic grace with imposing strength and vigorous vitality.

monsters.appearance:
守序善良的天界生物。其身高约十尺，肩宽背阔，体格强壮，肌肉呈条纹状，宛如被阳光雕刻的石块。光滑而厚实的皮肤散发出温暖的金属光泽——核心为金色，向四肢渐变为苍白的象牙色——彰显出不知疲倦的韧性。一圈灿烂的光环环绕其头颅，投射出柔和的金色光晕，笼罩着如明亮白金般的飘逸长发。

面容俊朗且对称：高耸的颧骨、坚毅的下颚以及丰满而宁静的唇。双眼如熔化的金子燃烧，星光般的瞳孔炯炯有神，长而笔直的眉毛更添聚焦的锐利。宽大的白羽翼从背部展开，每根洁白的羽毛边缘微微发光；翼展浩瀚，细微的羽毛颤动暗示着精准且闪电般的控制。

华丽而发光的板甲包覆躯干与四肢，紧贴其运动的体格，雕刻着捕捉光线的精细纹饰。戴着护手的双手硕大而稳固，指尖收束，短而光亮的指甲。姿态端正平衡，双脚轻离地面，仿佛悬浮，翼羽半收，随时准备展开。

一把闪耀银光的巨剑悬于一侧肩头，缓缓旋转而无须握持；一张光辉的长弓横跨背部，旁置装有白色光辉箭头的箭袋。金色微粒在其周围漂浮，其宁静而威严的气场让人感受到压倒性的神圣与震慑。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful good celestial. It stands about ten feet tall, broad-shouldered and powerfully built, with striated muscles that look carved from sunlit stone. Smooth, thick skin gleams with a warm, metallic luster—golden at the core, fading to pale alabaster along the limbs—suggesting tireless resilience. A radiant halo crowns the head, throwing a soft corona of gold around flowing hair the color of bright platinum.

The face is striking and symmetrical: high cheekbones, a strong jaw, and full, calm lips. Eyes burn like molten gold with star-bright pupils, their intense focus heightened by long, straight brows. Vast white-feathered wings spread from the back, each immaculate plume edged with a faint glow; the wingspan is immense, and minute feather shifts hint at precise, lightning-quick control.

Ornate, luminous plate encases the torso and limbs, fitted close to the athletic frame, etched with delicate patterns that catch the light. Gauntleted hands are large and steady, fingers tapered with short, polished nails. The stance is upright and balanced, feet just off the ground as if hovering, wings half-furled and ready.

A greatsword of gleaming silver hovers near one shoulder, slowly turning without a grip, while a radiant longbow rests across the back beside a quiver of arrow shafts tipped with brilliant white. Gold motes drift around the figure, and its serene yet commanding presence feels overwhelmingly holy and daunting.

monsters.name: 活化物件
monsters.description:
活化物件是一种被施法者或工匠以魔法赋予生命的普通器具。它们原本可能是一把椅子、一只箱子或一件武器，在被注入魔法后便会自行移动、攻击或执行指令。由于其本质是构装生物，活化物件缺乏自主意识，只会遵循最初被赋予的指令或本能的防御行为。它们常被用作守卫、陷阱或在战场上提供额外的火力支持，尤其在地下城的机关房间里随处可见。

虽然外观仍保持原有的形态，但活化物件的内部结构已经被魔法重塑，使其拥有坚硬的金属外壳和异常的耐久度。它们对普通的魔法攻击极为脆弱，却能在非魔法的物理冲击中保持稳固，这也让它们在面对法术使用者时表现出独特的弱点与优势。作为绝对中立的构装生物，它们不会主动挑起冲突，除非被指令或受到威胁。

specialAbilities.name: 不可变形 (Immutable Form)
specialAbilities.description: 活化物件免疫于形态改变的效果，包括变形、变形术以及其他试图改变其外形的法术和能力。

specialAbilities.name: 抗魔易感 (Antimagic Susceptibility)
specialAbilities.description: 活化物件对所有法术和魔法效果的豁免检定具有劣势。若受到抗魔场或被置于无魔区，它们将无法使用任何魔法或魔法驱动的能力。

actions.name: 撞击 (Slam)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击，命中加值 +4，范围 5 尺，对单一目标造成 5 (1d6+2) 点钝击伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立构造体。它呈现为一把高背橡木椅，以铁加固，约五英尺半高、三英尺宽，粗壮的框架由厚重的木材构成。木材黝黑且有伤痕，清漆被磨掉，露出致密的纹理和陈旧的凹痕；铁带和铆钉如层叠盔甲般覆盖接缝，形成坚实、肌肉感的轮廓。座面与靠背的铰接出奇地灵活，下面相互锁合的金属支架如同肌腱，尽管体形笨重，却能快速、精准地移动。

顶梁上镶有两枚圆形黄铜钉，宛若空洞的眼睛，暗淡的光泽无神；其下的面板呈现出一张空白、毫无表情的面具。扶手向前突起，犹如强壮的前臂，末端饰以沉重的卷纹，宛若钝重的拳头。四条坚实的腿以爪形铸件为足，张开以保持平衡，每只脚都有划痕与凹坑，仿佛常受硬击。边缘布满碎木屑和弯钉，接缝间附着污垢与尘埃，呈现出凌乱且略带令人厌恶的外观。

它保持稳固的支撑姿态，犹如迈步中的姿势，随时准备在指令下冲刺或转向。它的存在感显得尽职且冷漠——坚不可摧、高效，并在近战中悄然显露出强大的威慑力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct. It takes the form of a high-backed oak chair reinforced with iron, standing about five and a half feet tall and three feet wide, its stout frame built from thick, weighty timbers. The wood is dark and scarred, varnish rubbed away to reveal dense grain and old dents, while iron bands and rivets plate the joints like layered armor, giving it a rugged, muscular silhouette. The seat and backrest hinge with unexpected flexibility, and beneath, interlocked metal braces function like tendons, promising quick, precise movement despite its heavy build.

The crest rail bears two round brass tacks set like vacant eyes, their dull gleam unfocused; the panel below forms a blank, emotionless mask. The armrests jut forward like powerful forearms, ending in heavy scrollwork that suggests blunt knuckles. Four sturdy legs, capped with claw-foot castings, splay for balance; each foot is scarred and pitted, as if accustomed to hard impacts. Edges bristle with splinters and bent nails, and grime and dust cling in seams, lending it an unkempt, vaguely repellent look.

It holds a steady, braced posture, poised mid-stride, as if ready to lunge or pivot at a command. Its presence feels dutiful and impersonal—unyielding, efficient, and quietly formidable at close quarters.

monsters.name: 活化盔甲
monsters.description:
活化盔甲是一件被古老工匠以秘法注入生命的盔甲，常被安置在废弃的城堡、古墓或守卫重要宝物的密室中。它的金属外壳光泽暗淡，却在黑暗中散发出微弱的魔法光辉，似乎在等待指令的到来。虽然没有真正的意识，但它会毫不犹豫地攻击任何试图接近或触碰它的生物，成为守护者的无声铁拳。

这些盔甲的魔法源自于施法者的意志，因而对魔法的抵抗异常强大。它们没有情感，也不受恐惧、魅惑等心灵效果的影响，只会依据预设的守卫指令执行任务。对冒险者而言，面对活化盔甲往往意味着要克服它坚硬的防御和对法术的天然抗性。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 对抗法术和其他魔法效果的豁免检定具有优势。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 活化盔甲进行两次冲击攻击。

actions.name: 冲击 Slam
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+5 命中，射程 5 尺。命中造成 1d6+3 点钝击伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具绝对中立的构装体。空心的破旧板甲高约五尺半，肩部宽阔，胸躯厚实，宛如不知疲倦的斗士。相互咬合的甲片构成坚固的框架：带脊的胸甲、外翻的肩甲、分段的颈甲，以及覆于大腿甲之上的强化腰甲。可活动的护臂以沉重的铁拳套收尾，指板呈钩状；护胫与钝形胫甲支撑着低矮、平衡的姿态，仿佛随时准备弹射。

金属为暗淡的铁质，带着冷冽的哑光光泽，沾染了煤烟与油渍，遍布凹痕、划痕与锤击出的脊纹；锈斑沿接缝蔓延，失色的黄铜铆钉闪烁着微弱而阴森的光。细如发丝的符文刻痕沿甲片边缘勾勒，微弱且不均匀地发出暗淡光辉。裂开的皮带和裸露的链环从接缝处露出，呈现出粗犷实用的外观。

头盔封闭，面罩有狭长的裂口；从那细小的目孔中渗出暗淡、散漫的蓝白光，内部只有无底的黑暗。面罩的格栅构成一张粗糙的、咧嘴的嘴巴，使其面容丑陋且令人不安。它站姿方正、毫不动摇，拳头半举，散发出冷峻、无情的威胁——如同不屈的哨兵，沉默而警备，既不残忍亦不仁慈，只是等待出击。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a true neutral construct. A hollow suit of battered plate armor stands five and a half feet tall, broad in the shoulders and thick through the torso, built like a tireless brawler. Interlocking plates form a robust frame: ridged breastplate, flared pauldrons, segmented gorget, and reinforced faulds over cuisses. Articulated vambraces end in heavy gauntlets with hook-like finger plates, while greaves and blunt sabatons brace a low, balanced stance as if ready to spring.

The metal is dull iron with a cold, matte sheen, stained by soot and oil, scarred with dents, scratches, and hammered ridges; rust freckles creep along seams, and tarnished brass rivets catch a faint, grim glint. Hair-thin rune etchings trace the edges of the plates and barely glow with a wan, uneven light. Cracked leather straps and exposed chain links peek from the joints, giving a rugged, utilitarian look.

Its helmet is closed, visor slitted; from those narrow eye-holes seeps a dim, unfocused blue-white glow, revealing nothing within but a depthless black. The visor’s grille forms a crude, grimacing mouth, lending it an ugly, unsettling countenance. It stands square and unflinching, fists half-raised, exuding a cold, impersonal menace—an implacable sentinel, silent and ready, neither cruel nor kind, merely waiting to strike.

specialAbilities.name: 反魔法易感 Antimagic Susceptibility
specialAbilities.description: 当该剑处于反魔法力场（antimagic field）的范围内时，它将陷入失能状态。若其成为解除魔法（dispel magic）的目标，则该剑必须进行一次体质豁免，对抗施法者的法术豁免DC；若失败，则昏迷1分钟。

specialAbilities.name: 伪装外观 False Appearance
specialAbilities.description: 当该剑保持静止且未在飞行时，它与一把普通的剑无法区分。

actions.name: 长剑 Longsword
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d8+1）点挥砍伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立构装体。体型为中型，整体长度约为五英尺半（约1.7米），从柄首到剑尖是一把悬浮在空中的巨剑，毫无可见支撑。它的本体是一把厚重、过度加固的刀身，拥有宽阔的凹槽与强化的剑脊，金属呈油光的枪金属色，遍布锈斑与无数凹痕。刀刃不平且有缺口，呈锯齿状、粗暴的轮廓，暗示着沉重且具压碎冲击力的动能。护手呈块状、非对称，像是破碎的颚部突出，表面被划痕与伤痕覆盖；粗糙的刻纹形成了一个咧嘴的面具图案。护手中嵌有两颗浑浊的石英镶钉，宛若死亡且失焦的双眼，投射出空洞、无意识的凝视。

握柄用开裂、焦黑的皮革缠裹，并被厚重的铆钉带束紧。柄首是一枚形似畸形骷髅的矮铁饰，丑陋且布满凹坑。短碎的链环从护手和握柄上垂下，移动时如同一条破烂的尾巴摇摆。尽管重量惊人，剑身却以令人不安的姿态保持平衡——悬停时静止如石，随后以鞭般快速、精准的转动瞬间变换角度，毫无四肢或翅膀亦能传递出灵活的讯号。整体气息冷峻且缺乏人格，宛如一件工匠式、耐用的杀人工具：被击打得遍体鳞伤、坚固可靠，却以令人不安的冷漠取代了明显的恶意。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct. Medium in size, it measures about five and a half feet from pommel to tip, a massive greatsword hanging in midair with no visible support. Its body is a thick, overbuilt blade with a broad fuller and reinforced spine, the metal darkened to an oily gunmetal with patches of rust and countless nicks. The edge is uneven and chipped, giving a serrated, brutal profile that suggests weighty, crushing momentum. A chunky, asymmetrical crossguard juts out like broken jaws, its surfaces gouged and scarred; crude etchings form a grimacing mask motif. Set into the guard are two cloudy quartz studs that resemble dead, unfocused eyes, offering a blank, mindless stare.

The grip is wrapped in cracked, blackened leather, clamped by heavy riveted bands. A squat iron pommel shaped like a misshapen skull caps the hilt, ugly and pitted. Short, broken links of chain dangle from the guard and grip, trailing like a ragged tail when it moves. Despite its heft, the sword holds itself with unnerving poise—hovering perfectly still, then snapping to new angles with whip-fast, precise pivots, telegraphing agility without any limbs or wings. Its overall presence is cold and impersonal, a workmanlike, durable killer’s tool: battered, sturdy, and unsettlingly indifferent rather than overtly malicious.

monsters.name: 闷人毯
monsters.senses_text: 盲视 60 尺(该范围外视为目盲),被动察觉 6
monsters.speed_text: 25 尺力量 14 (+2) 敏捷 11(+0) 体质 13 (+1) 智力 1 (-5) 感知 3 (-4) 魅力 1 (-5) 伤害免疫:毒素,心灵状态免疫:目盲,魅惑,耳聋,恐慌,力竭,麻痹,石化,中毒感官:盲视 60 尺(该范围外视为目盲),被动察觉 6
monsters.description:
见习盗贼和粗心英雄在敌人门口仔细搜索陷阱时, 唯独忘记其脚下的活化毯子,甚至因此毙命。
闷人毯可以由许多不同的材质做成, 从为女王准备的细致编织品到农夫陋居的粗糙垫子。能够感知魔力的生物也会察觉到毯散发出的魔法灵光。
在某些情况下, 闷人怪毯会被误认为是飞毯 carpet of flying 或是其他具增益的魔法物品。但是, 那些试图站或坐在闷人毯上说出命令语的人最后只会被紧紧的卷曲起来闷住。
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_16_799_82_852_1098_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_16_799_82_852_1098_0.jpg)
活化盔甲 Animated Armor

specialAbilities.name: 反魔法易感 Antimagic Susceptibility
specialAbilities.description: 当该地毯处于反魔法力场（antimagic field）的范围内时，它陷入失能（incapacitated）。若以解除魔法（dispel magic）为目标，则该地毯必须进行一次对抗施法者法术豁免DC的体质豁免检定，失败则昏迷（unconscious）1分钟。

specialAbilities.name: 伤害转移 Damage Transfer
specialAbilities.description: 当它正擒抱一个生物时，地毯仅承受对其造成伤害的一半，而被地毯擒抱的生物承受另一半。

specialAbilities.name: 伪装外观 False Appearance
specialAbilities.description: 当该地毯保持不动时，它与一张普通地毯无异，无法被区分。

actions.name: 闷压 Smother
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺，目标为一个中型或更小的生物。命中：该生物被擒抱（逃脱DC 13）。直到此擒抱结束前，目标被束缚（restrained）、目盲（blinded），并有窒息风险（at risk of suffocating），且该地毯无法闷压另一个目标。此外，在目标每个回合开始时，目标受到10（2d6 + 3）钝击伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立构造体，属于中型魔法造物，展开时约六英尺长。乍看之下，它像是一块普通的装饰地毯，却有细微的不规则之处泄露出非自然的生命气息。表面由淡褪的深红色和暗金色的粗线织成，边缘磨损却异常柔软。质感犹如密实的织物层叠在沉重且有弹性的底层之上，平铺在地面时略显隆起。图案微微移动，几乎像在呼吸，暗淡的魔法光辉在纤维间荡漾。

被激活时，地毯卷起并以惊人的敏捷抬起，四角如抓握的肢体般向外弹出。织纹柔韧起伏，仿佛有隐藏在布料下的肌肉驱动。表面没有眼睛或嘴巴，但其中心的结点中闪烁着微弱、空洞的魔法感知光辉。移动时，这个生物散发出令人不安的捕食者般的耐心气息；既非善亦非恶，仅是其造主意图的工具。它的存在沉重、寂静且令人窒息——一件普通的家具被赋予了生命，化作等待窒息不慎之人的陷阱。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct, a medium-sized magical creation that appears roughly six feet long when unfurled. At first glance, it looks like an ordinary decorative carpet, but its subtle irregularities betray an unnatural life. The surface is woven from thick threads of faded crimson and dull gold, frayed at the edges yet unnervingly supple. The texture resembles dense fabric layered over something heavy and resilient, giving it a faint bulge when it lies flat on the floor. Its patterns shift minutely, almost seeming to breathe, while a dim shimmer of enchantment ripples through the fibers. 

When stirred into motion, the rug curls and lifts itself with surprising agility, its corners snapping outward like grasping limbs. The weave flexes and undulates as though powered by hidden muscles beneath the fabric. No eyes or mouth mark its surface, but a faint, empty glint of magical awareness pulses within its central knots. In movement, the creature gives off an unsettling aura of predatory patience; neither good nor evil, simply acting as a tool of its maker’s intent. Its presence feels heavy, silent, and suffocating—an ordinary furnishing animated into a trap that waits to smother the careless.

monsters.name: 掘地虫
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 11 语言:一挑战等级:2 (450 XP)
monsters.speed_text: 30 尺,掘穴 10 尺力量 17 (+3) 敏捷 11(+0) 体质 13 (+1) 智力 1(-5) 感知 13 (+1) 魅力 6 (-2) 感官:黑暗视觉 60 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 11 语言:一挑战等级:2 (450 XP)
monsters.description:
掘地虫形似巨大的多足昆虫, 其长长的触须随着周围的动静而颤动, 腿部末端是锋利的钩爪, 适合挖掘及捕捉猎物, 强壮的下颚甚至可以把小树咬成两截。

潜地者 Lurkers in the Earth。掘地虫用其强壮的下颌在地下深处挖掘蜿蜒的地道。每当需要捕猎时, 掘地虫就会向上掘穴至地表下耐心等待, 直到其触须侦测到地上有生物经过。随后它猛然冲出, 并用下颚抓住猎物, 边碾压边分泌酸性的消化酶, 以使猎物溶解便于吞咽。掘地虫也可以喷射消化酶来消灭敌人。

农林祸害 Bane of Field and Forest。虽然掘地虫可以从其挖掘的泥土中获得部分营养, 但其依然需要新鲜肉食补充其他养满是牲畜的牧场和猎物丰富的森林便成了掘地虫的主要狩猎场。 因此, 在任何地方, 掘地虫都是农民和巡林客的眼中钉。

泥质地道 Earthen Tunnels。掘地虫在地下掘穴时, 会留下一条狭窄而不稳定的地道。在这些隧道里, 人们可以找到掘地虫蜕下的壳、孵化的虫卵、疹人的猎物残骸,也包括散落的金银珠宝。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：10（2d6 + 3）挥砍伤害外加3（1d6）强酸伤害。若目标为大型或更小的生物，则其被擒抱（逃脱DC 13）。直到此擒抱结束前，掘地虫只能啃咬被其擒抱的生物，且对其进行的攻击检定具有优势。

actions.name: 喷吐强酸 Acid Spray
actions.description: 掘地虫喷吐强酸，形成一条长30尺、宽5尺的线状区域，前提是它没有擒抱任何生物。该线内的每个生物必须进行一次DC 13敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受到10（3d6）强酸伤害，成功则伤害减半。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只无阵营的怪异生物，体型庞大的掘地捕食者，约有十尺高、十尺长。它的身体由角质与肌肉融合而成，形似巨大的昆虫幼虫，拥有分段的装甲外骨骼，呈暗赭色与深绿色的黯淡光泽。每一段都能独立弯曲，展现出它在紧实土壤中扭动、穿行的惊人灵活性。

一对粗壮、锯齿状的颚占据了它的面部——锋利且有力，足以劈开木头或骨骼。颚之间，黏稠的唾液以酸绿的细线滴落。头部伸出两根细长、鞭状的触角，持续颤动，感知地下的震动。它的复眼虽小且光亮如漆，却没有任何智慧的火花，只映射出锐利的捕食者专注。

六条结实的腿从两侧伸出，末端是弯曲的钩形爪，常沾满土壤。腹部的甲壳上布满多年穿岩而成的划痕与伤痕。整体姿态既粗野又耐心——一种为伏击而生的土壤威胁。当它从地面升起时，散发出一种压迫感，仿佛数世纪以来一直潜伏在地下的凶兽，随时准备吞噬掠过上方的一切。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is an unaligned monstrosity, a massive burrowing predator that stands roughly ten feet tall and spans ten feet in length. Its body is a fusion of chitin and muscle, shaped like a colossal insect larva with a segmented, armored exoskeleton gleaming in dull shades of ochre and dark green. Each segment flexes independently, showing the creature’s ability to twist and maneuver through packed earth with unsettling agility.  

A pair of thick, serrated mandibles dominates its face—jagged and powerful enough to shear through wood or bone. Between them, saliva drips in viscous threads tinged with acid green. From its head extend two long, whip-like antennae that quiver ceaselessly, sensing vibrations in the ground. Its compound eyes are small and glossy black, lacking any spark of intelligence but reflecting a sharp, predatory focus.  

Six sturdy legs jut from its sides, ending in curved, hook-like claws caked with soil. The shell along its abdomen bears scratches and scarring from years of tunneling through rock. Its overall demeanor is both brutish and patient—an earthy menace built for ambush. When it rises from the soil, the creature exudes the oppressive danger of something that has stalked beneath the surface for centuries, waiting to devour whatever passes overhead.

monsters.name: 火矮人
monsters.description:
火矮人（Azer）是居住在炽热火山洞穴中的火元素与矮人血脉的混合体。它们的身体由炽热的岩浆与金属构成，皮肤呈暗红色，常年在高温环境中锻造武器与盔甲。火矮人对火焰有天然的亲和力，能够在炽热的火山口中毫无困难地生存，并将这种炽热的力量用于守卫自己的领地和执行雇佣军的任务。它们性格严苛、守序且极度自私，往往为达成目的不择手段，因而被视为守序邪恶的典型代表。

在冒险者的传说中，火矮人常被雇佣来守护矿脉或作为火焰法阵的活体核心。它们擅长使用重型武器进行近战，同时能够喷吐炽热的岩浆，对靠近的敌人造成持续的灼烧。尽管身体坚硬如岩石，火矮人仍对寒冷极度脆弱，一旦被冰冷的攻击击中，便会迅速失去火焰的热力而陷入虚弱。

specialAbilities.name: 灼热之躯 Heated Body
specialAbilities.description: 触碰阿泽，或在其5尺内以近战攻击命中它的生物，将受到5（1d10）火焰伤害。

specialAbilities.name: 灼热武器 Heated Weapons
specialAbilities.description: 当阿泽以金属近战武器命中时，它造成额外3（1d6）火焰伤害（已包含在该攻击中）。

specialAbilities.name: 照明 Illumination
specialAbilities.description: 阿泽在10尺半径内散发明亮光照，并在额外10尺范围内散发微光光照。

actions.name: 战锤 Warhammer
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：7（1d8 + 3）钝击伤害；若以双手进行近战攻击则为8（1d10 + 3）钝击伤害；外加3（1d6）火焰伤害。

monsters.appearance:
守序邪恶的元素类类人。该生物约六尺高，体格坚实紧凑，宛如一位经验丰富的铁匠以活金属雕刻而成。厚实的肌肉绳索在内部发光的表层下起伏，暗红色的皮肤裂开，露出如火脉般跳动的熔金金缝。每一次呼吸都会在空气中散发出淡淡的热雾，扭曲其宽阔肩膀与覆甲胸膛周围的空间。其头颅光秃且略呈棱角，仿佛铸自青铜；一撮点燃的余烬胡须微微闪烁，移动时会溅出火星。双眼如炉火燃烧，稳重而算计，透露出纪律性的智慧。

其臂膀强壮而粗壮，手掌如锻打的钢铁般老茧粗糙，适合握持沉重的战锤或铁刃。该生物的动作紧凑高效，步伐自信却沉重，赤足踏地处留下淡淡的灼痕。环绕其身的光环压抑而有序——炽热与统治交织。全身的每一道轮廓都散发受控的侵略性，宛如被僵硬目的与冰冷野心束缚的火焰哨兵。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil elemental humanoid. The creature stands about six feet tall, its stature solid and compact like a seasoned blacksmith carved from living metal. Thick cords of muscle ripple beneath a surface that glows from within, the dark crimson skin cracked with seams of molten gold that pulse like veins of fire. Each breath sends faint wisps of heat across the air, distorting the space around its broad shoulders and plated chest. Its head is bald and slightly angular, appearing as if forged from bronze; a short, ember-lit beard flickers faintly, shedding sparks when it moves. The eyes burn like twin furnaces, steady and calculating rather than wild, hinting at disciplined intelligence.

Its arms are powerful and thick, ending in hands calloused and rough as hammered steel, suited for holding heavy hammers or iron blades. The creature’s movements are compact and efficient, its gait confident but heavy, leaving faint scorch marks on the ground where bare feet step. The aura surrounding it feels oppressive and orderly—heat and domination fused together. Every contour of its body radiates controlled aggression, a sentinel of flame bound by rigid purpose and cold ambition.

monsters.name: 女妖
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10
monsters.speed_text: 0 尺, 飞行 40 尺 (悬浮)
monsters.description:
夜幕降临时, 不幸的旅者听到了绝望死者的微弱哭声。这个悲伤的灵魂是一只女妖,一种由女性精灵的灵魂形成的恶意生物。

女妖以朦胧发光的形态出现,依稀反映出她们在世时的特征。 它们脸萦绕着蓬乱的头发,身上则环绕着飘动的纤细碎布。

神之愤怒 Divine Wrath。女妖是精灵的不死生物残余。她们曾蒙恩获得了动人的美貌, 却未能以此天赋为世界带来欢乐, 而是利用美貌腐化操控他人。这些精灵遭受女妖化的诅咒后就再无法感受到快乐,只剩下生命的苦难。诅咒逐渐对其造成伤害,使她们的精神与肉体衰败,直至死亡时被转化为不死的怪物。

悲伤束缚Sorrow Bound。女妖被永远束缚在她毙命之地, 无法离开该地超过五里远。并被迫准确无误的重温她生命中每一刻的回忆,却始终拒绝接受其灭亡的责任。

囤积美丽Beauty Hoarders。促使女妖受诅咒的虚荣心在其成为不死生物后依然影响着她。这些生物贪图美丽的物体如:高级珠宝、画作、雕塑以及其他艺术品。此外, 女妖还憎恨任何能映照其自身的镜面, 厌恶看见其自身现今恐怖的样貌。而只要稍瞥到自己, 就足以激起女妖的狂怒。

不死本质 Undead Nature。女妖不需要空气、饮食和睡眠。

specialAbilities.name: 侦测生命 Detect Life
specialAbilities.description: 女妖能以魔法感测到 5 里内除不死生物和构装生物以外的生物存在, 它知道对方的大概方向但无法掌握确切的位置

specialAbilities.name: 虚体移动 Incorporeal Movement
specialAbilities.description: 女妖能像穿过困难地形那样穿过其他生物或物件。它在回合结束时若处于物件内则受到 5 (1d10)的力场伤害

actions.name: 腐化之触Corrupting Touch
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+4,触及 5 尺, 单一目标。伤害:12(3d6+2)的黯蚀伤害。

actions.name: 恐惧面容 Horrifying Visage
actions.description: 女妖周边 60 内能看见她的所有非不死生物必须进行一次 DC 13 的感知豁免, 豁免失败则陷入 1 分钟的恐慌状态。该受恐慌目标可以在每个其自己回合结束时再次进行该豁免以结束该效应, 此时如果女妖在其视线内则其进行该豁免时具有劣势。如果目标豁免成功或效应结束,则其在 24 小时内免疫女妖的恐惧面容。

actions.name: 衰嚎 Wail(1/日)
actions.description: 不在阳光下的女妖可以发出一阵悲恸的哀嚎。哀嚎对构装生物和不死生物无效。女妖周边 30 尺内能听见其声音的其他生物必须进行一次 DC 13 的体质豁免。豁免失败者其生命值将降为 0,豁免成功则受到 10(3d6)的心灵伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混沌邪恶的中型亡灵，高约五至六尺，悬浮在地面之上而非站立。其形体为一具腐朽的精灵女子，纤细而脆弱，四肢似乎失去重量，伸展至超出凡人比例的长度。她的手臂与面容上的肉体苍白且半透明，散发出淡淡的绿白幽光，犹如墓土上飘渺的雾气般闪烁。  

她那纠结的长发如同浸在水中般漂浮，化作幽灵般的触须，遮掩住她那凄凉、空洞的面容。眼眶中空无实质，仅充盈着暗淡的银光，虽无情感，却以令人不安的专注凝视。她的嘴巴张得极宽，仿佛在无声的尖叫，露出若隐若现的牙齿，宛若碎裂的水晶。  

残存的昔日华丽长袍仍紧贴其身——破碎的轻纱碎片在幽幽的风中旋转。她的姿态弯曲扭曲，仿佛永远背负着悲恸与怒火。她周围的空气因细微的波纹而扭曲，散发出压抑的悲怆与威胁气息。每一细节都凸显出被虚荣扭曲的腐败：这是一种既可怜又恐怖的生物，怀着对所有活着之美的永恒恶意。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil undead of medium size, roughly five to six feet tall, hovering just above the ground rather than standing upon it. Her form is that of a decayed elven woman, slender and frail, with limbs that seem weightless and elongated beyond mortal proportion. The flesh upon her arms and face is pale and semi-transparent, glowing faintly with a greenish-white luminescence that flickers like mist over grave soil.  

Her long, tangled hair drifts as if underwater, flowing in spectral tendrils that obscure parts of her gaunt, hollow face. The eyes are empty sockets filled with dim silver light, devoid of emotion yet watching with unsettling focus. Her mouth stretches wide in a silent scream, revealing rows of faintly visible teeth like shards of crystal.  

The remnants of a once-elegant gown cling to her form—tattered shreds of sheer fabric that swirl in a ghostly breeze. Her posture hangs crooked, as if forever burdened by grief and rage. Around her, the air distorts with a subtle shimmer, distilling an oppressive aura of sorrow and menace. Every detail emphasizes decay twisted by vanity: a creature simultaneously pitiful and horrifying, driven by eternal malice toward all living beauty.

monsters.name: 石化蜥蜴
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 9
monsters.description:
“没人会造那些一脸恐慌的勇士雕像。如果你看
到一尊。请务必闭上眼睛并竖起耳朵。”
——X 地下城求生奥妙第 4 条
旅者有时会发现一些栩栩如生的野生动物雕像。其中一些残缺的石像似乎是被咬下了肢体。此时经验丰富的冒险者将认识到这是一种警报,预示着石化蜥蜴就在附近。
可塑性猎食者 Adaptable Predators。石化蜥蜴在温带或热带气候的干燥地区繁衍生息。它们通常会在洞穴或其他隐秘地点筑巢。事实上,大多遭遇石化蜥蜴的情况都发生在地底。
石化蜥蜴可以自幼起关在笼中驯养受训。驯服的石化蜥蜴会懂得听从主人指使避免与特定生物进行目光接触, 而其本身的能力依然可以让其成为一只令人生畏的野兽护卫。石化蜥蜴的蛋也因此价值不菲。
石之凝视 Gaze of Stone。笨重而迟钝的石化蜥蜴难以追猎其他生物, 只是它们无需辛苦捕猎。它们会用自己神奇的凝视能力将猎物迅速转变成松动的石头, 再用强健的下颚将石头嚼碎, 而这些石头将会在石化蜥蜴胃中转化成原本的形态再被消化。
某些炼金术士懂得如何处理石化蜥蜴的胃及其中的分泌物。 处理妥当后, 这些提取物可以制成一种帮被石化生物恢复原样的油膏。然而, 如果对方在石化时身躯受损, 这种油膏则只能恢复未受损的身体部分, 不能恢复失去的生命和肢体。
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_21_50_2_1600_1130_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_21_50_2_1600_1130_0.jpg)

specialAbilities.name: 石化凝视 Petrifying Gaze
specialAbilities.description:
若一个生物在其回合开始时位于蜥怪30尺内，且双方能互相看见，则只要蜥怪未陷入失能（incapacitated），蜥怪即可迫使该生物进行一次DC 12体质豁免。豁免失败：该生物以魔法开始变成石头并被束缚（restrained）。它必须在其下一回合结束时重复该豁免。豁免成功：该效果结束。再次豁免失败：该生物被石化（petrified），直到被高等复原术（greater restoration）或其他魔法解救。
未陷入惊讶（surprised）的生物可以在其回合开始时移开视线以避免进行该豁免。若如此做，则直到其下一回合开始前它都无法看见蜥怪；届时它可以再次移开视线。若它在此期间看向蜥怪，则必须立即进行该豁免。
若蜥怪在明亮光照下于其30尺内看见自己的倒影，它会将自己误认为对手，并以其凝视以自己为目标。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：10（2d6 + 3）穿刺伤害外加7（2d6）毒素伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种无阵营的怪异生物。石化蜥蜴体型矮壮，呈爬行动物形态，约六尺长，肩部约四尺高，身体贴地而建，四肢沉重而发达。厚实的石灰色鳞片覆盖全身，鳞片上点缀着苔绿和锈棕的条纹，使其能够在岩石荒原和洞穴壁面中隐匿。每片鳞片都带有暗淡的石质光泽，仿佛沾染了细碎的花岗岩粉末。

它的头宽而楔形，眉骨上有一排骨质刺脊一直延伸至脊柱。下颚方正有力，满布锯齿状的牙齿，形似碎裂的岩石。两侧短小的角状突起在眼睛上方突出，眼睛散发出淡淡的苍绿光辉。那双眼永不眨动，冷峻而凝固，散发出一种诡异的静止感。

该生物的四肢粗壮坚实，爪足能够紧抓并劈裂岩石。尾巴又长又有力，末端呈钝状棒状，用以保持平衡和防御。石化蜥蜴行进时步伐沉重而有条不紊，每一次移动都笨拙却精准。它周身笼罩着一种令人不安的寂静威胁——这是一位以石与鳞为武器的捕食者，随时准备将生命化作冰冷而脆裂的岩石。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is an unaligned monstrosity. The basilisk is a stocky, reptilian creature roughly six feet long and four feet tall at the shoulder, its body built low to the ground with heavy, muscular limbs. Thick, stone-gray scales cover its hide, mottled with streaks of mossy green and rusty brown that help it blend with rocky wastelands and cavern walls. Each scale has a dull, stony sheen, as if dusted with powdered granite.  

Its head is broad and wedge-shaped, with a ridge of bony spines running from its brow down the length of its spine. The jaws are powerful and square, packed with jagged teeth that resemble splintered rock. Two short, horn-like protrusions jut forward above its eyes, which glow with a faint, pale emerald hue. Those eyes never blink, fixed and cold, exuding an eerie stillness.  

The creature’s legs are thick and sturdy, ending in clawed feet capable of gripping and cracking stone. Its tail is long and muscular, tapering to a blunt, clubbed tip used for balance and defense. The basilisk moves with a ponderous, deliberate gait, each motion heavy yet precise. An unnerving aura of silent threat hangs around it—a predator of stone and scale waiting to turn life itself into cold, brittle rock.

monsters.name: 青足龙蛇
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 90 尺,被动察觉 16
monsters.description:
“我今天已经吃了三只巨蝙蝠、六个穴居人还有

一个夺心魔,不过没事儿。我觉得我肚子还能放

得下你和你的朋友们。”

——青足龙蛇卢德 Lludd,在失落的索吉卡斯

Tsojcanth 洞窟直面冒险者们时,如是说

青足龙蛇在地面和墙壁上匍匐蛇行,追捕猎物。它的闪电吐息可以焚化大多数生物, 即使更强的生物, 也会被青足龙蛇绞缠勒紧, 活囵生吞。

青足龙蛇的外形类似蜈蚣和鳄鱼的结合体。鳞片构成的外皮为青蓝到深蓝色, 逐渐过渡到腹部的浅蓝色。

洞窟掠食者 Cavern Predators。青足龙蛇筑巢于其它生物难以到达的地方, 破使入侵者必须进行艰苦的攀爬作业。深坑, 峭壁高处的洞穴, 以及只由狭窄曲折地道连通的洞窟都是青足龙蛇伏击猎物的主要场所。它的十二条腿使其能够轻松地攀爬在巢穴内外。不需要攀爬时, 青足龙蛇可以把腿合拢在体侧, 像蛇一样迅速滑行。

青足龙蛇通常会将猎物整个吞下, 然后进入一段休眠期来进消化。在此期间, 青足龙蛇会躲藏在闯入巢穴的入侵者容易忽略的隐蔽处。

龙之仇敌Foes of the Dragon。在早已被遗忘的古代,巨人和龙族进行着近乎无休止的战争。风暴巨人则为此创造了第一只青足龙蛇作为其对抗龙族的兵器, 因而青足龙蛇们至今仍留存着对龙族天生的仇恨。

青足龙蛇从不在有龙栖息的地区筑巢。如果在青足龙蛇巢穴几十里以内有龙试图筑巢, 青足龙蛇将不得不前去将其杀死或驱逐。只有当这条龙过于强大无法对抗时, 青足龙蛇才会放弃, 并远走他乡以寻找新的筑巢地。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 贝希尔进行两次攻击：一次以其啃咬，一次以其缠绕。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+10，触及10尺，单一目标。命中：22（3d10 + 6）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 缠绕 Constrict
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+10，触及5尺，目标为一个大型或更小的生物。命中：17（2d10 + 6）钝击伤害外加17（2d10 + 6）挥砍伤害。若贝希尔尚未缠绕某个生物，则目标被擒抱（逃脱DC 16），且直到此擒抱结束前目标被束缚（restrained）。

actions.name: 闪电吐息 Lightning Breath
actions.description: 贝希尔吐出一道闪电线状吐息，长20尺、宽5尺。线内每个生物必须进行一次DC 16敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受到66（12d10）闪电伤害，成功则伤害减半。

actions.name: 吞噬 Swallow
actions.description:
贝希尔对其正在擒抱的一个中型或更小目标进行一次啃咬攻击。若该攻击命中，则目标也被吞下，且该擒抱结束。被吞下期间，目标目盲（blinded）且被束缚（restrained），它对来自贝希尔体外的攻击及其他效应具有完全掩护（total cover），并在贝希尔每个回合开始时受到21（6d6）强酸伤害。贝希尔一次只能吞下一个生物。
若贝希尔在同一回合内从被吞下的生物处受到30点或更多伤害，则贝希尔必须在该回合结束时成功通过一次DC 14体质豁免，否则将反刍该生物；该生物在距离贝希尔10尺内的一个空间中倒地（prone）。若贝希尔死亡，被吞下的生物不再被其束缚，并可使用15尺移动力从尸体中逃出，离开时处于倒地（prone）。

monsters.appearance:
中立邪恶的怪异生物——青足龙蛇，体型庞大且凶猛异常。它那如蛇般的躯体绵延近三十尺，盘卷时兼具爬行动物的优雅与压碎一切的力量。十二条粗壮有力的腿从两侧突起，每条腿的末端皆长有锐爪，能够以惊人的力度抓握岩石与石块。它的鳞甲光泽闪烁，沿脊柱呈深电蓝色，腹部则转为淡蔚蓝，每一块鳞片光滑如抛光陶瓷，却又坚硬如盔甲。

青足龙蛇的头部似龙兼鳄，细长呈楔形，口中布满相互咬合的獠牙，专为撕裂并整吞猎物而生。钝鼻前端两侧的鼻孔微微张开，头冠与颈脊上排列着两排向后弯曲的角，微微放电，发出细微的嗞嗞声。其眼中燃烧着冷峻的智慧——细长的瞳孔在黑暗中如银色闪电般闪耀。

当它准备发动攻击时，身体高高拱起，盘绕的身躯以鞭般的速度紧绷。鳞甲下的肌肉起伏翻滚，昭示出恐怖的力量与旺盛的生命力。尽管体型庞大，它的行动却如盘旋的鞭索般迅捷，每一次移动都寂静而精准。它散发出的气场如同耐心的猎手——冷酷、算计且自信无比，毫不留情。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil monstrosity of immense size and predatory menace, known as a Behir. Its serpentine body stretches nearly thirty feet long and coils with both reptilian grace and crushing power. Twelve thick, muscular legs emerge from its flanks, each ending in taloned claws that can grip rock and stone with astounding strength. Its hide glistens with overlapping scales that shift from deep electric blue along the spine to pale azure on the belly, each segment smooth yet armored like polished ceramic plates.  

The Behir’s head resembles a blend of dragon and crocodile, long and wedge-shaped with a maw lined by interlocking fangs made for rending and swallowing whole. Small nostrils flare near its blunt snout, while twin rows of backward-curving horns sweep along its crown and neck ridge, crackling faintly with static energy. Its eyes burn with cold intelligence—slitted pupils shining like silver lightning in the dark.  

When poised to strike, the creature’s body arches high off the ground, coils tightening with whip-fast precision. Muscles ripple beneath its plated hide, betraying terrifying strength and vitality. Despite its size, it moves with the speed of a coiled whip, every motion silent and deliberate. The aura it exudes is that of a patient hunter—cold, calculating, and mercilessly confident.

monsters.name: 眼魔
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 120 尺,被动察觉 22
monsters.languages_text: 深潜语, 地底通用语
monsters.description:
人们仅仅看一眼就足以认知眼魔的肮脏与其超自然的本质。 它们贪婪而充满憎恨, 而且具有强烈的进攻性。这种畸变怪会驱逐其他所有生物, 仅凭其自己的好恶就戏弄甚至摧毁其他生物。

眼魔的球状身体时刻悬浮着, 而它那巨大而囊鼓的眼球睁圆在一张血盆大口上方, 其他较小的眼柄则在其身边扭曲旋转着搜索敌人。眼魔入睡时会闭上主眼,同时睁开眼柄的小眼睛时刻保持警戒。

独立而排外 Xenophobic Isolationists。敌人比比皆是,至少眼魔自己是这么认为的。眼魔们认为, 自己因身负神奇而辉煌的力量而被其他低等生物所厌恶,而眼魔们却时常以粗鲁和恶心的 “每只眼魔都认为自己是眼魔一族中的楷模,而其手段驱逐这些低等生物。此外, 就算其附近并没有其他生物, 眼 唯一惧怕的事,就是这个观点可能并不正确。” 魔也总是疑心自己要被人暗算。 ——矮人智者,瓦尔卡拉·落钢 Valkara Ironfell

specialAbilities.name: 反魔法力场 Antimagic Cone
specialAbilities.description: 眼魔的主眼创造出一个 150 尺锥状区域的反魔法力场,区域内效应如同法术反魔法力场 antimagic field。眼魔在每个其自己回合开始时决定该锥状范围的方向以及该力场是否激活。该区域对该眼魔自己的眼波射线同样生效

actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+5,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:14(4d6)的穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 眼波射线 Eye Rays

actions.name: 2. 麻痹射线 Paralyzing Ray

actions.name: 3. 恐惧射线 Fear Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的感知豁免, 豁免失败者将陷入 1 分钟的恐慌状态。该目标可以在每个其自己回合结束时再进行一次该豁免,豁免成功则终止该效应。

actions.name: 4. 缓慢射线 Slowing Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的敏捷豁免, 豁免失败者将在 1 分钟内速度减半。此外该生物无法执行反应, 也无法在其回合里同时执行一个动作与一个附赠动作, 而只能两者选其一。该生物可以在每个其自己回合结束时再进行一次该豁免,豁免成功则终止该效应。

actions.name: 5.衰弱射线 Enervation Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的体质豁免,豁免失败者将受到 36(8d8)的黯蚀伤害,豁免成功则伤害减半。

actions.name: 6. 念力射线 Telekinetic Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的力量豁免,豁免失败者将被眼魔抓起并向任意方向移动至多 30 尺。目标被眼魔射线的念力抓住并陷入束缚, 直至眼魔的下一回合开始时,或直至该眼魔陷入失能。

actions.name: 传送术光线 Telekinetic Ray
actions.description: 如果目标是一个未被着装或携带, 且不超过 300 磅重的物件, 则眼魔可以直接将它向任意方向移动至多 30 尺 该眼魔也可以使用该射线精确控制物件, 比如操作简单的工具或是打开一扇门或一个容器。

actions.name: 7. 催眠射线 Sleep Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的感知豁免, 豁免失败者将沉睡 1 分钟并在此期间陷入昏迷, 直至其受到伤害或由其他生物用一个动作唤醒。该射线对对构装生物和不死生物无效。

actions.name: 8. 石化射线 Petrification Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的敏捷豁免, 豁免失败者将开始变成石头并陷入束缚。目标必须在其下一回合结束时再进行一次该豁免。豁免成功则终止该效应。豁免失败,则该生物陷入石化,直至受法术高等复原术 greater restoration 或其他魔法解除该效应为止。

actions.name: 9. 解离射线 Disintegration Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的敏捷豁免,豁免失败者将受到 45(10d8)的力场伤害,如果该伤害将目标的生命值降至 0 ,则其身体将化为一堆灰尘。

actions.name: 如果目标是一个大型或更小体型的非魔法物件, 或者魔法造物, 则它的豁免直接失败
actions.description: 如果目标是巨型或更大体型的物件,则解离射线可以分解其中 10 尺立方状区域的部分。

actions.name: 10. 致死射线 Death Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 16 的敏捷豁免, 豁免失败者将受到 55(10d10)的黯蚀伤害,如果目标因此生命降至 0,则其直接死亡。

monsters.appearance:
它是一种守序邪恶的异常生物，体型庞大，几乎有十尺高与宽，整体呈漂浮的球形。整个身体像一个肿胀的斑驳皮革般的肉球，表面布满淡淡的脊纹和不规则的血管，在皮肤下脉动不止。皮肤散发出薄薄的油光，呈紫色与灰色相间，散发出令人不安的异域光泽。球体中心张开一只巨大的圆形琥珀金色眼睛，裂缝状的瞳孔随智慧且算计的凝视而闪动、收缩。那不眨眼的目光之下是一张宽阔、咆哮的嘴巴，排列着锯齿状、不规则且锋利到足以斩断骨骼的牙齿。

数十根柔韧的眼柄从其冠部和两侧伸出，卷曲后又以诡异的精准度展开。眼柄尖端的较小眼睛不停地在各个方向旋转，闪烁着警惕的猜疑与冷酷的恶意。尽管没有明显的推进手段，它却轻松漂浮，阴影在地面上以精确而刻意的方式移动。整体印象是完美而可怕的控制——一种冷酷、纪律严明的仇恨，体现在漂浮的血肉与不眨眼的视线之中。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil aberration, a massive floating creature almost ten feet in height and breadth. Its entire body resembles a swollen orb of mottled, leathery flesh, pocked with faint ridges and irregular veins pulsing beneath the surface. The skin glistens with a thin, oily sheen of violet and gray tones, giving it an unsettling, alien luster. At the center of the sphere gapes a huge, round eye of amber gold with a slit-like pupil that flicks and narrows with an intelligent, calculating focus. Beneath that unblinking gaze stretches a wide, snarling mouth lined with jagged, uneven teeth—each one sharp enough to sheer through bone.  

Dozens of flexible eyestalks sprout from the creature’s crown and sides, each one curling and unfurling with eerie precision. The smaller eyes at their tips swivel restlessly in every direction, gleaming with watchful suspicion and cold malice. Despite having no apparent means of propulsion, the being hovers effortlessly, its shadow drifting over the ground in exact, deliberate motion. The overall impression is one of perfect, terrible control—a cold, disciplined hatred embodied in drifting flesh and unblinking vision.

actions.name: 如果目标是一个大型或更小体型的非魔法物件, 或者魔法造物, 则它的豁免直接失败
actions.description: 如果目标是巨型或更大体型的物件,则解离射线可以分解其中 10 尺立方状区域的部分。

actions.name: 10. 致死射线 Death Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 17 的敏捷豁免, 豁免失败者将受到 55(10d10)的黯蚀伤害,如果目标因此生命降至 0,则其直接死亡。

legendaryActions.description: 亡眼暴君拥有 3 传奇动作,用于选择执行下列动作选项。每次执行传奇动作时, 每个选项只可以选用一次, 且只能在另一生物的回合结束时执行。暴君在它的回合开始时恢复其所有已消耗的传奇动作数。

actions.name: 眼波射线 Eye Ray
actions.description: 亡眼暴君随机使用一种眼波射线。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立邪恶亡灵，悬浮在地面上方约五至六英尺，其形体是对生命的扭曲嘲讽。亡眼暴君的躯体由一颗巨大的颅骨构成，约等于成年人的躯干大小，已被剥去所有肉体，却被诡异的死灵能量所驱动。其骨面风化且布满裂纹，微微散发出苍白的灰色光泽。空洞的眼窝中燃烧着病态的红光，犹如垂死的余烬跳动；宽阔的下颚张开，露出一排锯齿状、不规则的牙齿，闪烁着如古老象牙碎片般的寒光。

颅骨的后部与冠部生出数十根细长的眼柄，每根都是苍白、筋状的触须，末端是一只枯萎的眼球，能够独立旋转，动作精准得令人不安。这些眼柄如蛇般优雅地摆动，彰显出怪物出奇的敏捷。亡眼暴君的口中与眼窝里渗出淡淡的死腐蒸汽，随其漂浮的姿态缓缓向下蔓延。

尽管缺乏血肉，它的存在却显得充满活力且坚不可摧，仿佛死亡本身被锻造成了运动的形体。其周围的光环低鸣着无声的威胁，寒冷的压迫感充斥空气，令人心生恐惧，标记出亡眼暴君既是墓穴的统治者，也是毁灭之源。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil undead hovering five to six feet above the ground, its form a grotesque parody of life. The Death Tyrant’s body consists of a massive skull, roughly the size of a man’s torso, stripped clean of flesh yet animated by eerie necromantic energy. Its bone surface is weathered and cracked, gleaming faintly with a pallid gray sheen. From its hollow eye sockets burns a sickly red light that dances like dying embers, and the cavernous jaw gapes with rows of jagged, uneven teeth that glimmer like shards of ancient ivory.  

Dozens of small eyestalks sprout from the back and crown of its skull, each a pale, sinewy tendril ending in a shriveled eyeball that swivels independently with unnerving precision. These stalks move with serpentine grace, betraying the creature’s unnerving agility. A faint mist of necrotic vapor oozes from the Death Tyrant’s mouth and eye sockets, trailing downward as it floats effortlessly through the air.  

Despite its lack of flesh, its presence feels vigorous and unyielding, as though death itself has been forged into motion. The aura around it hums with silent menace, a cold pressure that fills the air with dread, marking the Death Tyrant as both ruler and ruin of the grave.

monsters.name: 观察者眼魔
monsters.alignment: 尤其是其召唤者已经死亡的情况下更是如此。失去使命的观察者眼魔
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 120 尺,被动察觉 16
monsters.languages_text: 深潜语,地底通用语,心灵感应 120 尺

actions.name: 啃咬Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+1,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:2(1d6-1)的穿刺伤害

actions.name: 眼波射线 Eye Ray
actions.description: 观察者眼魔从下列选项中选择发射两束魔法眼波射线,并指定身边 90 尺内它可以看到的一到两个目标。 每种射线观察者在一回合中只能使用一次:

actions.name: 1. 困惑射线 Confusion Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 13 的感知豁

actions.name: 免, 豁免失败者直至其下回合结束前都无法执行任何反应
actions.description: 该生物在其自己回合中将无法移动, 并使用其动作对可及范围内随机的某个生物发动一次近战或远程攻击。如果受术目标无法攻击, 则其在自己回合中什么都不做。

actions.name: 2. 麻痹射线 Paralyzing Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 13 的体质豁免, 豁免失败者将陷入 1 分钟的麻痹。该目标可以在每个其自己回合结束时再进行一次该豁免,豁免成功则终止该效应。

actions.name: 3. 恐惧射线 Fear Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 13 的感知豁免, 豁免失败者将陷入 1 分钟的恐慌状态。该目标可以在每个其自己回合结束时再进行一次该豁免,豁免成功则终止该效应。

actions.name: 4. 致伤射线 Wounding Ray
actions.description: 目标必须进行一次 DC 13 的体质豁免,豁免失败者将受到 16(3d10)的黯蚀伤害,豁免成功则伤害减半。

actions.name: 造粮 Create Food and Water
actions.description: 观察者眼魔以魔法制造足够维持自己 24 小时供给的食物和饮用水。

reactions.name: 法术反射 Spell Reflection
reactions.description: 如果观察者眼魔通过了对法术的豁免检定, 或者对其发动的法术攻击未命中时, 它可指定身边 30 尺范围内一个它能看见的其他生物 (包括施法者), 如果该法术迫使目标进行豁免检定, 则被指定的生物必须自行进行豁免。若该法术发动一次攻击,则该法术必须对被指定生物重掷攻击检定。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立异常生物，曾被造物主的意志束缚，如今漂泊无目的。观察者眼魔悬浮约五至六英尺高，球形躯体漂浮在离地面几英寸的空中。其皮革般的皮肤散发出油腻的青灰色光泽，点缀着暗淡紫色的细微血管，缓慢脉动，暗示着其中有奇异的生命。皮肤下的肌肉脊梁透露出对无肢体生物而言出人意料的体力。

躯体中心占据着一只巨大的不眨眼睛，明亮的黄色，垂直裂缝形瞳孔，以令人不安的精准度快速转动。其冠部对称生出四根触手，每根触手末端是一颗较小、独立的眼球——眼睑抽动，目光飞转，永不安歇。细微的皱纹和淡淡的疤痕遍布这些触手，昭示着多年警惕的服役。

其口位于中央眼睛下方，呈锯齿状的灰色牙环在透明的唾液中闪光，周围的肉瓣抽动，以缓慢而刻意的节奏开合。它的动作平滑且平衡，在空中滑行，展现出对如此圆滚形体而言意想不到的敏捷。生物散发出紧绷且警觉的气息；即使在静止时，也仿佛绷紧待发。

当主人的指令消失时，它的气场带有不安——孤独的哨兵，异形的，谨慎且暗藏威胁。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral aberration, once bound by its creator’s will but now adrift and purposeless. The Spectator hovers about five to six feet in height, its spherical body floating a few inches above the ground. Its leathery skin gleams with an oily greenish-gray hue, mottled by faint veins of dull violet that pulse slowly, suggesting strange life within. Muscular ridges beneath the hide hint at a surprising physical vigor for a creature without limbs.  

At the center of its body dominates a large, unblinking eye, bright yellow with a vertical slit pupil that flicks about with unnerving precision. Four stalks sprout symmetrically from its crown, each ending in a smaller, independent eyeball—lids twitching, gazes darting, never resting. Fine wrinkles and faint scars across these stalks suggest long years of vigilant service. Its maw lies beneath the central eye, a jagged ring of grayish teeth glistening with translucent saliva, framed by twitching flesh that opens and closes in a slow, deliberate rhythm.  

Its movements are smooth and balanced, gliding through the air with an agility unexpected for such a rotund form. The creature exudes a tense, watchful presence; even in stillness, it seems coiled for reaction. When its master’s command is gone, its aura carries restlessness—a lonely sentinel, alien, cautious, and quietly threatening.

monsters.name: 枯萎怪
monsters.description:
枯萎怪是一群腐败的植物怨灵，常在荒废的墓地、被遗忘的墓穴或被破坏的森林中出现。它们原本是普通的植物，却被暗黑的力量扭曲，失去生机，变成了渴求腐肉的凶残生物。枯萎怪的外形如同干枯的灌木，枝条上布满了腐烂的苔藓和枯黄的叶片，散发出令人作呕的腐臭气味。它们行动缓慢，却能在阴暗处悄然潜伏，等待不幸的冒险者靠近后发动致命攻击。

尽管外表看似脆弱，枯萎怪却拥有对毒素的天然免疫，并且对非魔法武器的伤害只有一半抵抗。这使得它们在与普通的肉体战士交锋时能够保持一定的生存能力。枯萎怪的本性邪恶且自私，它们会利用任何机会吞噬活体，以延续自己的腐败存在。它们常成群出现，利用数量上的优势压倒单个目标，尤其在黑暗环境中更具威胁。

specialAbilities.name: 植物免疫 Plant Immunity
specialAbilities.description: 对毒素伤害和中毒状态免疫，并对非魔法武器造成的钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害具有抗性（只受到一半伤害）。

specialAbilities.name: 黑暗视觉 Darkvision
specialAbilities.description: 在黑暗中可见60尺范围内的事物，视力如同在明亮光线下般清晰。

actions.name: 爪击 Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4命中，触及5尺。命中后造成1d4+2点挥砍伤害。

monsters.appearance:
中立邪恶 野兽  
约有三尺半高，这个生物看起来像灌木与尸体的怪诞融合体。它的身体由扭曲、枯枝交错而成，勉强呈现出类人形状，纤细而柔韧，却在腐烂的树皮层下显得异常筋骨分明。干裂的树皮如同它的皮肤，斑驳着霉绿苔藓的斑块和病态棕色树汁的条纹，树汁像血般从旧伤口渗出。  

它的四肢又长又细，关节如藤蔓与骨骼交织，末端长着带刺的爪子，滴落着暗色树汁。生物的姿态低伏而蹲踞，野性十足，透露出埋伏与饥饿的气息。头部倾斜得不自然，周围环绕着锯齿状的小枝，犹如鬃毛；两只空洞的眼窝中微微散发出淡 amber 色的光辉——一种令人不安的“有意识”讽刺。  

它移动时枯萎的叶子在身上颤动，细小的昆虫爬满其表面，以腐败为食。周围的空气弥漫着潮湿泥土和腐烂的淡淡腐臭。虽体型不大，却散发出静默的威胁——一种不该存在的生物在暗处潜伏，随时准备从灌木丛中猛扑而出。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil beast. Standing about three and a half feet tall, the creature resembles a grotesque fusion of shrub and corpse. Its body is composed of twisted, gnarled branches that form a vaguely humanoid shape, wiry and flexible yet unnaturally sinewy beneath layers of rotting bark. Dry, cracked bark serves as its skin, mottled with patches of mold-green moss and streaks of sickly brown sap that ooze like blood from old wounds.  

Its limbs are long and wiry, jointed like both vines and bones, ending in thorny claws that drip with dark sap. The creature’s stance is low and crouched, a feral poise that speaks of ambush and hunger. Its head tilts unnaturally, framed by jagged twigs resembling a mane, with two hollow eye sockets glowing faintly amber from within—an unsettling parody of sentience.  

Shriveled leaves flutter from its body as it moves, and tiny insects crawl across its surface, feeding on the decay. The air around it carries a faint, putrid stench of wet earth and decomposition. Though small, its presence evokes quiet menace—a creeping sense of something that should never have lived, waiting in the dark to lunge from the undergrowth.

monsters.name: 枯针怪
monsters.senses_text: 盲视 60 尺(该范围外视为目盲),被动察觉 9

actions.name: 爪击 Claws
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+3,触及 5 尺,单一目标。 伤害:6(2d4+1)的穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 针刺Needles
actions.description: 远程武器攻击:命中+3,射程 30/60 尺,单一目标。伤害:8(2d6+1)的穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的植物生物，体型约与人类相当，身高约六尺。它的身体像是由脆弱的枝条和暗绿色藤蔓扭曲而成的类人形嘲讽，外覆如树皮般的硬化皮肤。无数锐利的木质针刺从四肢和躯干突起，表面闪烁着淡淡的树脂光泽。其身形瘦削而坚韧，透露出随时出击的紧绷姿态，每一次动作都刻意且令人不安地精准。

它的头部平滑地与躯干融合，毫无明显颈部；本应有面的部位是一对深陷的凹洞，散发出微弱的黄绿色光芒。眼睛闪烁着不自然的警觉，然而那空洞的光芒透露出如同其躯体般木讷的思维。嘴巴是一道锯齿状的裂口，布满碎木屑而非牙齿，张得像枯木中裂开的节疤。

手臂的末端化作细长如指的树枝，顶端长满刀锋般的刺；双腿逐渐细化成根状的脚掌，行进时深深扎入土壤。整个形体散发出腐败与潮湿树皮的刺鼻气味。它静止不动时，仿佛昏暗中一株枯萎的灌木，直至它颤动起来，带着恶意的静止，使周围空气骤然寒冷。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil plant creature, roughly human-sized, standing about six feet tall. Its body resembles a twisted mockery of a humanoid shape formed entirely from brittle branches and dark green vines hardened into bark-like skin. Countless sharp wooden needles jut from its limbs and torso, glistening with a faint resinous sheen. Its frame is lean but wiry, conveying a tense readiness to strike, every movement deliberate and disturbingly precise.  

The creature’s head merges smoothly into its body, lacking a distinct neck, and where a face should be, deep-set hollows glow with faint yellow-green light. These eyes flicker with an unnatural alertness, though their emptiness betrays a mind as wooden as its body. Its mouth is a jagged split lined with splinters rather than teeth, gaping like a cracked knot in dead wood.  

Its arms end in long, finger-like twigs tipped with razor-sharp thorns, and its legs taper down to rootlike feet that dig into the soil as it moves. The entire form exudes a pungent odor of decay and wet bark. When it stands still, it could be mistaken for a dead shrub in the gloom, until it shudders to life with a malevolent stillness that chills the air around it.

monsters.name: 枯枝怪
monsters.senses_text: 盲视 60 尺(该范围外视为目盲),被动察觉 9

specialAbilities.name: 拟形 False Appearance
specialAbilities.description: 该枯萎怪静止不动时与普通的枯死灌木一模一样

actions.name: 爪击 Claws
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+3,触及 5 尺,单一目标。 伤害:3(1d4+1)的穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的植物生物。它约有六尺高，约等于人类的身高，但全身由扭曲的枝桠和枯瘦的细枝构成。其躯体纤细且不平整，细长的四肢以不自然的角度弯曲，却展现出异常的敏捷。树皮般的皮肤呈暗棕与灰色的粗糙拼块，掺杂着苔绿的斑点和干枯腐烂的斑痕。肩部和膝盖处突出的细小碎片如同刺刺，形成锯齿状的轮廓。

它的面孔是一副空洞的树皮面具——本应是嘴部的裂缝中露出由锯齿状木片构成的碎裂牙齿。两道暗 amber（琥珀）色的微光在眼窝深处燃烧，微微闪烁如垂死的余烬，透露出一丝恶意本能的火花。细长的木质指尖化作锋利的枝条爪子，极其适合抓握与撕裂。当它静止不动时，几乎可以被误认为是枯死灌木的一部分，但其姿态紧绷且充满捕食性，仿佛随时准备对任何动作发动攻击。一股腐烂与潮湿泥土的淡淡气味萦绕其身，周围的空气也显得压抑而阴沉，尽管体型不大、力量有限，却仍散发出残忍而潜伏的恶意。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil plant creature. It stands around six feet tall, roughly the height of a human, but its body is formed entirely of twisted branches and gnarled twigs. The creature’s frame is wiry and uneven, with thin limbs that bend at unnatural angles yet move with uncanny agility. Its bark-like skin is a rough patchwork of dark brown and gray tones, streaked with hints of mossy green and spots of dry decay. Small splinters jut out from its shoulders and knees like thorns, giving it a jagged silhouette.

Its face is a hollow mask of bark plates—splits where a mouth should be reveal splintered teeth made from jagged wood. Two dim amber lights burn deep within its eye sockets, flickering faintly like dying embers, betraying a faint spark of malevolent instinct. Thin wooden fingers end in sharp twig-like claws, perfect for grasping and tearing. When it stands still, it could be mistaken for part of a dead thicket, but its posture is tense and predatory, as if ready to lash out at any movement. A faint scent of rot and damp earth clings to it, and the air around it feels quietly oppressive, reflecting a cruel and creeping malevolence despite its small size and modest power.

monsters.name: 枯藤怪
monsters.senses_text: 盲视 60 尺(该范围外视为目盲),被动察觉 10

specialAbilities.name: 拟形 False Appearance
specialAbilities.description: 该枯萎怪静止不动时与普通的纠结藤蔓一模一样

actions.name: 绞缠 Constrict
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+4,触及 10 尺,单一目标。伤害:9(2d6+2)的钝击伤害,如果目标为大型或更小体型则其受擒抱 (逃脱 DC 12)。直至该擒抱终止前, 该目标受束缚, 而该枯萎怪无法绞缠另一个目标。

actions.name: 缠身植被 Entangling Plant (充能 5~6)
actions.description: 以枯萎怪味中心半径 15 尺范围内长出擒抱根须与藤蔓,并持续存在 1 分钟后枯萎。在其存在期间, 该区域对非植物生物视为困难地形。此外, 区域内由该枯萎怪指定的每个生物在这些植物出现时, 必须进行一次 DC 12 的力量豁免, 豁免失败者将受束缚。以该方式被束缚的生物必须进行一次 DC 12 的力量检定以挣脱束缚, 或由另一处于可触及目标的生物以同类的检定为其解脱。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的植物生物，形体大致类人形，身高约六尺。它的全身由扭曲的树皮、纤维茎和纠结的藤蔓编织而成，藤蔓轻轻蠕动，仿佛拥有独立的生命。躯干紧凑而筋骨分明，犹如古树的坚硬树干；本应是肌肉的部位则伸出如绳索般的触须，使其动作既轻盈又突兀。其树皮般的皮肤呈深棕与发霉的绿交杂，表面湿润光滑，斑驳着苔藓与爬行真菌的斑块。

头部是一团扭结的枯木，裂开成粗糙的面孔——空洞的眼窝散发出微弱的病态黄绿色光芒，裂缝状的口部不规则张开，边缘布满如刺般的碎木而非牙齿。肩部和前臂上冒出小树枝，随动作颤动。其长藤手臂以鞭状触须收尾，尖端缠绕着卷曲的刺。双腿粗壮如根，踏步时会拖拽出潮湿的土壤。

它的姿态弓背且充满捕食性，散发出一种静谧而令人不安的威胁，仿佛整片森林决定化作人形，来勒死所有靠近的生灵。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil plant creature shaped roughly like a humanoid, standing about six feet tall. Its body is woven entirely from twisted bark, fibrous stems, and tangled vines that writhe softly as if they have a life of their own. The torso is compact and sinewy, resembling the tough trunk of an ancient tree, while long, rope-like tendrils extend where muscles should be, allowing lithe and jerky movements. Its bark-like skin is a mix of dark brown and moldy green, slick with moisture and streaked with patches of moss and creeping fungi.  

Its head is a knot of gnarled wood split open into a crude semblance of a face—empty hollows for eyes glow faintly with sickly yellow-green light, and a slit-like maw opens unevenly, lined with thornlike splinters instead of teeth. Small twigs sprout from its shoulders and forearms, twitching when it moves. The creature’s long vine arms end in whip-like tendrils tipped with curling thorns. Its legs are thick, root-like, and drag damp soil wherever it steps.  

Its stance is hunched and predatory, exuding a quiet, unsettling menace—as though the forest itself had decided to take human form to strangle anything living that wanders too close.

monsters.description:
熊地精们为战斗与暴乱而生。以掠夺和狩猎营生的它们四处欺凌弱小却不屑受人指使。不过, 为了享受血战与财宝的乐趣, 它们还是可以为那些强大的主人担任一些打手的工作。

类地精 Goblinoids。熊地精经常混迹于其表亲种族群体里, 亦即大地精 hobgoblins 和地精 goblins 的群落中。它们常常奴役所遇到的地精, 还会敲诈大地精的金子与食物作为它们担当斥候与突击部队的报酬。然而即使是雇佣关系的熊地精, 也是极不可靠的盟友。不过地精与大地精们为了得到这些生物的强大支援, 还是会愿意为其耗费大量的部族资源。

赫鲁格克的追随者Followers of Hruggek。熊地精崇拜一位居于修罗场 Acheron 位面的弱等神祇,其名为赫鲁格克 Hruggek。 不与其类地精表亲一起时, 它们会以最凶悍的个体带头组成若干松散的战团。熊地精们坚信自己死后, 有机会化作灵魂与赫鲁格克并肩作战。为了赢取这份殊荣, 它们时刻都会拼尽全力杀敌以证明自己的价值。

可收买的伏击者 Venal Ambushers。熊地精尽管体格吓人, 却意外的善长隐匿行动。它们热衷于伏击敌人,却又常常在身处劣势时仓皇逃窜。只要有足够的饮食补给和财宝, 熊地精还算是比较有实力的佣兵,只不过它们还会在命悬一线时摒弃约定。熊地精战团的伤员会成为弃卒以让其他成员得以逃脱。然后这些被遗弃的熊地精又会为了活命转而为敌人带路, 帮其追捕自己的前队友们。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱中立的类人怪物，身高约六尺，体型如野性捕食者般凶悍。暗棕与炭黑相间的浓密粗毛覆满其强壮的躯体，宛如一只学会行走并以人类方式战斗的熊。其肩部与手臂宽阔且肌肉结实，修长的四肢以巨大的爪形手掌收尾，适合碾碎或抓握猎物。它的姿态略显弓背，却又随时准备以惊人的速度与敏捷向前扑出。

面容粗野且具动物气息，突出的下颚上长满不规则的黄牙与锋利的獠牙，专用于撕裂肉块。扁平的鼻梁延伸至一张不断抽动、露出饥饿低吼的口中。双眼闪烁着野性的狡黠——警觉、琥珀色且在疯狂中仍带有算计。尖锐的耳朵从头部两侧竖起，半被打结的毛发和系在其上的皮绳遮掩，皮绳上挂着粗糙的战利品。

熊地精的盔甲由拾荒而得的兽皮与锈蚀金属板拼凑而成，松散地披覆以便快速移动。它的站姿与呼吸散发出未经驯服的凶威——更像野兽而非士兵，其存在暗示着一名渴望下一次埋伏的雇佣兵的无尽暴力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral humanoid, a bugbear roughly six feet tall and built like a wild predator. Thick, coarse fur of dusky brown and charcoal black blankets its powerful frame, giving it the look of a bear that learned to walk and fight like a man. Its shoulders and arms are broad and knotted with muscle, and its long limbs end in large, clawed hands suited for crushing or grasping prey. The creature’s posture is hunched yet poised, ready to spring forward with surprising speed and agility.  

Its face is brutish and animalistic, with a jutting jaw filled with uneven yellow tusks and sharp teeth suited for tearing meat. A flat nose flares over a mouth that constantly twitches into a hungry snarl. The eyes gleam with feral cunning—alert, amber-colored, and calculating even in madness. Pointed ears rise from the sides of its head, half-hidden by matted fur and leather thongs tied around them as crude trophies.  

Bugbear armor is a patchwork of scavenged hides and rusty metal plates, worn loosely to allow swift movement. The creature’s stance and breathing radiate an untamed menace—more beast than soldier—and its presence suggests the restless violence of a mercenary eager for its next ambush.

monsters.appearance: 这是一只混乱邪恶的地精类生物，身高约六尺，体格魁梧、肌肉发达，宛如随时待发的捕食者。它的全身披覆着粗糙的暗棕色毛皮，毛发沾满泥土与油脂，散发出淡淡的动物腥味。毛皮在肩部和上臂处尤为浓密，厚厚的皮层下可见绳状的肌肉隆起；而在前臂和颈部则变得稀薄，露出粗糙的皮革般皮肤。它的面孔是猿类与地精的野蛮混合体——宽而扁平的鼻子、突出的眉脊以及宽大的下颚，牙齿呈黄褐色的象牙状獠牙，即便闭口也可见其尖突。两侧的耳朵小而尖锐，随时抽动；深陷的琥珀色眼睛闪烁着捕食者般的警觉光芒。熊地精的长臂以结节状、带爪的手收尾，暗色指甲弯曲如利爪，专用于撕裂与抓握。它身穿补丁斑驳、磨损的皮甲，系以破旧的皮带，并装饰有牙齿和小骨头。其姿态低沉而警备，双腿微屈，既像随时准备冲刺的猛兽，也似随时可潜入阴影的潜伏者。一股凶险的威慑气场笼罩其周围，空气中充斥着突如其来的凶猛伏击的预兆。
monsters.appearanceEn: This is a chaotic evil goblinoid, standing roughly six feet tall with a hulking, muscular frame that looms like a predator ready to strike. Its body is draped in crude, dark brown fur matted with dirt and oils, giving off a faint animal musk. The fur grows thick around the shoulders and upper arms, where corded muscle bulges beneath the hide, and thins to reveal rough, leathery skin along the forearms and neck. Its face is a brutish mix between ape and goblin—broad flat nose, heavy brow ridge, and wide jaw lined with yellowed tusk-like fangs that protrude even when its mouth is closed. Small, sharply pointed ears twitch at the sides of its head, while deep-set amber eyes gleam with predatory alertness. The bugbear’s long arms end in knotty, clawed hands with dark nails curved for ripping and grasping. It wears patched and worn leather armor, strapped with ragged belts and decorated with teeth and small bones. Its stance is low and ready, legs bent slightly, the posture of a creature equally prepared to spring forward or melt into shadows. An aura of menace clings to it, the air around heavy with the promise of sudden, violent ambush.

monsters.name: 鲨蜥兽
monsters.skills: 察觉+6 感官:黑暗视觉 60 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 16 语言:一挑战等级:5(1,800 XP)
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 16 语言:一挑战等级:5(1,800 XP)
monsters.description:
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_30_129_84_1495_1005_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_30_129_84_1495_1005_0.jpg)

鲨蜥兽是巨大的掠食者,无论栖息何处都是霸主。作为 “陆鲨”的鲨蜥兽活着只为填饱肚子。它们暴躁而贪婪,不惧任何生物, 也不在乎数量或力量上的优劣, 随时毫不犹豫地发动攻击。

地底猎手 Underground Hunters。猎食时,鲨蜥兽用强壮的爪子在地下挖洞, 毫不在意障碍。它们连根铲除树木, 造成山体滑坡, 并在身后留下坑洞。鲨蜥兽一旦侦测到生物活动造成的土石震颤就会从地下一跃而出,张牙舞爪的扑向猎物。

游荡的怪物Wandering Monster。鲨蜥兽广泛分布在温带的大陆, 捕食任何动物和类人生物。它们不喜欢矮人和精灵肉, 然而往往在杀死猎物后才意识到猎物为何。鲨蜥兽最爱半身人肉, 很喜欢在旷野上追逐肥胖的半身人。

鲨蜥兽没有巢穴, 不过通常在一片方圆不超过三十里的领地内狩猎。它们对领地的唯一标准就是食物,吃完领地内的所有食物后, 鲨蜥兽便会继续迁徙。它们经常定居在类人生物村镇附近令居民胆战心惊,直至最后居民全部逃离,或鲨蜥兽被杀死。

鲨蜥兽把会动的东西都当作食物, 因此所有生物都对其退避三舍,甚至包括其他的掠食者和其他鲨蜥兽。鲨蜥兽只会为了交配而聚到一起, 在一番尖牙利爪的血腥乱舞后, 这场聚会通常是以雄性的死亡与被吞噬而告终。

奥术的造物 Arcane Creation。一些智者认为鲨蜥兽是某个疯狂法师用鳄龟与犰狳杂交,再注入恶魔脓水的实验产物。曾有好几次人们都以为鲨蜥兽灭绝了, 然而多年没有目击记录后, 这些生物总会重现于世。因为几乎从没人见过鲨蜥兽幼崽,一些智者怀疑它们有秘密的繁殖场所, 直至其个体成年后才会来到外面的世界中。

specialAbilities.name: 立定跳跃 Standing Leap
specialAbilities.description: 巨颚龙的跳远最多30尺，跳高最多15尺，无论是否助跑皆可。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：30（4d12+4）点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 致命跳跃 Deadly Leap
actions.description: 如果巨颚龙在其移动的一部分中跳跃至少15尺，它随后可以使用此动作，以双脚着地并落在一个包含一个或多个其他生物的空间内。每个此类生物必须成功通过一次DC 16的力量或敏捷豁免（目标自选），否则将被击倒 prone，并受到14（3d6+4）点钝击伤害外加14（3d6+4）点挥砍伤害。若豁免成功，该生物仅受到一半伤害，不会被击倒 prone，并被推离巨颚龙的空间5尺，进入由该生物选择的一处未被占据的空间。若范围内没有未被占据的空间，则该生物改为在巨颚龙的空间内倒地 prone。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只中立大型怪异生物，约有十尺高，拥有为原始力量而生的粗壮、桶形身躯。它的全身被绞紧的肌肉填满，肌肉在厚实、皮革般的外皮下起伏，外皮上覆着不规则的暗灰色盔甲板，犹如重叠的石块。盔甲板有脊纹且满是伤痕，间隙处则是锯齿状、似鲨鱼皮肤的斑块，触感粗糙。它宽阔而驼背的肩部向下延伸为强壮的前肢，前肢以巨大的弯曲爪收尾，每只爪子长如短剑，足以撕裂土壤或岩石。后肢粗壮坚实，以爆发性的力量推动它前进。

它的头部呈现出怪诞的鲨鱼与爬行动物混合体——扁平的铲状吻部被有脊纹的护甲覆盖，张开的颚内排列着一排排三角形锯齿牙，专用于粉碎骨骼。珠状的暗黑眼睛深陷于眼窝中，目光不眨，空洞的凝视散发出野兽般、无思考的威胁感。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral large monstrosity, towering around ten feet tall with a hulking, barrel-shaped body built for raw power. Its frame is packed with corded muscles that ripple beneath thick, leathery hide plated with irregular slabs of dull gray armor, like overlapping stone. The plates are ridged and scarred, bearing the marks of countless battles, with patches of jagged, shark-like skin in between that appear abrasive to the touch. Its broad, hunching shoulders slope into powerful forelimbs ending in massive, curved claws, each as long as a short sword, perfect for tearing through soil or stone. The hind legs are thick and sturdy, driving it forward with explosive force.  

Its head resembles a grotesque blend of shark and reptile — a flattened, shovel-like snout protected by ridged plating, gaping jaws lined with rows of triangular, serrated teeth meant for crushing bone. Beady, dark eyes stare unblinking from deep sockets, their emptiness giving it a bestial, unthinking menace, whil

monsters.name: 狂蛙人
monsters.alignment: 然后将这些巨蛙训练为护卫与猎手。一些体型更大的巨蛙有时也会被训练为坐骑
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 10

specialAbilities.name: 水陆两栖Amphibious
specialAbilities.description: 狂蛙人可以在陆上和水中自由呼吸

specialAbilities.name: 蛙类交流 Speak with Frogs and Toads
specialAbilities.description: 狂蛙人可以用狂蛙人语同任何青蛙或蟾蜍进行内容简单的交流

specialAbilities.name: 沼泽伪装 Swamp Camouflage
specialAbilities.description: 狂蛙人身处沼泽地形时,其尝试躲藏而进行的敏捷(隐匿)检定具有优势

specialAbilities.name: 立定起跳 Standing Leap
specialAbilities.description: 无论是否助跑, 狂蛙人最远可以跳 20 尺,最高 10 尺

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 狂蛙人发动两次近战攻击:一次矛攻击, 一次是啃咬攻击。

actions.name: 啃咬Bite

actions.name: 邪魔祝福 Fiendish Blessing
actions.description: 魔裔的 AC 加上其魅力加值。

actions.name: 天生施法 Innate Spellcasting
actions.description: 魔裔天生施法的关键属性为魅力

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的类人（蛙）生物。身高约三尺半，狂蛙人在蹲伏与弓背之间保持平衡，修长的四肢随时准备弹射。它那光滑、斑驳的绿色皮肤永沾水汽，在潮湿的沼泽栖息地中与环境融为一体。躯体纤细却布满坚韧的细肌，使其在体型上显得出奇地强大。宽阔的蹼足和蹼手以短粗的爪收尾，能够轻易地在泥泞与芦苇间抓挠。

突出的金色眼球高悬于宽阔而扁平的头部，能够独立转动以捕捉四面八方的动静。宽大的口周围薄薄的唇缘永远保持两栖动物式的狞笑，牙齿细小而锋利。鼻孔靠近面部张开，兼具在水面呼吸和部分潜水的功能。

一条淡淡的深色皮肤脊线沿背部向下延伸至短而粗的尾巴，每一次呼吸都使其喉囊有节律地脉动，在空气中闪烁出湿润的光泽。该生物姿态不安且警觉，双腿绷紧待发，散发出一种紧张的侵略性与沼泽天生的威胁感，而非宏伟或力量的气势。它的出现暗示着潜伏的捕食者，半影潜行、全然机会主义。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil humanoid (frog). Standing about three and a half feet tall, the bullywug balances between a crouch and a hunch, its long limbs always ready to spring. Its slick, mottled green skin glistens with a perpetual layer of moisture, blending seamlessly with the damp swampland it calls home. The body is lean but corded with wiry muscle, rendering it deceptively powerful for its size. Wide, webbed feet and hands end in stubby claws that claw effortlessly through mud and reeds.  

Its bulging golden eyes sit high on a broad, flattened head, swiveling independently to track motion in every direction. Around its wide mouth, thin lips stretch into a permanent, amphibian grimace filled with small, sharp teeth. The nostrils flare close to the face, adapted for both surface breathing and partial submersion.  

A faint ridge of darker skin runs down its back to a short, stubby tail, each breath causing its throat sac to pulse rhythmically, glimmering wetly in the air. The creature’s posture is restless and alert, its legs coiled in readiness, giving off an air of twitchy aggression and swamp-born menace rather than grandeur or might. Its presence suggests a lurking predator, half-shadowed and entirely opportunistic.

monsters.name: 魔裔
monsters.description:
魔裔（Cambion）是恶魔与凡人血脉交织的堕落后裔，常在阴暗的城市巷口或被诅咒的荒野中潜伏。它们拥有半恶魔的外貌——炽热的血红眼睛、暗红的皮肤以及微微散发的硫磺气息，却又保留了人类的伪装与狡黠。魔裔以操纵人心、挑起纷争为乐，常在凡人社会中扮演诱惑者或阴谋家的角色，以自己的恶魔血统为后盾，暗中为更高阶的恶魔势力服务。

在战斗中，魔裔凭借先天的魔法天赋和对黑暗能量的掌控，能够轻易撕开敌人的防御。他们的爪牙不只是一记普通的打击，往往伴随燃烧的地狱之火，灼烧肉体的同时腐蚀灵魂。虽然体型仅为中型，但其混乱邪恶的本性与对痛苦的渴望，使得每一次交锋都充满了致命的不可预测性。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 (Magic Resistance)
specialAbilities.description: 对所有法术豁免检定具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 暗视 (Darkvision) 60尺
specialAbilities.description: 在黑暗中能够以黑白两色看见事物，距离最高60尺。

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 (Innate Spellcasting)
specialAbilities.description:
魔裔拥有以下天生法术（使用魅力作为施法属性，DC 13，+5 加值）：
- 每日可使用1次【魅惑人类】(1级)；
- 每日可使用2次【黑暗】(2级)；
- 每日可使用1次【火焰之拳】(3级)（1d8火焰伤害）。
这些法术不需消耗法术位，且不需要材料成分。

specialAbilities.name: 恶魔血统 (Fiendish Heritage)
specialAbilities.description: 对火焰和酸性伤害具有抗性（伤害减半），并且对善良生物造成的伤害额外+2。

actions.name: 多重攻击 (Multiattack)
actions.description: 魔裔可以进行两次攻击：一次使用爪击，或一次使用短剑加一次爪击。

actions.name: 爪击 (Claw) +7
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中命中检定+7，命中后造成1d6+4挥砍伤害，并附加1d4火焰伤害。

actions.name: 短剑 (Shortsword) +7
actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击（灵活），命中检定+7，命中后造成1d6+4穿刺伤害，若目标是凡人，则额外受到1d6火焰伤害。

actions.name: 地狱报复 (Hellish Rebuke) 反应
actions.description: 当魔裔受到近战攻击并受到伤害时，可使用此反应。向攻击者发射一团火焰，造成2d10火焰伤害，DC 13 敏捷豁免成功则伤害减半。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具混乱邪恶的类人生物——半邪魔的魔裔，身高约六尺，拥有老练捕猎者般的灵活而强壮的体格。宽阔的肩膀和绳状的肌肉在如燃烧余烬般的肤色下起伏，表面隐隐发光，仿佛自内而热。细长的暗色血管如冷却熔岩的裂纹般横跨其手臂和胸膛。一对向后弯曲的黑色角从眉间伸出，角面光滑却带有淡淡的邪魔符文伤痕。

它的面容棱角分明、俊美近似人类，却有血红的蛇形裂瞳，泄露出邪魔血统。其全身散发微弱热浪，呼吸时硫磺烟雾从鼻孔中袅袅升起。嘴里露出细小却锋利如刀的獠牙，笑时闪烁，既是威胁亦是诱惑。

背部展开一对蝙蝠状的血红皮翼，翼缘点缀着细小的骨刺。柔软的尾巴在身后摇摆，尾端是一枚因火焰伤痕而黝黑的钩形倒刺。魔裔站姿高挑而从容，散发出危险的自信；每一次动作都显得刻意，宛如猎手在玩弄猎物。其周围的空气充斥着威胁的嗡鸣与燃烧的欲望。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil humanoid, a half-fiend cambion standing about six feet tall with the lithe, strong frame of a seasoned predator. Broad shoulders and corded muscles ripple beneath skin the color of smoldering embers, its surface faintly gleaming as though heated from within. Thin, dark veins trace across its arms and chest like cracks in cooling lava. A pair of curved black horns sweep backward from its brow, their surface polished yet scarred with faint infernal runes.  

Its face bears sharp, handsome features that seem almost human, but the blood-red eyes—slitted like a serpent’s—betray the infernal heritage. A faint heat shimmers around its body, and wisps of sulfuric smoke drift from its nostrils when it breathes. Its mouth reveals small but razor-edged fangs that flash when it smiles, part threat and part allure.  

Batlike wings of leathery crimson span from its back, their edges tipped with small, bone-like spines. A sinuous tail sways behind it, ending in a hooked barb darkened by fire scars. The cambion stands tall and poised, radiating a dangerous confidence; every motion feels deliberate, like a hunter playing with its prey. The air around it hums with menace and smoldering desire.

monsters.name: 食腐虫
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 13
monsters.description:
食腐虫啃掉尸体上最后一丝腐肉,再吞下了剩下的黏滑骨头。 任何胆敢闯入它们领地或是打扰它们进食的生物都要面对其凶猛的攻击。

食腐者 Carrion Eaters。食腐虫跟随死亡的气息寻找食物, 却不喜欢与别的食腐者竞争。因此这些污秽的生物通常盘踞在尸体充足且其它食腐者不便活动之处。洞窟、下水道、地下城、树木丛生的沼泽都是其偏爱的筑巢地, 而食腐虫也会被吸引到战场和墓地中。

食腐虫觅食时会一边游荡一边用触须探测空气中鲜血或腐烂的气息。地道和废墟中的食腐虫则习惯攀爬在天花板上扑向食物, 以可以避开泥怪、食腐兽 Otyughs 和其它栖息在黑暗中的危险居民,也可以突袭那些忘了抬头看一眼的猎物。

耐心的掠食者 Patient Predators。不论是在地下还是夜晚, 光亮通常意味着一顿美餐。食腐虫可能会花几小时从远处跟踪一个光源, 期望从中发现血腥气味。虽然体型颇大, 食腐虫依然可以轻松地躲在拐角的视野盲区等待猎物自投罗网。

食腐虫会充分利用其毒液来应对潜在的猎物与入侵者。一旦对方毒效发作, 食腐虫便用触须缠住麻痹僵直的猎物, 将其拖到高台或偏远地道, 再确切的将猎物杀死。然后食腐虫便一边继续巡视领地,一边等待猎物腐熟以方便进食。

specialAbilities.name: 敏锐嗅觉Keen Smell
specialAbilities.description: 食腐虫进行依赖嗅觉的感知(察觉)检定时具有优势

specialAbilities.name: 蛛行 Spider Climb
specialAbilities.description: 食腐虫可以在困难地形的表面攀爬,包括倒吊在天花板上,且不需要进行属性检定

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 食腐虫发动两次攻击:一次触须攻击和一次啃咬。

actions.name: 触须 Tentacles
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+8,触及 10 尺,单一生物。伤害:4(1d4+2)的毒素伤害,目标必须进行一次 DC 13 的体质豁免, 豁免失败则中毒 1 分钟, 并在中毒期间陷入麻痹。目标可以在每个其自己回合结束时再进行一次该豁免, 豁免成功则该中毒效应终止。

actions.name: 啃咬Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+4,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:7(2d4+2)的穿刺伤害。 人马 Centaur 大型怪兽, 中立善良

actions.name: 冲锋 Charge
actions.description: 如果人马向其目标直线移动至少 30 尺,然后在同一回合里对该目标发动长矛攻击,则该目标受到额外 10(3d6) 的穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立怪异生物，体型庞大的腐肉爬行者，约有十尺长，粗壮如战马，整体形态令人不安，融合了蠕虫与昆虫的特征。它那肌肉发达、分段的躯体覆以粗糙的淡黄色肉块，斑点状的病绿瘀伤遍布其上，表面沾满了吞噬尸体后留下的黏液与污垢。背部沿线有一排颤动的几丁质板，在火把光下微微闪光，宛若潮湿的骨骼。靠近钝圆的头部，一簇章鱼般的触手向外伸展，每根闪亮的触须上点缀着细小的倒刺，并不断脉动着毒液。  

它的眼睛如珠般小而光亮，黑色且有光泽，低垂于面部，快速而警惕地扫视四周。眼下的口部呈椭圆形，边缘布满向内弯曲的钩形牙齿，专为撕裂血肉、碾碎骨骼而生。厚实且关节分明的肢体从腹部伸出，爪端带刺，令它能够以惊人的敏捷爬上墙壁、贴附天花板。  

该生物的姿态透出一种不安的紧张感——随时待发、警觉且怪诞。每一次肢体的抽动都昭示着原始的力量与冷酷的捕食本能，而随之而来的腐败恶臭甚至让阴影也显得不安。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral monstrosity, a hulking carrion crawler about ten feet long and thick as a warhorse, its entire form an unsettling blend of worm and insect. Its muscular, segmented body ripples with coarse, pale-yellow flesh mottled with sickly green bruising, slick with slime and grime from the corpses it devours. A ridge of twitching chitin plates runs along its back, glinting faintly under torchlight like damp bone. Near its blunt head, a writhing cluster of octopus-like tentacles extends outward, each glistening strand studded with faint barbs and pulsating with venomous fluid.  

Its small, bead-like eyes are black and glossy, set low on its face and scanning its surroundings in darting, suspicious motions. The mouth beneath them is an oval maw rimmed with inward-curving hooked teeth designed to shred flesh and crush bone. Thick, jointed limbs sprout from its underside, tipped with bristled claws that allow it to scuttle up walls and cling to ceilings with unsettling agility.  

The creature’s stance exudes a restless tension—poised, alert, and grotesque. Every twitch of its limbs speaks of brute strength and ruthless predation, while the stench of decay that trails it makes even the shadows seem uneasy.

monsters.name: 人马
monsters.description: 人马是一种拥有上半身为人类、下半身为马匹的巨型生物，生活在广袤的林地和草原之间。它们以强壮的体格、敏捷的奔跑和熟练的弓术闻名，常在日落时分聚集于古老的石环中祭拜自然之神。人马的社会结构以部落为单位，部落首领通常是最为勇猛且懂得操控弓与战锤的战士。\n\n在许多地区，人马被视为中立邪恶的掠夺者，利用其快速的移动能力和强大的近战攻击抢劫过路的商队和旅行者。它们对外来者缺乏信任，常在边境设下埋伏，利用长弓进行远程射击，然后在近距离发动致命的蹄击冲锋。尽管如此，人马仍保留对自然的敬畏，若有人类或精灵以尊重的姿态接近，它们亦可能在必要时提供指引或帮助。

specialAbilities.name: 冲锋 Charge
specialAbilities.description: 如果半人马径直朝一个目标移动至少30尺，并在同一回合以长枪攻击命中它，则该目标额外受到10（3d6）点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 半人马进行两次攻击：一次以其长枪，另一次以其马蹄；或以其长弓进行两次攻击。

actions.name: 长枪 Pike
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+6，触及10尺，单一目标。命中：9（1d10+4）点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 马蹄 Hooves
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+6，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：11（2d6+4）点钝击伤害。

actions.name: 长弓 Longbow
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：命中+4，射程150/600尺，单一目标。命中：6（1d8+2）点穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只中立邪恶的类人怪物，身形高耸的半人马约有十尺高，庞大的身躯占据了十尺宽的地面。它的下半身是一匹强壮的战马，四腿肌肉绷紧，覆以粗糙的深棕色毛皮，毛皮上隐约闪烁着汗水与尘土的光泽。厚实的蹄子因无数次狩猎而磨损开裂，每一次体重的转移都深深嵌入大地。上半身则是一名粗犷的人类战士——肩宽臂壮，筋络分明，满是旧战的伤疤。皮肤因长期曝露在旷野之下而被阳光晒得黝黑且风化，显示出在露天生活的坚韧。

半人马的面容带着硬朗而务实的神情：方正的下巴被胡渣遮掩，薄唇常常挂着轻蔑的嘲笑，冷峻的琥珀色眼睛锐利而警觉，审视着四周的一切。长长的黑发被皮绳束起，编入小珠和从猎物或战利品上取下的羽毛。胸膛上有淡淡的部族纹饰，以土色颜料绘成，常被风雨抹得模糊。

它站立时保持直立却又随时准备起动，肌肉绷紧如待发的弹簧，散发出一种警惕的威胁气息——既非盲目的野蛮，也非高贵的英雄，而是理性与本能的捕食者，等待弱点的出现。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil humanoid, a towering centaur standing around ten feet tall, its massive frame filling a ten‑foot span of ground. The creature’s lower body is that of a powerful warhorse, its legs corded with muscle and coated in coarse, dark brown fur that gleams faintly with sweat and dust. Thick hooves, scuffed and cracked from countless hunts, dig into the earth with every shift of weight. The upper body is that of a rugged human warrior—broad‑shouldered, sinewy, and scarred from old battles. Its skin is sun‑darkened and weathered, showing the toughness of one who lives under open skies.  

The centaur’s face bears a hard, pragmatic look: a square jaw shadowed by stubble, thin lips often drawn into a sneer, and sharp, alert eyes of cold amber that study everything around it. Long, black hair is tied back with leather cords, braided with small beads and feathers taken from prey or trophies. Across its torso are faint tribal markings, painted in earthy pigments and smeared by wind and rain.  

It stands upright yet poised, muscles coiled for sudden motion, exuding an aura of wary menace—neither blindly savage nor noble, but a predator of reason and instinct waiting for weakness to show.

monsters.name: 奇美拉
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 18
monsters.description:
奇美拉由被召唤到人间的狄摩高根 Demogorgon 所创。恶魔主君由于对其召唤者印象不佳, 便将它们变成了恐怖的多头怪物 ——第一只奇美拉即由此诞生。
奇美拉天生如恶魔般残暴,并警醒着人们恶魔领主成功进入主物质位面时可能造成的后果。奇美拉通常长着山羊的后肢,狮子的前肢,一对龙翼以及这三种生物的头部。奇美拉喜欢对猎物发动突袭,它们一边从高空俯冲下来一边喷吐火焰,再着陆继续攻击。
矛盾的生物 Conflicted Creature。奇美拉结合了自身每部分最糟糕的一面。龙头驱使它袭击、掠夺并积聚宝藏,狮子的天性激起它猎杀领地内强大生物威胁的欲望。而它的羊头则使其恶毒顽固, 死战到底。
三种习性综合的奇美拉会划定方圆 10 里为其领地。它在其内四处猎食, 并寻找更强的怪物作对手。奇美拉的强敌包括龙、 狮鹫 griffons、蝎尾狮 manticores、佩利冬 perytons 和飞龙 wyverns。
奇美拉会纯粹的寻求猎食过程中自娱自乐。它享受猎物的恐惧与痛苦, 时常戏弄猎物, 或是给受伤的猎物留一口气, 等其受尽伤痛与恐惧折磨后再返回将其杀死。
邪恶的仆从 Servant of Evil。奇美拉远称不上狡诈,它的龙类习性使其容易受奉承与礼物影响。献上食物与财宝的旅者甚至可以躲过奇美拉的残害。而有些恶棍甚至可以用大量食物和宝藏诱使奇美拉为其服务。
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_35_0_0_1653_1111_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_35_0_0_1653_1111_0.jpg)

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 奇美拉进行三次攻击：一次用其啃咬、一次用其角击、一次用其爪击。当其火焰吐息可用时，它可以用吐息替代其啃咬或角击。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：11（2d6+4）点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 角击 Horns
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：10（1d12+4）点钝击伤害。

actions.name: 爪击 Claws
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：11（2d6+4）点挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 火焰吐息 Fire Breath
actions.description: 龙头在15尺锥形范围内喷吐火焰。该区域内的每个生物必须进行一次DC 15的敏捷豁免，豁免失败则受到31（7d8）点火焰伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱邪恶的怪物，身高近十尺，令人不安的狮、羊、龙三种形体的融合体。它庞大的躯体在粗糙的皮毛、鳞片皮肤与皮革般的薄膜交错的纹理之下，布满了强壮的肌肉。前躯如同巨大的狮子，胸膛厚实、肩宽肩阔，爪子以黑色、弯曲的利爪收束，极其适合撕裂血肉。背部展开一对巨大的蝙蝠形翼翼，翼膜呈烟雾般的深红色，血管暗红交错，展开时能扬起尘土与余烬。

三颗凶猛的头颅冠于其粗壮而有力的颈部——正中是一颗狮头，金色鬃毛被煤灰与血迹纠缠；左侧突出一颗羊头，眼神狂乱，卷曲的角上沾满砂砾；右侧则是一颗青铜鳞片的龙头，细长的裂缝瞳孔中闪烁寒光，烟雾在锯齿状的獠牙间缭绕。后躯则是巨羊的形态，分叉的蹄子踏动大地，行动间展现出惊人的敏捷。

其皮肤上刻满伤疤与灼痕，昭示着无数生还的战斗。空气中弥漫硫磺与腐败的恶臭。整只野兽散发出原始而混乱的威胁感——一只以恐惧与毁灭为乐的顶级掠食者。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil monstrosity standing nearly ten feet tall, an unsettling fusion of lion, goat, and dragon. Its hulking body is corded with powerful muscle beneath patchwork textures of coarse fur, scaled hide, and leathery membrane. The forequarters resemble a massive lion, thick-chested and broad-shouldered, with paws ending in black, curved claws ideal for rending flesh. From its back rises a pair of vast, batlike wings, their membranes a smoked crimson veined with dark arteries, capable of kicking up dust and embers when spread.  

Three ferocious heads crown its thick, sinewed necks—the lion’s head dominates the center, golden mane matted with soot and blood; to one side juts a goat’s head, eyes rolling with madness and curling horns slick with grit; to the other, a bronze-scaled dragon head glares with slit pupils, smoke curling between jagged fangs. The creature’s hindquarters are those of a great goat, ending in split hooves that churn the earth as it moves with shocking agility.  

Scars and burn marks etch its hide, hinting at countless battles survived. Its scent of sulfur and decay fills the air. The entire beast radiates a feral, chaotic menace—an apex predator that delights in fear and destruction.

monsters.name: 甲伏怪
languages: understands Deep Speech but can't speak
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 14
monsters.description:
甲伏怪是由底栖魔鱼改造后赋予智能的甲壳生物, 也是底栖魔鱼远古帝国的残存者。其脑中仍根深蒂固的保留着创造者的指令,而它们从古至今都严格遵循这些指令行事。

太古遗存者Primeval Relics。太古时期的底栖魔鱼曾统治着横跨数个大洋的庞大帝国, 并用其强大的魔法扭曲凡间新生生物的心智。然而, 底栖魔鱼的水生习性使其必须依靠仆从, 才能将其意志施加到水面之外。正是因此它们才创造了甲伏怪。

完美服从的甲伏怪遵照底栖魔鱼的命令四处搜集智慧生物与魔法。随着世代的更迭, 被设计有超强适应力的甲伏怪们变得越来越强大。而底栖魔鱼帝国随着众神崛起而分崩离析后,甲伏怪们也四散飘零。但它们仍然继续做着曾经为底栖魔鱼所做的事务,仍在悠然的采集类人生物,积攒财宝,搜集魔法,增强力量。

不倦的守卫 Tirelsee Guardians。甲伏怪仍守卫着底栖魔鱼帝国的遗迹, 沉默地遵从无数世代前的命令。有时, 寻宝者们会根据流言和古代地图找到这些遗迹的位置, 但胆大与无畏也只能为其带来死亡作为奖赏。

![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_36_0_77_899_1359_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_36_0_77_899_1359_0.jpg)

specialAbilities.name: 两栖 Amphibious
specialAbilities.description: 丘尔可以呼吸空气和水。

specialAbilities.name: 感知魔法 Sense Magic
specialAbilities.description: 丘尔能够随意感知其120尺内的魔法。除此之外，此特性如同侦测魔法（detect magic）法术般运作，但其本身并非魔法。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 丘尔进行两次钳击。如果丘尔正擒抱一个生物，丘尔还可以额外使用一次触须。

actions.name: 钳击 Pincer
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+6，触及10尺，单一目标。命中：11（2d6+4）点钝击伤害。若目标为大型或更小体型的生物，且丘尔没有擒抱另外两个生物，则目标被擒抱（逃脱DC 14）。

actions.name: 触须 Tentacles
actions.description: 一个被丘尔擒抱的生物必须成功通过一次DC 13的体质豁免，否则将中毒1分钟。直到该中毒结束前，目标陷入麻痹状态。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重复进行该豁免，成功则结束其身上的该效果。
