monsters.appearance:
这是一位中立阵营的巨型巨人，身高近三十英尺，站立于旋转的雾气与闪烁的静电弧之中。其庞大的体格如同雕刻的石块，肌肉如岩石般坚实，却在巨大的身躯下动作流畅而从容。皮肤呈现被风暴侵染的花岗岩色调——蓝灰色，并在闪电划过全身时微微发光。长长的银白色发丝如被风吹拂的云朵般在宽阔的肩膀周围飘荡盘旋，匹配的胡须环绕着一张庄严而棱角分明的面孔。

双眼散发苍白的电光，炯炯有神且警觉，映射出强大且洞察的心智。高颧骨和威严的凝视——却被元素磨砺，仿佛历经数个世纪的雷霆与洪水。手臂粗壮如柱，末端是一双巨大而优雅的手，足以握持为诸神锻造的武器。皮肤上有淡淡的似血管纹路，在表层下如闪电通道般微光闪烁。

依据其情绪，周身环绕着宁静的威严或逼近的危机光环——云雾在其脚下盘旋，微弱的风声在其身形周围缭绕。无论是仁慈的守望者还是阴郁的征服者，这位风暴巨人都如活生生的暴风，凭两条巨大的腿屹立，庄严而电光四射的宏伟令人敬畏。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a colossal giant of neutral alignment, standing nearly thirty feet tall amid swirling mists and flickering arcs of static energy. Its immense frame is sculpted with muscle like carved stone, every movement smooth and deliberate despite its tremendous size. The creature’s skin carries the hue of storm-touched granite—bluish-gray and subtly luminescent when lightning flashes across its body. Long silver-white hair flows and coils like windblown clouds around broad shoulders, and a matching beard frames a regal, angular face.  

Its eyes glow with pale electric light, intense and alert, reflecting a mind both powerful and perceptive. The features are striking—high-boned cheeks and a commanding gaze—yet hardened by the elements, suggesting centuries witness to thunder and flood. Arms thick as pillars end in large, graceful hands that can wield weapons forged for gods. The skin bears faint vein-like patterns that shimmer like lightning channels beneath the surface.  

Depending on its mood, an aura of serene majesty or looming danger surrounds it—clouds swirl at its feet and faint winds coil around its form. Whether benevolent sentinel or brooding conqueror, this storm giant stands as a living tempest on two monumental legs, towering in solemn, electrified grandeur.

monsters.name: 巨人众神
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 17
monsters.description:
远古巨人帝国陨落时,巨人的父神安南 Annam 离弃了他的所有的子孙与整个世界。他立誓决定在巨人们取回自己生为世界统治者的荣耀前, 将不再干涉任何凡间事务。此后巨人们不再向安南祈祷, 而转向投靠父神的神圣子嗣们。这些混杂着英灵与恶神的神祇一起组成了巨人神系的万神殿。
这些作为安南子嗣的神祇里, 各种类型的巨人有着各自的主神: 风暴巨人主神思绰茂兹 Stronmaus,云巨人主神曼诺 Memnor,石巨人主神司寇雷乌斯 岩骨 Skoraeus Stonebones, 霜巨人主神索列姆 Thrym,火巨人主神苏尔特 Surtur,以及山丘巨人的主神葛洛蓝托 Grolantor。并不是所有的巨人都敬畏本族的主神。很多善良的云巨人拒绝崇拜不老实的曼诺, 而住在北方冰原上的一支风暴巨人相对于思绰茂兹反而更为亲近索列姆。还有一些巨人感觉自己跟安南的女儿们有着强烈的联系,其中包括女猎人与强硬的家长西亚缇 Hiatea； 爱与和平的女神艾兰妮斯 lallanis; 还有鲁莽傲慢的欺诈者戴安喀斯特 Diancastra。
某些巨人甚至放弃信仰自己的神系,转而加入恶魔教团。它们可能效忠巴弗灭 Baphomet 或科斯彻奇 Kostchtchie。而崇拜任何非巨人系的神祇都是违背序位制度的严重罪行,而且几乎肯定会因此被逐出巨人的社会体系。
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_145_134_1683_1392_518_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_145_134_1683_1392_518_0.jpg)

monsters.appearance:
这是一位中立善良的巨人，身为类人神祇的它高耸近三十尺。其庞大的身躯由层层绳状肌肉构成，每一次动作都承载着山岳的重量，却又流露出惊人的轻盈。皮肤呈淡石灰灰色，带有微弱的蛋白石光泽，宛如经千年风雨抛光的花岗岩。银蓝色的光脉在其表层下跳动，绘出神圣纹路，闪烁如缓慢的雷电。

它的面容庄严而肃穆，长长的发丝如黎明时的暴风云般暗沉。发光的蓝宝石色双眼散发出宁静的智慧，目光既慈祥又威严。修剪精细的淡银色胡须捕捉光线，为其增添了永恒的威严。

每只手宽大而稳固，指头粗壮有力，却亦能施展细腻的精准。它身披雕刻的云状金属与石质盔甲，盔甲上刻有符文，在其周身的空气中微微闪烁。站立时姿态端庄静止，这位巨人散发出慈善与令人敬畏的气息——一位古老的守护者，其心跳仿佛在天际回响。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral good giant, a towering humanoid deity standing nearly thirty feet tall. Its colossal frame is built from layers of corded muscle, each movement carrying the weight of mountains yet flowing with surprising grace. The skin is pale stone-grey with a faint opalescent sheen, reminiscent of granite polished by centuries of wind and rain. Veins of silver-blue light pulse beneath its surface, tracing divine patterns that flicker like slow lightning.  

Its face bears noble and solemn features, framed by long, flowing hair the color of storm clouds at dawn. Eyes of glowing sapphire radiate calm intelligence, their gaze both kind and immensely powerful. A finely trimmed beard of pale silver catches the light, giving the creature an ageless majesty.  

Each hand is broad and steady, the fingers thick and strong, yet capable of gentle precision. It wears carved armor of cloud-like metal and stone, inscribed with runes that shimmer faintly in the air around its body. Standing upright with a dignified stillness, this giant exudes both benevolence and awe-inspiring presence—an ancient guardian whose very heartbeat seems to echo through the heavens.

monsters.name: 惧噬体
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10
monsters.description:
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_149_813_3_840_1347_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_149_813_3_840_1347_0.jpg)
惧噬体是所有创自邪秽巫术的恐怖之物里最邪恶、最堕落的一种。它是其受害者的眼、口与液化身体胡乱混合的产物。这些受害者因身体被摧毁而陷入疯狂, 然后再被惧噬体吸收同化, 而它们持续喋喋不休的疯狂又迫使其进一步吞噬所触碰到的一切东西。
变形虫形态 Amoeboid Form。惧噬体是一堆无定形的嘴与眼, 它可以像泥怪一样向前挪动, 或是用几张嘴咬紧地面再将自己臃肿的身躯推向后方。虽然移动得很慢,但它可以轻易的通过水面、泥沼和流沙。
疯狂之嘴Mouths of Madness。惧噬体感知到猎物时身上诸多的嘴巴便开始咕哝和喋喋不休,每张嘴发出各种不同的声音: 深沉或尖锐, 哀鸣或嚎叫, 还有各种痛苦或狂喜的叫喊。这种不谐的杂音可以压制听者的感官, 使大多数人惊恐地逃窜。剩下的人只能陷入疯狂或麻痹的站定, 死盯着这个可怕的生物等待它慢慢将自己吞噬。
香噬一切 All-Consuming。惧噬体不由自主的吞没自己能触及的所有东西,淹没所有被它恐惧咆哮怔住的受害者,这堆七嘴八舌在啃噬吞咽活肉时却又霎时间一起陷入沉默。这怪物可以将接触到的石头液化,以阻碍那些抵受住呓语并试图逃跑的生物。
惧噬体所过之处有如风卷残云。而受害者身体的每一丝骨肉都被吞噬干净后, 他曾经的嘴与眼便浮现在惧噬体的表面, 并加入这怪物的呓语和下一次吞食盛宴。
惧噬体 Gibbering Mouther

specialAbilities.description: 以咕哝怪为中心10尺半径内的地面呈面团状的困难地形。每个在该区域内开始其回合的生物必须进行一次DC 10力量豁免，失败则其速度降低为0，直到其下一回合开始。

specialAbilities.name: 胡言乱语 Gibbering
specialAbilities.description: 当咕哝怪能看见任何生物且未陷入失能状态时，它会语无伦次地咕哝。每个在咕哝怪20尺内开始其回合且能听见该胡言乱语的生物必须进行一次DC 10感知豁免。豁免失败则该生物直到其下一回合开始前都不能进行反应，并掷1d8来决定其在该回合会做什么。掷出1至4：该生物什么也不做。掷出5或6：该生物不进行动作或附赠动作，并用尽其全部移动以随机决定的方向移动。掷出7或8：该生物对其触及范围内随机决定的一个生物进行一次近战攻击；若无法进行此类攻击则什么也不做。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 咕哝怪进行一次啃咬攻击，并且若其可以，则使用其致盲唾液。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bites
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+2，触及5尺，单一生物。命中：17（5d6）穿刺伤害。若目标为中型或更小体型，则其必须成功通过一次DC 10力量豁免，否则被击倒（prone）。若目标因该伤害而死亡，则其被吸收进咕哝怪体内。

actions.name: 致盲唾液 Blinding Spittle
actions.description: 咕哝怪向其15尺内可见的一点吐出一团化学黏球。该黏球在撞击时以一道致盲的闪光爆炸。闪光5尺内的每个生物必须进行一次DC 13敏捷豁免，失败则目盲（blinded），直到咕哝怪下一回合结束。

monsters.appearance:
绝对中立的异常生物——惧噬体

这是一团真正的中立异常生物，约有六尺宽的活肉团块，低伏在地面上，犹如一座颤抖的熔化尸体堆。其形体无定形且不断变换，由光滑的、呈黏土色的组织构成，表面闪烁着湿润的油脂光泽。隆起的表面遍布无数张张口——有人类面孔、野兽形态，甚至彻底异形——它们不停低语或咬合着看不见的空气。那些流口水的巨口之间，冒出无眼睑的眼睛，形状大小各异，有的玻璃般失明，有的则在不规则的警觉中快速扫视。

这里没有可辨认的头部或躯干，只有一堆混乱的肉团，仿佛每一张口都在把整体往不同方向拉扯，因而整体摇晃、冲刺。其肉体厚实而有弹性，皱褶如同瘢痕组织，点缀着黏稠液体的气泡。它缓慢爬行时会留下黏滑的痕迹，有时堆体的下缘会伸出短粗的假足——畸形的肢体，伸展、固定并以令人不安的力量拖动整块肉体前进。

整体形象令人毛骨悚然，既非真正的活体也非死亡之物——是一团脉动的破碎解剖结构与疯狂饥渴的混合体，散发出压迫性的疯狂感，使目光接触者本能地退缩。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a true neutral aberration, a disturbing mass of living flesh about six feet across, sprawling low to the ground like a quivering mound of melted bodies. Its form is amorphous and shifting, composed of slick, clay‑colored tissue that glistens with a wet, fatty sheen. Across its bulging surface countless mouths gape and twist—human, beastly, and utterly alien—all of them muttering or gnashing invisible air. Between those drooling maws emerge lidless eyes of varying shapes and sizes, some glassy with blindness, others darting in erratic vigilance.  

There is no recognizable head or torso, only a chaotic heap that lurches and surges as if each mouth pulls the whole form in a different direction. The creature’s flesh appears thick and resilient, wrinkled like scar tissue and speckled with bubbles of viscous fluid. Its slow crawl leaves slimy tracks, and sometimes the mound’s lower edge extrudes stubby pseudopods—misshapen limbs that stretch, anchor, and drag the mass forward with unsettling effort.  

The overall presence feels hideously unnatural—neither truly alive nor dead—a pulsating conglomeration of broken anatomy and deranged hunger, radiating an oppressive sense of madness that makes onlookers instinctively recoil.

monsters.name: 吉斯人
monsters.description: 吉斯人（Gith）是从深渊星界逃离出来的类人生物，曾被强大的古神奴役数千年。成功摆脱束缚后，他们在幽暗的外层位面上建立了自己的帝国，崇尚严苛的秩序与残酷的效率。吉斯人天生对心灵能量敏感，能够在战斗中利用精神力量压制敌人，同时也对星界的魔法具有天然的抵抗力。\n\n作为守序邪恶的种族，吉斯人严格遵从统治者的旨意，任何背离命令的行为都会受到严厉的惩罚。他们常以精锐的剑士和心灵术士的组合组成突击小队，穿梭于星际之间，以快速致命的攻击撕裂敌人的防线。尽管他们的外表与人类相似，却拥有锐利的牙齿、淡蓝色的皮肤以及一双散发幽光的眼睛，令人不寒而栗。

specialAbilities.name: 星界抗性 (Astral Resistance)
specialAbilities.description: 吉斯人对星界能量的魔法拥有优势检定，且对所有法术的豁免检定获得+2加值。

specialAbilities.name: 心灵屏障 (Psionic Shield)
specialAbilities.description: 作为反应，吉斯人在受到攻击时可以花费1点灵能点，使自己的AC暂时提升2点，持续1轮。该能力每日可使用三次。

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 (Innate Spellcasting)
specialAbilities.description: 吉斯人可以使用以下法术，每日各使用一次：1级的『心灵冲击 (Mind Thrust)』和2级的『幻影护盾 (Phantasmal Shield)』。施法时的法术豁免DC为13，+5的施法加值。

actions.name: 银剑攻击 (Silvered Longsword)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+6 命中，射程5尺，一次命中造成1d8+4点挥砍伤害，若目标为非构造体或非恶魔，则额外受到1d6点精神伤害。

actions.name: 心灵冲击 (Psychic Blast)
actions.description: 远程法术攻击（范围15尺锥形）：+5 命中，射程15尺锥形，命中目标受到2d8点精神伤害。目标可进行一次DC 13的感知豁免，成功则伤害减半。此能力为Recharge 5-6。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名守序邪恶的类人生物——吉斯人，身高约六尺，体格瘦削却极具力量感，显露出多年严苛战斗训练的痕迹。其身形紧绷而健美，四肢筋肉匀称，动作精准且受控。皮肤呈苍白的冷蓝色，光滑且带有淡淡的金属光泽，紧贴在突出的骨骼上。面容修长而棱角分明，颚线狭窄，颧骨锐利。薄薄的唇线向后收拢，露出略带锯齿的捕食者般牙齿。

其眼睛又大又呈杏仁形，散发出幽幽的幽光——冷漠而算计，绝非诱人，位于有棱纹的眉毛之下，眉头永远紧锁成皱眉的表情。耳朵拉长并向后倾斜，几近精灵之形，却更为硬朗。手指细长而骨感，指尖是钝而坚硬的指甲，足以精准握住剑柄。

姿态僵硬而严谨，肩背挺直，头颅抬高，散发出威胁的气场与绝对的控制感。每一次动作都刻意而有目的，尽量减少无用的动作。整体氛围紧张且危险，仿佛随时准备以毫不留情的效率击倒敌人。它的存在带有压迫感，使周围的空气沉重，战斗不可避免。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil humanoid, a Gith, standing approximately six feet tall with a lean yet powerfully muscular frame that speaks of years of disciplined combat training. Its build is taut and athletic, with sinewy arms and legs that move with precise, controlled agility. The skin is a pale, cold blue, smooth with a faint, almost metallic sheen, stretched tightly over prominent bones. The face is long and angular, with a narrow jawline and sharp cheekbones. Thin lips pull back to reveal slightly serrated, predatory teeth.  

Its eyes are large, almond-shaped, glowing with a dim, ghostly light—cold and calculating rather than inviting—set beneath a ridged brow that furrows into a perpetual scowl. The ears are elongated and swept back, almost elven but harsher in contour. Fingers are long and bony, tipped with blunt but hardened nails, capable of precision grip on a sword hilt.  

Posture is rigid and disciplined, shoulders back, head high, projecting an aura of menace and absolute control. Every movement is deliberate, minimizing wasted motion. The overall atmosphere is tense and dangerous, as if the creature is seconds away from striking down a foe with merciless efficiency. Its presence feels oppressive, the kind that makes the air around it heavy and battles inevitable.

monsters.name: 吉斯洋基
monsters.description: 吉斯洋基（Githyanki）是来自星界的战斗种族，外表似人却拥有锐利的牙齿和锐利的精神力。他们在星界的漂浮城堡中成长，以对抗永恒的星界巨龙和其他星界威胁为生。吉斯人对时间和空间有独特的感知，常利用星界之门进行突袭，掠夺其他平面的资源。\n\n在物质界，吉斯洋基常以雇佣兵或盗贼的身份出现，凭借其卓越的剑术和心灵能力，在黑暗的城镇和古老的废墟中散布恐怖。他们遵循严格的等级制度，忠诚于强大的领袖和对星界的永恒誓约，因而被视为守序邪恶的典型代表。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 对抗法术和其他魔法效果的豁免检定拥有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 精神感知 Psionic Awareness
specialAbilities.description: 对任何感官范围内的心灵活动（如心灵感应或精神探测）拥有优势的感知检定。

actions.name: 光剑攻击 Silver Sword Attack
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+5 命中，触及 5 尺，单一目标。命中时造成 1d8+3 点挥砍伤害。若目标是非星界生物，还会额外受到 1d6 点精神伤害。

actions.name: 心灵冲击 Mind Blast
actions.description: 远程精神攻击（冲击），30 尺范围，锥形 15 尺。目标必须进行 DC 13 智力豁免，失败则受到 2d8 点精神伤害并在 1 轮内陷入眩晕，成功则只受到一半伤害且不眩晕。此能力每 5-6 回合可使用一次。

monsters.appearance:
这是一位守序邪恶的吉斯族类人，身高约六尺，体态瘦削却肌肉发达，显露出多年严苛战斗训练的痕迹。四肢修长而纤细，紧绷的黄绿皮肤下的肌肉如同经火锻造的绳索，随时准备发起攻击。皮肤带有淡淡的金属光泽，仿佛被星光轻拂，散发出与其星界起源相呼应的异世气息。

其面容狭长而棱角分明，高颧骨、锐利的下颚线以及薄而无唇的嘴巴，在低吼时会露出细小而尖锐的牙齿。眼眸深陷，呈淡银或琥珀色，闪烁着冷峻的智慧与精算的专注。鼻梁扁平，近似爬行动物的形态，耳朵向尖端收拢，暗示其遥远的位面血统。稀疏的淡白或灰烬色发束直垂或被紧束，凸显出纪律与控制。

它身着合体的深红与黑色战甲，皮甲与轻金属板交织，手执一把镀银的巨剑，剑身刻有符文。站姿笔直而精准，每一个动作都经过深思熟虑且高效。时而有微弱的心灵能量光辉在其头部荡漾，暗示其头脑既强大又危险。整体气场如同一名沉默、冷酷的战士，忠诚于残忍而不可动摇的秩序。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil humanoid of the gith race, standing around six feet tall with a lean yet muscular build that speaks of years of disciplined combat training. Its limbs are long and wiry, the muscles under its taut yellow-green skin coiled like tempered cords ready to strike. The skin has a faint metallic sheen, as if brushed by starlight, giving it an otherworldly touch reminiscent of its astral origin. 

The creature’s face is long and angular, with high cheekbones, a sharp jawline, and thin, lipless mouth revealing small, pointed teeth when it snarls. Its eyes are deep-set, pale silver or amber, glimmering with cold intelligence and a calculating focus. The nose is flat, almost reptilian, and the ears taper to fine points that hint at its distant planar ancestry. Sparse tendrils of pale white or ash-colored hair hang straight or are bound tightly, emphasizing discipline and control. 

Clad in fitted, crimson and black battle gear of leather and light metal plates, it grips a silvered greatsword etched with runes. Its stance is upright and precise, every motion deliberate and efficient. A faint shimmer of psychic energy occasionally dances around its head, suggesting a mind both powerful and dangerous. The overall presence is that of a silent, ruthless warrior devoted to a cruel, unbending order.

monsters.appearance:
这是一具纪律严明且守序中立的类人形生物。它约有六尺高，身形既纤细又强壮，每块肌肉都因多年苦行训练而清晰可见。四肢修长且均衡，适合快速而精准的动作，而非单纯的蛮力，给人一种克制的力量感。皮肤呈暗淡的黄灰色，紧绷地覆盖在致密的肌肉与骨骼之上，带有淡淡的皮革质感，暗示其坚韧与耐久。前臂和颈部的血管与腱线清晰可见，彰显出活力与自制。

其头部棱角分明，颅骨略为拉长，颧骨高耸而锐利。眼睛虽小却炯炯有神，微微散发出琥珀色的光辉，似乎在计算而非情感流露。嘴唇薄而紧闭，常保持中性线条，牙齿小而整齐。光秃的头皮突显其苦行的气质，头侧有淡淡的脊状突起，暗示其外星血统。

它身着简洁、贴身的服装——暗灰色和赭色调的长袍或裹身衣——便于自由活动。姿态端正而沉稳，只有在迅捷而有意的手势时才会打破那种经过深思熟虑的静止。其周围的空气显得受控而紧绷，仿佛仅凭它的意志便能在周遭强加完美的秩序。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a disciplined and lawful neutral humanoid. It stands around six feet tall, with a frame both sinewy and powerful, every muscle defined by years of ascetic training. Its limbs are long and balanced, built for quick and precise motion rather than brute bulk, giving it an impression of restrained power. The skin is a muted yellow-gray, stretched tightly over dense muscle and bone, with a faint leathery texture that suggests toughness and endurance. Veins and tendon lines are visible along its forearms and neck, speaking of both vitality and control.  

The creature’s head is angular, the skull slightly elongated, cheekbones high and sharp. Its eyes are small but piercing, glowing faintly with an amber hue that seems calculating rather than emotive. The mouth is thin-lipped, often pressed into a neutral line, with teeth small and even. A bald scalp accentuates its ascetic demeanor, while faint ridges run along the sides of its head, hinting at its alien heritage.  

It wears simple, close-fitting garments—robes or wraps of muted gray and ochre tones—that allow free movement. Its posture is upright and composed, a studied stillness broken only by swift, deliberate gestures. The air around it feels controlled and tense, as though the creature’s will alone enforces perfect order in its surroundings.

monsters.appearance:
这是一名守序中立的类人，称为吉斯泽莱武僧。它约有六尺高，身形瘦削而结实，所有肌肉在紧绷、带有琥珀色光泽的皮肤下都清晰可见。皮肤略带粗糙感，仿佛是严格纪律与苦行锻造出的坚韧活力。其体格虽具运动员般的力量，却又显得轻盈——手臂修长，动作精准；双腿平衡有力，随时可以在瞬间出击或闪避。

面容狭长而棱角分明，高颧骨与修长的禁欲式下巴相得益彰。黄绿相间的眼睛闪烁着警觉的智慧，瞳孔锐利且不断移动，仿佛在衡量周围的每一个举动。额头正中有一道细细的脊线，暗示其异界血脉。头部全秃，颞部与颈项上隐约可见伤疤或仪式纹饰的痕迹。

它的姿态控制自如、挺拔端正，透露出坚定不移的专注。所穿的长袍为低调的灰色与暗金色，裁剪简洁，以便行动自如而非装饰。双手赤裸，指关节因无数小时的严苛训练而略显硬化。整体而言，吉斯泽莱武僧的气场宁静却充满威胁——沉默、警觉，随时准备以熟练的精准发动致命一击。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful neutral humanoid known as a Githzerai Monk. It stands about six feet tall, lean and wiry, every muscle sharply defined beneath taut, amber-tinted skin. The texture of its skin is slightly coarse, giving the sense of durable vitality born from strict discipline and austerity. Its build is athletic yet spare—arms long and precise in their movements, legs balanced and ready to strike or evade in a fluid instant.  

The face is narrow and angular, with high cheekbones and a long, ascetic jaw. Yellow-green eyes gleam with alert intelligence, pupils sharp and constantly shifting as though measuring every gesture around it. A thin ridge runs down the center of its forehead, a subtle mark of its otherworldly heritage. Its head is completely bald, with faint patterns of scars or ritual markings tracing along the temples and neck.  

The creature’s posture is controlled and upright, suggesting unwavering focus. It wears simple robes of muted gray and dull gold, fitted for ease of motion rather than decoration. Its hands are bare, the knuckles faintly hardened from countless hours of disciplined training. The overall presence of the Githzerai Monk is calm yet dangerous—silent, watchful, and ready to strike with practiced precision.

monsters.name: 豺狼人
monsters.description:
豺狼人（Gnoll）是凶残的类人生物，居住在荒野、废墟与洞穴中，常以掠夺和残暴的仪式为生。它们体型中等，外形似人类却拥有凶猛的犬齿、粗壮的四肢和覆满粗糙皮毛的身躯。豺狼人崇拜强力的血神，常在猎杀后进行血祭，以此来取悦其神祇并获得短暂的狂暴力量。它们组成松散的部族，靠捕猎大型猎物和抢劫旅行者维生，行事极为残忍且毫无顾忌。

在战斗中，豺狼人依赖其敏锐的嗅觉和团队协作来压制对手。它们常在夜幕中潜伏，利用黑暗视力和对气味的敏锐感知，快速锁定猎物。若有同伴在侧，豺狼人会利用“团队协作（Pack Tactics）”获得攻击优势，并在击倒敌人后立刻发动冲撞，继续对残余的敌人进行撕咬。它们的野性与凶残使得即使是低级的冒险者也必须保持警惕。

specialAbilities.name: 嗅觉灵敏 (Keen Smell)
specialAbilities.description: 豺狼人对气味异常敏感，拥有对依赖嗅觉的感知检定的优势。

specialAbilities.name: 团队协作 (Pack Tactics)
specialAbilities.description: 只要有至少一个同类在目标 5 尺范围内，豺狼人对该目标的攻击检定拥有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 凶残冲撞 (Rampage)
specialAbilities.description: 当豺狼人将一名生物击至 0 生命值时，它可以使用其奖励动作向任意方向移动最多其速度的一半，并进行一次咬合攻击。

actions.name: 咬合 (Bite)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4 命中，范围 5 尺，一名目标。命中时造成 4 (1d4+2) 穿刺伤害。

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: 长矛/短剑 (Morningstar)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4 命中，范围 5 尺，一名目标。命中时造成 5 (1d6+2) 穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱邪恶的类人生形，身高约六尺的豺狼人。它的体格纤细却极度结实，四肢修长，专为快速移动和凶猛搏斗而生。毛皮粗糙且斑驳，呈深棕与赭黄相间的色块，沾满污垢与干涸的血迹。厚实的肌肉绳索在皮毛下起伏，营造出原始野兽般的力量感。

它的头颅如同被残忍扭曲的鬣狗——宽阔的口鼻部、张开的鼻孔以及排列成锯齿状的黄牙在龟裂的唇下闪烁。眼睛小而琥珀，闪烁着野兽的狡黠而非理性的光芒，呈现出空洞而捕食性的凝视。耳朵尖锐且不断抽动，随时捕捉最微弱的声响。豺狼人的手指细长且带爪，适合紧握武器或撕裂血肉；其趾行的腿部使其呈现出弓背却弹性的姿势，随时准备冲刺。

全身悬挂着粗制的战利品——骨骼、割下的耳朵以及用肮脏绳索系在一起的金属碎片。它的姿态充满攻击性，肩膀前倾、头低垂，散发出紧绷的野性气息。其周围的氛围令人作呕且充满威胁，仿佛暴力的腥臭附着在毛皮上，毫无疑问地标记出它是一只为混沌与屠戮而生的生物。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil humanoid, a gnoll standing around six feet tall. Its frame is lean yet powerfully muscular, with long limbs adapted for swift movement and savage combat. The creature’s fur is coarse and patchy, mottled in shades of dark brown and ochre, streaked with grime and dried blood. Thick cords of muscle ripple beneath the hide, creating an impression of raw feral strength.

Its head resembles that of a hyena twisted by cruelty—broad muzzle, flaring nostrils, and rows of jagged yellow teeth gleaming beneath cracked lips. The eyes are small, amber, and glint with bestial cunning rather than true thought, giving it a hollow, predatory stare. Its ears are pointed and constantly twitch, alert to the faintest sound. The gnoll’s hands end in long, clawed fingers suited for gripping weapons or tearing flesh, while its digitigrade legs give it a hunched but springy stance, ready to lunge.

Across its body hang crude trophies—bones, severed ears, and scraps of metal plates tied together with filthy cords. Its posture is aggressive, shoulders forward and head low, exuding a tense, wild energy. The atmosphere around it is repulsive and menacing, as if violence clings to its fur like a stench, marking it unmistakably as a creature born for chaos and slaughter.

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱邪恶的类人形——豺狼人首领，身高约六尺，拥有掠食兽类的瘦削而结实的体格。全身覆以粗糙、斑驳的皮毛，颜色从污黄到斑驳的深棕不等，局部聚集着干涸的血迹与污垢。厚实的肩膀和修长的筋肉臂膀勾勒出强大的轮廓，每只手都宽阔异常，指尖长着弯曲的黑色爪子，专用于撕裂血肉。它的防具是一件破损的链甲衬衣，金属暗淡且染污，松垮地挂在胸腹之间。

这头狼形头颅突出的口鼻部布满锯齿状的黄牙，嘴唇始终向后撅起，露出怒吼的笑容。眼中闪烁着残忍的智慧——野性黄瞳映射出捕猎的狡诈。鼻梁与颈部交错着破烂的伤疤，都是昔日战斗的战利品。它的四肢修长，趾行结构专为速度与追踪而生，爪足似乎永远半蹲，随时准备发动致命一击。短而竖毛的尾巴在激动时不停抽动。

豺狼人首领的姿态凶猛而有序，每一次动作都迅捷且刻意。它散发出凶残的支配与残忍光环，毫无疑问是那位经验老练的杀手，领衔猎群的存在。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil humanoid—a gnoll pack lord, towering around six feet tall with the lean, muscular frame of a predatory beast. Its body is covered in coarse, mottled fur ranging from dirty ochre to patchy dark brown, clumped in places with dried blood and grime. Thick shoulders and long, sinewy arms give it a powerful silhouette, each arm ending in broad hands tipped with curved black claws meant for tearing flesh. Its armor is a battered chain shirt, the metal dulled and stained, hanging loosely over its chest and belly.

The creature’s lupine head features a protruding muzzle filled with jagged yellow fangs, its lips constantly pulled back in a snarling grin. Its eyes gleam with cruel intelligence—feral yellow irises reflecting a predatory cunning. Ragged scars crisscross its snout and neck, trophies of past battles. Its legs are long and digitigrade, built for speed and pursuit, ending in clawed feet that seem perpetually half-crouched as if ready to strike. A short, bristling tail flicks behind it in agitation.

The gnoll’s posture is aggressive yet coordinated, every motion quick and deliberate. It radiates a savage aura of dominance and cruelty, the unmistakable presence of a seasoned killer leading the hunt.

monsters.name: 豺狼人·耶诺古毒牙
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10
monsters.description:
豺狼人主持恶魔仪式来庆祝胜利, 并为耶诺古献祭鲜血。恶魔领主有时也会奖励这些崇拜者, 以让其中一名被恶魔的精魄附身。这名被标记为耶诺古宠儿的豺狼人将幸运的被选为耶诺古毒牙,豺狼人领主的选民。耶诺古毒牙所杀死的敌人喂食给普通鬣狗时, 被喂食者便会如同耶诺古所制造的第一批豺狼人一样, 在经历一场可怕转变之后彻底成长为一名成年豺狼人。根据军团中鬣狗的多寡,耶诺古毒牙可能会使其豺狼人同胞的数量急剧增长。 而设法找到并杀死这些毒牙是控制豺狼人人口的唯一方法。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混沌邪恶的类人生物豺狼人，身高约六尺，拥有被扭曲目的所驱使的野兽体格。它的身体结实有力——宽阔的肩膀、筋肉发达的手臂，以及为奔跑与冲刺而弯曲的双腿。全身覆以粗糙、斑驳的皮毛，呈病态的土黄、灰色与棕色交织，暗色斑块仿佛干涸的血迹与污垢。它的护甲由粗糙缝合的兽皮和皮革碎片拼凑而成，挂在身上如同从受害者身上夺取的战利品。

豺狼人的面容像是一只巨大的、鬃毛蓬乱的鬣狗，伸展在类人骷髅之上——细长的口鼻、锯齿状的黄牙，以及永远绷紧、似在低吼的嘴唇。其双眼闪烁着饥饿而空洞的光辉，宛如在被撕碎前所见的深渊。它的手臂与下颚线上布满淡淡的伤痕与仪式刻纹，呈现耶诺古的邪魔符印，渗出黏稠的黑色血清。

它的爪子粗壮如刀，双手绷紧，仿佛随时准备致命一击。尽管体型庞大，豺狼人仍以灵活的速度移动，姿态蹲伏且充满捕食者的凶狠。一股混沌而野性的气息环绕其身——血腥的恶臭、期待的抽搐、以及只为狩猎、屠戮与吞噬而活的病态兴奋。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil humanoid gnoll, roughly six feet tall, with the feral physique of a beast given twisted purpose. Its body is powerfully built — broad shoulders, sinewy arms, and legs bent for both running and lunging. The creature’s frame is covered in coarse, mottled fur, a sickly mix of ochre, gray, and brown streaked with darker patches that hint at dried blood and filth. Its armor consists of crudely stitched hides and leather scraps, hanging from its body like trophies taken from victims.  

The gnoll’s face resembles a massive, maned hyena stretched over a humanoid skull — long muzzle, jagged yellow fangs, and lips that peel back in constant snarls. Its eyes gleam with a hungry, hollow intensity, the kind of void one sees before being torn apart. Across its arms and jawline are faint scars and ritual carvings shaped like infernal sigils of Yeenoghu, oozing black ichor.  

Its claws are thick and knife-like, hands tense as if seconds away from a killing strike. The gnoll moves with wiry quickness despite its bulk, its posture crouched and predatory. A chaotic, feral aura surrounds it — the stench of blood, the twitch of anticipation, the sick excitement of a creature that lives only to hunt, kill, and feed.

monsters.name: 侏儒
monsters.nameEn: Gnome,地底侏儒 Deep (斯涅布力 Svirfneblin)
monsters.alignment: 部分斯涅布力甚至可以召唤这些生物以寻求协助。土源生物时常帮助斯涅布力守护聚居地
languages: 地底通用语挑战等级:1/2 (100 XP)
monsters.description:
侏儒（Gnome, Deep，亦称斯涅布力 Svirfneblin）是居住在地下深处的矮小种族，身形约为三尺，皮肤呈灰褐色，常被岩石的尘埃染成暗淡的色调。他们擅长在狭窄的岩洞和矿脉中生存，凭借对石质环境的天生适应与隐匿技巧，几乎可以在任何岩石表面消失无踪。斯涅布力的社会结构以氏族为单位，成员之间相互扶持，面对外来侵扰时会召集土源生物（如岩元素、土精）共同防御，守护他们的洞穴城邦。

斯涅布力性格谨慎且多疑，极少与地表种族交往，但在需要时他们会利用自身的魔法抗性与先天施法帮助盟友。传说中，最古老的斯涅布力能够在黑暗的深渊中看见光的微光，并以此引导同伴避开致命的陷阱与敌人的法术。尽管他们的战斗力不强，却以巧妙的偷袭、对环境的利用以及对法术的天然抵抗而著称，使得任何敢闯入其领地的冒险者都必须小心翼翼。

specialAbilities.name: 洞悉隐匿 (Stone Camouflage)
specialAbilities.description: 当斯涅布力在岩石或矿石环境中进行潜行时，拥有优势检定。若完全隐藏在岩石中，任何生物在未进行感知（察觉）检定前均无法发现其所在位置。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 (Magic Resistance)
specialAbilities.description: 对所有法术检定拥有优势。斯涅布力对魔法的天然抵抗使其在面对施法者时更具生存能力。

specialAbilities.name: 卓越暗视 (Superior Darkvision)
specialAbilities.description: 在完全黑暗中拥有 120 英尺的暗视距离，能够以黑白两色辨识物体。

specialAbilities.name: 先天施法 (Innate Spellcasting)
specialAbilities.description: 斯涅布力可以无消耗地使用以下法术：每天 1 次盲聋术 (Blindness/Deafness)（3 级），每天 1 次扩大/缩小术 (Enlarge/Reduce)（2 级），以及随时使用幻象术 (Minor Illusion)（1 级）作为戏法。

actions.name: 短剑 (Dagger)
actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击：+4 命中，射程 20/60 ft。命中时造成 1d4+2 穿刺伤害。若使用暗光或岩石环境进行偷袭，可获得额外 1d6 暗影伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立的地下类人种，俗称深矮人或潜岩精灵。身高约三尺半，拥有为地下生活的艰苦环境而锻造的结实紧凑体格。其皮肤呈粗糙的花岗岩灰色，斑驳着淡淡的棕色和灰烬色斑块，仿佛直接从周围的岩石中雕刻而出。粗壮的肌肉塑造了手臂和腿部，展现出与其矮小身躯不相称的力量；动作低沉而紧绷——既沉着克制，又足够敏捷，能够在锯齿状的岩石和狭窄的通道间穿梭自如。

面容小巧而锋利：短鼻、突出的颧骨以及紧绷的薄唇，透露出专注的神情。抛光的黑曜石般的眼睛闪烁着警觉的智慧，像黑色水晶碎片般在昏暗光线中反射光辉。稀疏而粗糙的发丝或胡茬覆盖头皮，呈尘土般的银灰色。双手老茧厚实却灵巧，指尖能够熟练操作石制工具或施展细微的土系法术手势。其姿态始终保持防御或后撤的准备，显示出久经警戒的习性。整体印象是一种静默的韧性——一位警惕且岩肤的生存者，仿佛与洞穴的阴影融为一体。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral subterranean humanoid, known as a deep gnome or svirfneblin. Standing about three and a half feet tall, it possesses a sturdy, compact frame built for the rigors of life beneath the earth. The creature’s skin is a rough, granite-gray tone mottled with faint brown and ashen patches, giving the impression that it has been carved directly from the surrounding rock. Thick muscles shape its arms and legs, showing a strength unexpected for its small stature, while its movements are low and taut—quietly deliberate, yet quick enough to slip between jagged stones and narrow tunnels.

Its face bears small, sharp features: a short nose, pronounced cheekbones, and thin lips drawn tight in concentration. Eyes of polished obsidian gleam with alert intelligence, reflecting the dim light like shards of black crystal. Sparse, coarse hair or stubble covers its scalp, dusty silver-gray in hue. The hands are calloused and dexterous, fingers capable of deftly working stone tools or weaving subtle earth-magic gestures. Its posture is constantly poised to dodge or retreat, the bearing of one accustomed to vigilance. The overall impression is one of quiet resilience—a wary, mineral-skinned survivor who seems to merge seamlessly with the cavern shadows.

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的哥布林类类人形生物。它的身高约为三尺半，体格瘦削，肌肉紧实且反射敏捷。皮肤呈斑驳的绿褐色，粗糙且略带油光，能够轻易地融入阴影或灌木中。肩部狭窄、手臂细长而有力，使其呈现出弓背的捕食者姿态；其动作迅捷而精准，更多依赖敏捷而非蛮力。

这只哥布林的面容尖锐且似狐，扁平的鼻梁、向后倾斜的尖耳以及闪烁着警觉狡黠光芒的黄眼。它的牙齿虽小却锯齿状，笑或咆哮时会闪现出来。稀疏的粗黑发附着在头皮上，常被束起或沾满泥土。它身披拼接而成的皮甲，虽粗糙缝合，却实用且贴身，便于无声行动。

它的手指又长又灵巧，指尖是钝而坚固的指甲；双脚纤细，适合在崎岖地形上灵活移动。它的姿态紧绷且略呈蹲伏，仿佛随时准备出击或瞬间撤退。一股恶意与不安的活力环绕其身——虽算小型威胁，却始终潜伏在火把光芒的边缘，随时构成危险。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil humanoid of the goblinoid kind. The creature stands about three and a half feet tall, its wiry frame balanced between lean muscle and quick reflexes. Its skin is a mottled greenish-brown, rough and slightly oily, blending easily into shadow or brush. Narrow shoulders and long, sinewy arms give it a hunched, predatory silhouette, while its movements carry a quick, darting precision born of agility rather than brute force.  

The goblin’s face is sharp and foxlike, with a flat nose, pointed ears that angle backward, and yellow eyes that glimmer with alert cunning. Its teeth, small but jagged, flash when it grins or snarls. A patchy scattering of coarse black hair clings to its scalp, often tied or matted with dirt. It wears a patchwork of leather armor pieces, crudely stitched together but functional, fitting close to the body to allow silent motion.  

Its fingers are long and deft, tipped with blunt but sturdy nails, and its feet are narrow, built for nimble movement across uneven terrain. The goblin’s stance is tense and slightly crouched, as if ready to strike or flee in an instant. An air of malice and restless energy surrounds it—a minor but ever-present menace lurking at the edge of torchlight.

monsters.appearance:
怪物名称：地精头目  

这是一只中立邪恶的哥布林类类人，身高约三尺半，体格纤细却结实。它的身体紧凑而瘦削，兼具速度与耐力。皮肤呈暗绿棕色，斑驳着因久经污垢与战斗留下的深色斑块，质感如同老化的皮革。四肢相对修长，指尖灵活，爪形指甲短小，似乎专为握持武器或攀爬崎岖地形而生。

地精的面容尖锐而狡黠——狭长的黄眼炯炯有神，警觉地在四周来回扫视。扁平的鼻子位于一口不整齐、尖锐的牙齿之上，牙齿上常有污渍或缺口，显露出艰苦的生活痕迹。宽大的蝙蝠状耳朵从头部两侧展开，对微弱的声音也会抽动。稀疏的黑发被束成油腻的绺或粗糙的辫子，常挂有从倒下的敌人身上抢来的骨制或金属小饰品。

它身披拼凑而来的废旧皮甲和锈蚀的护甲碎片，姿态中透露出指挥般的傲慢——胸膛鼓起，下巴抬高。尽管身形矮小，却散发出一股威胁的气场——这是一只因残忍与狡诈而硬化的生物，随时准备以迅捷而精准的方式发动攻击或下达命令。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil humanoid of the goblinoid kind, standing about three and a half feet tall with a wiry but well-toned build. Its body is compact and lean, shaped for both speed and endurance. The creature’s skin is a dull greenish-brown, mottled with darker patches from old grime and battle scars, giving it a leathery, weathered texture. Its limbs are proportionally long, ending in nimble fingers and small clawed nails that look suited for gripping weapons or scaling rough terrain.  

The goblin’s face is sharp and cunning—its narrow yellow eyes gleam with alertness, constantly flicking around its surroundings. A flat nose sits above a mouth of uneven, pointed teeth, some stained or chipped from hard living. Its large, batlike ears fan out from the sides of its head, twitching at faint sounds. Sparse black hair is tied into greasy tufts or crudely knotted braids, often adorned with bone or metal trinkets looted from fallen foes.  

Dressed in mismatched bits of scavenged leather and rusted armor plates, the goblin boss carries itself with a posture of commanding arrogance, chest puffed and chin lifted. Despite its small stature, an aura of menace surrounds it—a creature hardened by brutal cunning, ready to strike or command with swift precision.

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立的构装体，一尊约十尺高的巨大粘土魔像，由致密、经魔法硬化的土石构成。它的身体像是一座被赋予生命的粗糙雕像——层层古老黏土塑成的高大类人生形，在巨大的力量在表层下蠢蠢欲动时出现裂纹与碎屑。厚重如石的肌肉凸起在胸膛和手臂上，轮廓粗糙不平，给人一种野蛮力量而非优雅的印象。尽管体形庞大，它的动作却带有诡异的流畅感，仿佛关节能够随突发的速度而转移、重塑。

魔像的表面布满暗淡的赭黄与灰色条纹，斑驳的深色斑块犹如烤制过的黏土或古老仪式留下的焦痕。它的面孔粗糙而令人不安——一张光滑、无特征的面具，只有淡淡的凹陷暗示眼位，微微发出琥珀色的内光，像余烬般闪烁。嘴部不过是一条裂开的细缝，破碎且锯齿状，偶尔张开时会发出低沉的研磨声，犹如土壤在移动。

每只手都以粗壮、钝圆的指头收尾，适合碾碎而非抓握；它的站姿沉重如同随时可能倾倒的雕像，却永不倒塌。一层淡淡的威胁光环环绕其身，默默承诺着由被遗忘的魔法驱动的不可阻挡的力量。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct, a large clay golem standing roughly ten feet tall and built from dense, magically hardened earth. Its body resembles a rough-hewn statue brought to life—a towering humanoid form molded from layers of ancient clay that crack and flake where immense power strains beneath the surface. Thick, stone-like muscles bulge across its chest and arms, their contours coarse and uneven, giving the impression of brutal strength rather than grace. Despite its massive frame, its movements carry an eerie fluidity, as if its joints shift and reshape to accommodate sudden bursts of speed.  

The golem’s surface bears streaks of dull ochre and gray, mottled with darker patches that suggest baked clay or scorch marks from ancient rites. Its face is crude yet haunting—a smooth, featureless mask with faint indentations where eyes should be, glowing dimly with an inner amber light that flickers like embers. The mouth is little more than a slit, cracked and jagged, occasionally opening to emit a low grinding sound of shifting earth.  

Each hand ends in thick, blunt fingers perfect for crushing rather than grasping, and its stance looms heavy, like a statue moments from toppling but never falling. A faint aura of menace clings to it, a silent promise of unstoppable force animated by forgotten magic.

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立构装体，既非善良亦非邪恶，由生肉与魔法结合而成的人工造物。它约六英尺高，拥有由不匹配的身体部位以粗黑缝线缝合而成的人形外壳。其体格异常健壮——绳索般的手臂、宽阔的肩膀、如石般的肌肉在参差不齐的皮肤下起伏，有的部位苍白且蜡质，有的则呈灰色或带有腐烂的绿意。表面在某些部位闪烁着淡淡的油光，胸膛和四肢遍布粗糙的伤疤。

其面容粗糙而令人不安——浓重的眉毛遮蔽着毫无生气、玻璃般的眼睛，微弱的烛光在其中轻轻反射。鼻子似乎是从另一具尸体上缝上来的，宽大的嘴巴露出参差不齐、变色的牙齿。头皮上零星的发束从斑驳的部位冒出，呈现出支离破碎、近乎怪诞的人形外观。

粗壮的手指以钝而污浊的指甲收尾；它的手部动作出奇地精准，既显示出强大的力量，又流畅如行云。姿态高挑却略微驼背，仿佛在抵抗无形的压力。尽管目光中带着沉默的中立，却笼罩着一股威胁的气场与不安的力量——如同风暴即将爆发，等待指令释放其残暴之力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct, neither good nor evil, an artificial being built from raw flesh and bound together by magic. Standing around six feet tall, it has the imposing frame of a human forged from mismatched body parts sewn with thick black sutures. Its physique is unnaturally muscular—corded arms, broad shoulders, and stone‑like muscles ripple beneath its uneven skin, some sections pale and waxy, others gray or greenish with decay. The surface glistens in places with a faint oily sheen, while rough scars crisscross its chest and limbs.  

Its face is crude and unsettling—a heavy brow shadowing lifeless, glassy eyes that faintly reflect candlelight. The nose appears stitched on from another corpse, and its wide mouth exposes uneven, discolored teeth. Stray tufts of hair sprout from patches across its scalp, giving it a disjointed, almost grotesque semblance of humanity.  

Thick fingers end in blunt, dirty nails; the creature’s hands flex with disconcerting precision, suggesting both strength and fluid movement. Its posture is tall but slightly hunched, as though resisting invisible strain. Despite the silent neutrality in its gaze, an aura of menace and restless power surrounds it—like a storm barely held in check, waiting for a command to unleash its brutal might.

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立的构造体，没有阵营。它身高近十英尺，铁魔像如同实体化的堡垒——一个由光亮金属板锻造而成的庞大类人生物，每个关节都精工细作，却被数世纪的战斗所划伤。它的骨架异常庞大，肩宽堪比战马的全身，手臂呈锤头状，金属肌腱在交叠的护板下鼓胀突起。其躯体表面散发暗淡的铁光，因氧化而风化，并带有煤黑色的锈斑，宛如活化的古代盔甲。

它的头部由一整块头盔铸成，只有一道狭窄的裂口透出微弱的猩红光芒，成为这死寂核心中唯一的活动痕迹。面孔毫无表情——仅是一张被无数次敲击与凹陷的铁面具。它的指头粗钝沉重，专为粉碎岩石而非精细动作而生。

魔像每迈出一步，地面便发出嘎吱声，蒸汽或淡淡的炼金烟雾从肩部和膝盖的通风口升起。尽管重量沉重，它却以令人不安的精准移动，每一个动作都刻意而不可阻挡。其周围的空气微微嗡鸣着奥术能量，警示众人这座金属巨兽中蕴藏的不可阻挡之力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct with no alignment. Standing nearly ten feet tall, the iron golem looms like a fortress given form—an immense humanoid forged from burnished metal plates, each joint crafted with precision yet scarred by centuries of battle. Its frame is massively built, with shoulders as broad as a warhorse’s length and arms shaped like hammerheads, cords of metal muscle bulging beneath overlapping plates. The surface of its body glints with a dull iron sheen, weathered by oxidation and streaked with soot-black patina, giving it the look of ancient armor come to life.  

Its head is shaped from a solid helm, with a narrow slit where faint crimson light glows, the only trace of motion within its lifeless core. The face bears no expression—just a blank mask of iron, beaten and dented by countless blows. Its fingers end in blunt, heavy digits made for crushing stone rather than delicate movement. Each step of the golem rattles the ground, steam or faint alchemical fumes rising through vents along its shoulders and knees. Despite its ponderous weight, it moves with unsettling precision, every motion deliberate and unstoppable. The air around it hums faintly with arcane energy, warning all of the unstoppable force bound within this metallic juggernaut.

actions.description: 魔像以其为中心10尺内其能看见的一个或多个生物为目标。每个目标必须对抗此魔法进行一次DC 17的感知豁免。豁免失败时，目标不能使用反应，其速度减半，且其在自己的回合中不能进行超过一次攻击。此外，目标在其回合中只能进行一个动作或一个附赠动作，不能两者都进行。这些效果持续1分钟。目标可以在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，豁免成功则结束其自身所受影响。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立构造体，既非善亦非恶。石魔像约有十尺高，庞大的身躯由暗色花岗岩与纹理大理石雕凿而成。其体格宽阔而威严，肩部如悬崖岩石的巨板，手臂粗如树干，胸部与四肢覆以层叠的板块，形似强壮的肌肉。全身表面留有粗糙的凿痕和风化的裂缝，仿佛古代工匠之手的杰作。裂缝中隐约有符文微微发光，柔和的金光如同由大地本身锻造的机器的缓慢心跳般脉动。

其面孔残忍且毫无特征，唯有两只空洞的眼窝被暗金光点亮。表情永不改变，既不流露情感也不显思考——只有不懈的目的。嘴部是一条雕刻的凹槽，始终封闭。指头沉重，末端是钝石尖，可轻易碾碎金属。双腿如粗壮的支柱，稳固而坚实，每一步都轻微震动地面，尘土随之在其脚下升起。

尽管形体僵硬，细微的精准却定义了它的动作，暗示出一种受控且不屈的优雅。石魔像的存在感古老而令人恐惧，宛如一位不可征服的守卫，专为经受岁月的围攻与悲伤而雕刻。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct, neither good nor evil. The stone golem stands about ten feet tall, its massive body carved from dark granite and vein-streaked marble. Its proportions are broad and imposing, shoulders like slabs of cliff rock, arms as thick as tree trunks, and layered plates across its chest and limbs shaped to mimic powerful muscles. The surface of its body bears rough chisel marks and weathered cracks, as if formed by ancient artisans’ hands. Faint runes glow softly within those crevices, pulsing like the slow heartbeat of a machine made from earth itself.  

Its face is brutal and featureless except for two hollow sockets lit by dim golden light. The expression never changes, conveying neither emotion nor thought—only relentless purpose. Its mouth is a carved groove, sealed shut. The creature’s fingers are heavy, ending in blunt stone points capable of crushing metal. Its legs are thick pillars braced for stability, each step shaking the ground slightly as dust rises around its feet.  

Despite its rigid form, subtle precision defines its movements, suggesting a controlled, unyielding grace. The golem’s presence feels ancient and dreadful, an indomitable guardian sculpted to endure ages of siege and sorrow.

monsters.name: 石化牛
monsters.description:
石化牛（Gorgon）是一种古老的金属野兽，常栖息在荒凉的山谷和废弃的矿坑中。它们的身体覆满灰黑色的铁鳞，犹如活生生的活塞与钢铁锻造而成，行走时会发出沉闷的金属碰撞声。传说这些怪物是被被遗忘的矮人工匠所创造，原本用于守卫矿脉，却因被黑暗力量腐蚀而变得凶残且充满怨恨。

石化牛最致命的天赋是它们的石化呼吸——一阵腐蚀性的蒸汽从鼻孔喷出，能在瞬间将生物的血肉转化为石质。受害者若未能在短时间内通过体质豁免，便会被永久石化，成为它们领地中永恒的雕像。除了致命的呼吸，它们还拥有坚硬的金属皮肤，使得普通的攻击难以对其造成伤害。尽管如此，石化牛仍保持着野兽的本能，以冲撞和践踏来击倒任何敢于侵犯其领地的入侵者。

specialAbilities.name: 践踏冲锋 Trampling Charge
specialAbilities.description: 如果戈贡在同一回合中沿直线朝一个生物移动至少20尺，并随后以其冲撞攻击命中该生物，则该目标必须进行一次DC 16的力量豁免，豁免失败则倒地。若目标处于倒地状态，则戈贡可以用一个附赠动作对其进行一次以蹄击进行的攻击。

actions.name: 石化吐息 Petrifying Breath
actions.description: 戈贡在30尺锥形范围内呼出石化气体。该区域内的每个生物必须进行一次DC 13的体质豁免。豁免失败时，目标开始变成石头并陷入束缚状态。该束缚目标必须在其下一个回合结束时重复该豁免。豁免成功则效果在该目标身上结束；豁免失败则目标陷入石化状态，直至被高等复原术（greater restoration）或其他魔法解救。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶异常体，由金属与威胁交织而成，俗称石化牛。它肩部约有六尺高，形体宛若一头由活铁锻造的强壮公牛。全身每一寸都覆以相互重叠的暗淡钢鳞与腐蚀铁片，移动时各鳞片轻微摩擦发出低沉的磨砺声。其躯干宽阔而肌肉发达，关节如活塞般坚固，粗壮而有力的四肢暗示着巨大的体力。蹄子踏地时迸射火星，在石头与泥土上留下灼热的印记。

石化牛的头部融合了有机与机械的恐怖——巨大的弯曲角向后伸展，表面覆有暗淡的锈斑；鼻孔中缓缓喷出淡淡的灰色蒸汽。锯齿状的眉骨之下，双眼散发微红光芒，专注而警觉，透露出野兽外表下的算计智慧。颈部的护甲板随呼吸起伏波动，激动时，装甲缝隙中会喷出嘶嘶作响的蒸汽。

它的姿态充满挑衅，随时准备冲锋；即便在静止时，身躯也隐隐绷紧，似有张力在其中回荡。其周围的空气沉重而压抑，仿佛这只生物携带着古老锻炉中锈蚀的怒火——一只由钢铁与腐败孕育的捕食者，耐心而致命。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil aberration of metal and menace, known as a Gorgon. It stands about six feet tall at the shoulder, its form resembling a powerful bull forged from living iron. Every inch of its body is plated in overlapping scales of dull steel and corroded iron, each segment grinding slightly as it moves. The creature’s frame is broad and muscular, with piston-like joints and thick, sinewy limbs that suggest immense physical strength. Its hooves strike the ground with sparks, leaving scorched impressions in stone and earth alike.  

The Gorgon’s head bears a mix of organic and mechanical horror—massive curved horns jut backward, coated with a tarnished sheen, while its nostrils vent faint wisps of gray vapor. Beneath a jagged brow, its eyes glow faintly red, focused and alert, betraying a calculating intelligence behind the beastly form. Plates along its neck ripple and lift with each breath, and when agitated, steam jets hiss from gaps in its armored hide.  

Its stance is confrontational, always poised to charge; even in stillness, tension hums in its frame. The air around it feels heavy and oppressive, as though the creature carries the weight of ancient forge-bound anger—a predator born of steel and corruption, patient and lethal.

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的异形，体型为中型，约六尺高，却诡异地悬浮在空中而非站立。它的身体几乎只是一颗巨大的苍灰色脑袋，脑组织在半透明、黏滑的薄膜下微微胀大并轻微脉动。暗淡的蓝紫色粗大血管在表层以下盘绕，呈现出一种不安且异样的生命律动。从生物的下半部伸出十二根细长而有力的触手，表面覆有黏液光泽，末端为可抓握撕裂的钩状尖端。触手以缓慢而刻意的扭动蠕动，展现出令人不安的敏捷与力量。

脑状肉块上没有眼睛、嘴巴或面部特征；相反，表面之下漂浮着如乳白色珍珠般的感官球体，微微发光，散发出智能且掠夺性的感知。整体轮廓显得极不自然——像是一团悬浮的肌肉与内脏纠结体，随时能够骤然发动冲击。它那骇人的形体透露出坚韧的肉体，能够抵御打击，却带有一种令人作呕且诡异的存在感，使任何凝视过久的生物感到不安。其周围的空气沉重而充满静谧的威胁，恰如一只源自异界、浸透邪恶企图的怪物。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil aberration, a medium-sized creature about six feet tall, suspended eerily in midair rather than standing. Its body is little more than a large, pale-gray brain, swollen and pulsing faintly under a translucent, slimy membrane. Thick veins of dull blue and purple coil beneath the surface, giving an impression of restless, alien life. From the lower half of the creature sprout a dozen long, sinewy tentacles, each slick with a mucous sheen and ending in hooked tips capable of gripping and tearing. The tentacles twist and writhe in slow, deliberate movements, displaying an unsettling agility and strength.  

No eyes, mouth, or facial features mark the brain-like mass; instead, sensory orbs like milky pearls float just beneath its surface, glowing faintly with intelligent, predatory awareness. The creature’s overall silhouette seems unnatural — a hovering tangle of muscle and viscera, capable of sudden bursts of motion. Its ghastly form betrays a strong, resilient flesh that can weather blows, yet carries a repulsive, uncanny presence that unsettles any who gaze too long. The air around it feels heavy, charged with quiet menace, fitting for something born of otherworldly origin and steeped in wicked intent.

monsters.appearance:
这是一种真中立的怪异生物。全长约六尺（从口鼻部至尾巴），它的行动如同为暗影而生的猎手，悄无声息且流畅。其身躯强壮而柔软，覆有厚实、橡胶质的皮肤，呈暗板岩色，夹杂暗淡的绿灰条纹，完美融入岩石之中。肌肉在皮肤下可见地盘绕，每一次细微的移动都散发出受控的力量感。

乍看之下，它的头部似乎不存在——直到四根细长、皮革状的触手从本应有颈部的部位展开，围绕着一只锋利的黑色甲壳圆形喙。这些触手如蛇般柔滑地波动扭动，略带潮湿光泽，末端是粗糙且布满吸盘的尖端，可灵活地在洞穴地面上拖拽。它那对小而苍白的眼睛深陷于上部皮肤的褶皱之间，毫无光泽、冷峻空洞，缺乏智慧，却闪烁着捕食者的警觉。

躯干紧凑而肌肉发达，胸部宽阔且有肋骨纹理，逐渐收窄成如鞭索般的尾巴。它以异常流畅的姿态移动，依靠强壮的有爪四肢支撑重量，四肢末端是弯曲的暗色爪子，专为抓握岩石而生。它的形体毫无优雅或美感——只有一种阴险的实用性，宛如被培育来杀戮并消失于黑暗中的怪物。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a true neutral monstrosity. Standing about six feet long from snout to tail, the creature moves with the silent fluidity of a hunter built for the shadows. Its body is powerful yet sinuous, layered with thick, rubbery skin the color of dark slate, streaked with dull green and gray that blend perfectly with stone. Muscles coil visibly beneath its hide, giving each subtle shift of movement a sense of controlled strength.  

Its head appears headless at first glance—until four long, leathery tentacles unfurl from where a neck should be, surrounding a sharp, circular beak of black chitin. These tentacles ripple and twist with snake-like grace, gleaming slightly with moisture and ending in rough, sucker-lined tips that flex and drag along cave floors. The creature’s small, pale eyes are sunken deep between the folds of its upper hide, unreflective and chillingly blank, devoid of intelligence but glinting with predatory alertness.  

The torso is compact and muscular, the chest wide and ribbed, narrowing to a tail that whips like a whipcord. It moves with uncanny smoothness, pulling its weight on powerful, clawed limbs that end in curved, dark talons suited for gripping rock. There is no grace or beauty in its form—only the sinister practicality of a thing bred to kill and vanish into the dark.

monsters.description:
石盲蛮族由普通人类退化而成。它们的祖先由于历代崇拜跟随夺心魔在幽暗地域中潜伏过活, 而逐渐转变成盲目而魁梧的食人怪物。

卑微的信徒 Debased Cultists。夺心魔帝国的版图曾经延伸至许多相异的世界, 并奴役了无数的种族。这些被奴役者中从不缺乏人类族群的存在。夺心魔们用险恶的能力控制族群高阶祭司的思想, 让族群的领导者们逐渐转变信仰, 最终崇拜灵吸怪们为渎神的造物主。

随着时间的推移, 这些被奴役的人类自发形成了狂热的食人文化,并把夺心魔食脑的行为尊为圣餐仪式。灵吸怪们顺势命令崇拜者前去绑架其他的智能生物作祭品, 然后在吸食受害者的大脑后,让信徒们处理这些失去生命的尸体。

盲眼猎人 Blind Hunters。夺心魔的统治崩溃后,它们的崇拜者随即失去了靠山。曾经遭受猎杀的生物们对它们围追堵截, 继而引发了无数的战争。残存的信众最后一起逃向了幽暗地域, 一个有如其灵吸怪神明神域一样的地方。在后来的岁月里,世代的无光生活使信徒们被逼学习依赖其他感官生存。久而久之, 它们的眼睛和眼睑渐渐枯萎封闭,只留下皮肤覆盖着的空眼眶。

石盲蛮族的耳朵可以听清遥远石路上的脚步与低语, 然后用低到其他类人生物都无法听到的声量进行交流。汗水和血肉的气味会唤起它们的饥饿感,并促使它们如寻血犬般追踪源头。为了增强自己的感官, 石盲蛮族在巢穴范围之外布满血污、粪堆和猎物内脏。当入侵者经过这些地区时, 沾染上的这些污浊气味可以让石盲蛮族迅速发现对方的存在。

对大多数生物而言, 失明是一种严重的活动障碍。但石盲蛮族由于拥有其他的敏锐感官, 视觉反而成为一种多余的干扰。而石盲蛮族现有的感官结构足以让它们在猎杀时更加无所畏惧。

无尽的战争 Endless War。石盲蛮族至今仍崇拜着夺心魔, 并想尽办法为它们服务。而那些驱使它们逃往地下的战争也依然缠绕不休。然而它们仍时常为灵吸怪主子们绑架猎物, 并为此返回到地表世界的战争中,完全没有要结束这种恶性循环的想法。
