monsters.appearance:
怪物名称：穿刺者  

这是一种中立的怪异生物，称为穿刺者，一种潜伏于洞穴阴影中的中型掠食者。它全长约六尺，伸展开时从厚实、肌肉发达的中段逐渐收窄至如石头般坚硬的尖锥形尖端。其外层皮肤似暗色石灰岩——凹凸不平、粗糙且带有灰棕相间的斑纹，完美融入上方的钟乳石之中。细小的脊 ridge 与凹陷让其表面看起来像天然岩石，但皮肤下隐约的脉动暗示着活生生的肌肉在其下奔腾。  

在上半身沿线分布着淡淡的角质板，强化了其骨架；而筋肉的肉条则从裂缝中探出，显示出其紧凑而结实的体格。腹部较为苍白且更为光滑，呈节段状并带有细微的褶皱，随动作而 flex，尽管体形笨重，却能展现出令人惊讶的敏捷。两只暗淡、凹陷的眼睛空洞地盯着靠近尖端的部位，毫无智慧或情感的火花。腹侧隐藏的口腔张开时会露出锯齿状的钙化牙齿，用以撕裂猎物。  

穿刺者常保持静止，伪装成石头，直至从天花板上骤然坠落。其存在带有寒冷且令人不安的气息——一种原始而致命的生物，在寂静的领地中耐心且致命。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral monstrous creature known as a Piercer, a medium-sized predator that lurks in the shadows of caverns. It measures about six feet long when fully extended, its body tapering from a thick, muscular midsection to a sharp, conical tip hardened like stone. The creature’s outer hide resembles dark limestone—uneven, rough, and mottled in hues of gray and brown, blending seamlessly with stalactites above. Tiny ridges and pits make its surface appear like natural rock, but faint pulses beneath the hide hint at living muscle underneath.  

Along its upper body run faint chitinous plates that strengthen its frame, while strands of sinewy flesh peek through crevices, showing its compact but sturdy build. Its underside is pale and smoother, segmented with faint folds that flex as it moves, capable of surprising agility despite its bulk. Two dull, recessed eyes stare emptily from near its tip, lacking any spark of intellect or emotion. A hidden maw near the underside opens to reveal jagged, calcified teeth used to tear into prey.  

The Piercer hangs motionless, mimicking stone until it drops suddenly from the ceiling. Its presence feels cold and unsettling—a primitive but dangerous creature, patient and deadly in its silent domain.

monsters.name: 皮克精
monsters.skills: 察觉+4,隐匿+7 感官:被动察觉 14 语言: 木族语挑战等级:1/4 (50 XP)
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 14 语言: 木族语挑战等级:1/4 (50 XP)
monsters.speed_text: 10 尺,飞行 30 尺技能:察觉+4,隐匿+7 感官:被动察觉 14 语言: 木族语挑战等级:1/4 (50 XP)

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 皮克精为抵抗法术和其他魔法效应所作的豁免检定具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 Innate Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description: 皮克精天生施法的关键属性为魅力 (法术 DC 12)。它可施展以下法术, 且只需要其自身的妖精尘作为相应的法术成分。

actions.name: 强效隐形 Superior Invisibility
actions.description: 皮克精变为隐形直至其失去专注 (等同于专注法术)。该皮克精着装或携带的任何装备也会随之一同隐形。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立善良的妖精生物，体型极小，仅约八英寸高，虽纤弱却充满活力。它的身体纤细几乎无重量，柔和的曲线与细长的四肢在移动时显得轻盈自如。半透明的翅膀如蜻蜓般形状，闪烁着绿、金、青绿的色彩，每一次振动都在空气中散射出千变万化的光辉。  

它的皮肤带有淡淡的月光微光——光滑、苍白，在阴影中隐约发光。细腻的纹路如苔藓的脉络沿着手臂和肩部蔓延，暗示着它与森林魔法的深厚联系。面容年轻而精致，宽大的智慧之眼闪烁着翡翠绿和琥珀色的光辉，长睫毛轻拂其旁。小巧上翘的鼻子和温柔的淡笑赋予它一种令人不自觉放下防备的柔和魅力。  

它的发丝如漂浮的轻雾，随风轻荡，颜色如晨露中秋叶的柔金、淡绿与暮霞粉。它不披盔甲，仅以松散的花瓣和丝线织成的衣袍点缀。生物的动作敏捷而流畅，翅膀轻鸣，悬停时散发出宁静、愉悦的气息，远比威慑更具魅惑——宛若和平林间空地与隐蔽林丘的守护之灵。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral good fey creature, a tiny being only about eight inches tall, delicate yet vibrant with life. Its body is slender and almost weightless, with soft curves and narrow limbs that move with effortless grace. Translucent wings, shaped like those of a dragonfly, shimmer with hues of green, gold, and turquoise, scattering light in a thousand shifting colors whenever they beat.  

Its skin holds the faint glow of moonlight—smooth, pale, and faintly luminous in shadow. Fine patterns like moss veins trace along its arms and shoulders, suggesting a deep tie to forest magic. The face is youthful and refined, with wide, intelligent eyes gleaming in emerald and amber tones, fringed by long lashes. A small, upturned nose and subtle, kind smile lend it a disarmingly gentle allure.  

Its hair cascades in floating wisps that drift as though in a breeze, colored like autumn leaves seen through morning dew—muted golds, soft greens, and sunset pinks. It bears no armor, only loose petals and silken threads woven into garments. The creature’s movements are brisk and fluid, wings humming softly as it hovers, exuding a calm, cheerful aura more enchanting than intimidating, a guardian spirit of peaceful glades and hidden groves.

monsters.name: 伪龙
languages: understands Common and Draconic but can't speak
monsters.description:
伪龙是一种体型仅有几寸的小型龙类，常栖息于森林的树洞、山洞或城镇的屋檐下。它们外形如同拥有鳞片的蜥蜴，长有一对细小的翅膀，能在空中灵活盘旋。虽然体型微小，但伪龙拥有龙族的血脉，具备一定的魔法天赋和敏锐的感官，常被冒险者视为忠诚的宠物或情报来源。伪龙性情温和，倾向于帮助善良的生物，偶尔也会以小小的恶作剧取乐。

在战斗中，伪龙并不以力量取胜，而是凭借其天生的魔法抗性、隐蔽的身形以及致命的尾刺来保护自己和其主人。它们能够施展侦测魔法的法术，甚至可以变形伪装自己，以便在危急时刻逃脱或隐藏。伪龙的忠诚度极高，一旦与冒险者结成伙伴，它们会用心灵感应与主人保持联系，甚至在需要时提供情报或警示。

specialAbilities.name: 敏锐感官 Keen Senses
specialAbilities.description: 伪龙在依赖视觉、听觉或嗅觉的感知（Perception）感知检定上具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗力 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 伪龙在对抗法术及其他魔法效应的豁免检定上具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 有限心灵感应 Limited Telepathy
specialAbilities.description: 伪龙可以以魔法方式与任何位于其100尺内且能理解某种语言的生物进行心灵感应沟通，传达简单的想法、情绪与图像。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4命中，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：4（1d4 + 2）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 毒刺 Sting
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4命中，触及5尺，单一生物。命中：4（1d4 + 2）穿刺伤害，且目标必须通过一次DC 11体质豁免，否则中毒1小时。若该豁免失败且失败值达到5或更多，则目标在相同持续时间内陷入昏迷，或直到其受到伤害，或另一生物使用一个动作摇醒它为止。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立善良的龙类生物，体型小巧到足以栖息在人的手掌上——从鼻口到尾尖的细长身躯仅约一尺。伪龙的体格纤细而轻盈，更像一只微型蜥蜴而非庞大的巨龙，却在其动作中蕴含着宁静的活力。它的鳞片在深红与金色的光泽中柔和闪烁，细腻如磨光的宝石，却又呈哑光以便融入树皮或岩石。翅膀透明且布满脉络，犹如蜻蜓之翼，休息时整齐折叠贴于两侧；展开时快速而精准地拍动，轻盈地将其托起，宛若空中舞者。

狭长的头部冠以两只细小的弯曲角， amber色的眼睛闪烁着警觉的智慧光芒。鼻口逐渐收尖，轻声嘶鸣时可见一排细小如针的牙齿。细长的尾巴向后延伸，末端是一枚闪烁着淡淡毒液光泽的锐利刺。爪足稳固地抓握各种表面，动作精准而无声。尽管体型微小，伪龙仍散发出一种平和的警戒气息——温柔、忠诚，除非受到威胁，否则并不构成伤害。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral good dragon creature, small enough to perch on a human’s hand—its slender body barely a foot long from snout to tail tip. The pseudodragon’s frame is delicate and lean, more like a miniature lizard than a mighty wyrm, yet there is a quiet energy in the way it moves. Its scales shimmer softly in hues of crimson and gold, fine as polished gems but matte enough to blend into bark or stone. The wings are translucent and veined like those of a dragonfly, folding neatly against its sides when at rest; when unfurled, they beat with quick precision, carrying the creature through the air with effortless grace.  

A narrow head crowned with two tiny, curved horns holds eyes of amber that gleam with alert intelligence. Its snout tapers to a fine point, with a row of minute, needle-like teeth visible when it hisses softly. A thin tail extends behind it, ending in a sharp stinger glistening with faint venom. Clawed feet grip surfaces with easy surety, their motion precise and quiet. Despite its miniature size, the pseudodragon has an aura of calm watchfulness—gentle, loyal, and harmless unless threatened.

monsters.name: 紫虫
monsters.alignment: 这些隧道很快就会被其他生物用作廊道和通路。由于紫虫很少返回自己挖掘的地道
monsters.savingThrows: 体质+11,感知+4 感官:盲视 30 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 9 语言:一挑战等级:15(13000 XP)
monsters.senses_text: 盲视 30 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 9 语言:一挑战等级:15(13000 XP)
monsters.speed_text: 50 尺,掘穴 30 尺豁免:体质+11,感知+4 感官:盲视 30 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 9 语言:一挑战等级:15(13000 XP)

specialAbilities.name: 掘道者 Tunneler
specialAbilities.description: 紫虫能够以其一半的掘穴速度通过坚硬的岩层, 并在其身后留下直径 10 尺的地道

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 紫虫发动两次攻击:一次啃咬和一次尾刺攻击。

actions.name: 啃咬Bite
actions.description:
近战武器攻击:命中+9,触及 10 尺,单一目标。伤害:22(3d8+9)的穿刺伤害。如果目标是一大型或更小体型生物。则目标必须成功通过一次 DC 19 的敏捷豁免否则被紫虫吞下。 被吞下的目标陷入目盲且被束缚, 其对于紫虫身体外的攻击或效应视为处于全身掩护,并在每次该紫虫的回合开始时受 21(6d6) 的强酸伤害。
如果紫虫在同一回合累计受到 30 点来自其体内的伤害,则该紫虫在该回合结束时必须成功通过一次 DC 21 的体质豁免否则将吐出所有被其吞咽的生物, 并使其摔下倒地于紫虫周边 10 尺范围内 如果该紫虫死亡,则被吞下的生物将不再受束缚,且可以消耗 20 尺移动力逃出, 然后在尸体旁现身并陷入倒地状态。

actions.name: 尾刺Tail Stinger
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+9,触及 10 尺,单一生物。伤害:19(3d6+9)的穿刺伤害。且目标必须进行一次 DC 19 的体质豁免, 豁免失败则受 42 (12d6) 的毒素伤害, 豁免成功则伤害减半。

actions.name: 负伤狂怒 Wounded Fury
actions.description: 当生命值降至 10 或更低时,泽地熊人发动的攻击检定具有优势, 并且它对所有目标造成的近战攻击伤害额外增加 7 (2d6)。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只无阵营的巨型深土野兽，凶猛的掠食者，能够在坚硬的岩石中开凿隧道。它的庞大身躯近九十英尺长，直径约二十英尺，蜿蜒如活生生的肌肉山。分段的外壳闪耀着紫色和紫罗兰色的光泽，每块光滑的甲壳板紧密相连，保护着其密实的肉体。伤痕与粗糙的边缘刻画在它的身躯上，源自于在压抑黑暗中搏斗的痕迹。

它那巨大的头部似虫似蛇的混合体，冠以圆形巨口，口中排列着同心环状的锯齿状黄牙，牙齿不断抽动并不停磨牙。口腔持续张合，足以吞下一匹完整的马。细小的退化眼睛在颚上方闪烁着黑曜般的光泽，虽无智识，却充满无尽的饥渴。

沿着全身，微弱的脊 ridge 随其移动而起伏，展现出埋藏的力量与惊人的柔韧。这条巨虫的庞大形体在移动时呈现出与其体型不符的诡异优雅，掀起尘土与岩石如波浪般翻滚。它的存在散发出原始的威胁——一种不可阻挡的吞噬与掘穴本能，宛如活生生的灾难，拖拽着地下世界随之颤抖。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is an unaligned colossal beast of the deep earth, a monstrous predator that carves tunnels through solid stone. Its titanic body stretches nearly ninety feet long and rises twenty feet in diameter, coiling like a living mountain of muscle. The creature’s segmented hide gleams with shades of purple and violet, each slick, chitinous plate interlocking tightly to protect the dense flesh beneath. Scars and rough edges mark its body from battles fought in the crushing dark.  

Its enormous head resembles a hybrid of worm and serpent, crowned with a circular maw lined by concentric rings of jagged, yellowed teeth that twitch and grind restlessly. The mouth constantly flexes, gaping wide enough to swallow a horse whole. Tiny, vestigial eyes glint black and glassy above the jaws, devoid of intelligence but filled with relentless hunger.  

Along the length of its body, faint ridges pulse as it moves, showing buried strength and surprising suppleness. The worm’s vast form undulates with deceptive grace for its bulk, throwing up dirt and stone like waves. Its presence radiates primal menace—an unstoppable instinct of devouring and burrowing, a living catastrophe dragging the subterranean world in its wake.

monsters.name: 泽地熊人
monsters.description:
泽地熊人（Quaggoth）是一种生活在寒冷荒原和阴暗沼泽的凶残类人生物，身形庞大且覆满厚重的毛皮，外形近似巨大的熊却拥有直立行走的能力。它们通常成群结队地在暗潮汹涌的洞穴或废墟中潜伏，以猎捕闯入者或掳走走失的旅人来满足其野蛮的欲望。泽地熊人天性残忍、嗜血且极度好斗，常常在混乱与邪恶的力量驱使下，参与黑暗仪式或为强大的恶魔领主效忠。

这些生物拥有极其发达的嗅觉与视力，能够在昏暗的环境中轻易追踪猎物。它们的爪子锋利如刀，巨斧则足以劈开厚重的盔甲。泽地熊人对痛苦和死亡几乎没有同情心，若被激怒，它们会发动猛烈的冲锋，利用多次攻击撕裂敌人的防御。尽管体型庞大，却异常灵活，常常在战斗中利用其强大的感官优势取得上风。

specialAbilities.name: 黑暗视野 Darkvision
specialAbilities.description: 泽地熊人在黑暗中可见60尺范围内的事物，等同于在明亮光线下的视力。

specialAbilities.name: 敏锐嗅觉 Keen Smell
specialAbilities.description: 泽地熊人在进行依赖嗅觉的感知检定时具有优势，能够在远距离侦测隐藏或潜行的生物。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 泽地熊人可以进行两次近战攻击：一次使用巨斧，一次使用爪击。

actions.name: 巨斧攻击 Greataxe
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+5命中，射程5尺。命中时造成2d12+3点挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 爪击 Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+5命中，射程5尺。命中时造成1d6+3点挥砍伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱邪恶的类人形生物，外形如同一头巨大的熊，身高接近十尺，体格魁梧、肩宽如山。粗糙、蓬乱的皮毛在肌肉下起伏，颜色从胸前的肮脏白色渐变至四肢的泥泞棕色。厚重的毛发交织着污垢和沼泽泥巴的条纹，呈现出野性且未被驯服的外观。它的手臂又长又有力，手掌末端长着锯齿状的爪子，闪烁着暗淡的钢铁光泽——这些爪子看起来足以撕裂血肉与盔甲。

它的头部兼具熊与类人特征——扁平的鼻口排列着发黄的獠牙，鼻孔因猎物的气味而张开，眼中燃烧着冷酷、残忍的智慧。毛皮间可见斑驳的伤疤皮肤，昭示着无数战斗与艰难。它的步态弓背且带有捕猎者的姿态，却出奇地敏捷；每一次动作都散发出凶残的备战气息。

淡淡的潮湿、肮脏的雾气附着在它的皮毛上，仿佛刚从沼泽中爬出。它的存在散发出威胁与原始的野蛮，是混沌与饥饿的活生生化身，在阴影中徘徊，低声咆哮，等待下一次残暴的冲击。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil humanoid resembling a monstrous bear, standing close to ten feet tall with a hulking, broad-shouldered frame. Its muscles ripple beneath matted layers of coarse, shaggy fur, the color shifting from dirty white along the chest to muddy brown across its limbs. Thick strands of fur are tangled with streaks of grime and swamp mud, giving it a feral, untamed appearance. Its arms are long and powerful, ending in hands tipped by jagged claws glinting like dull steel; these claws look capable of shredding flesh and armor alike.  

The creature’s head combines bear and humanoid traits — a flattened snout lined with yellowed fangs, nostrils flaring from the scent of prey, and eyes that burn with a cold, cruel intelligence. Patches of scarred skin peek through its fur, evidence of countless battles and hardship. Its gait is hunched and predatory, yet disturbingly agile; every motion exudes vicious readiness.  

A faint coating of damp, grimy mist clings to its fur as if it has just emerged from a swamp. Its presence radiates menace and raw savagery, a living embodiment of chaos and hunger prowling through the shadows, snarling softly before its next brutal strike.

monsters.name: 罗刹
monsters.alignment: 当在九层地狱中被杀死后便会被彻底毁灭。 罗刹 Rakshasa 中型邪魔
damageImmunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 13

specialAbilities.name: 有限魔法免疫 Limited Magic Immunity
specialAbilities.description: 罗刹不能被6环或更低环阶的法术影响或侦测，除非它愿意。它在对抗所有其他法术与魔法效应的豁免检定上具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 Innate Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
罗刹的天生施法属性为魅力（法术豁免DC 18，法术攻击命中+10）。罗刹能天生施展下列法术，且不需要材料成分：

随意施放：侦测思想（detect thoughts）、易容术（disguise self）、法师之手（mage hand）、次级幻影（minor illusion）

每日3次：魅惑人类（charm person）、侦测魔法（detect magic）、隐形术（invisibility）、高等幻影（major image）、暗示术（suggestion）

每日1次：支配人类（dominate person）、飞行术（fly）、异界传送（plane shift）、真实视域（true seeing）

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 罗刹进行两次爪击攻击

actions.name: 爪击 Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+7命中，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：9（2d6 + 2）挥砍伤害，且若目标为生物，则该目标被诅咒。该魔法诅咒会在目标进行一次短休或长休时生效，以恐怖的影像与梦境充满目标的思绪。被诅咒的目标完成短休或长休时不获得任何收益。该诅咒持续至被解除诅咒术（remove curse）或类似魔法解除为止。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只守序邪恶的邪魔——一名高耸近十尺的罗刹，拥有暗黑君主般的威严姿态。它的体格肌肉发达，却又流畅灵动，每一次动作都带着老练捕食者的无声精准。其轻盈的身形披覆着如同虎纹般的皮毛——午夜般的漆黑与深琥珀相间，在昏暗光线下微微闪烁。它的双手向后扭曲，呈 grotesque 颠倒状，指尖是一对长而光亮的爪子，犹如黑曜石刀锋。

罗刹的面容是一只王者之虎，具有人类般的特征却令人不安——细长的口鼻、锋利的白牙，以及在捕食者的笑容中流露出的残忍智慧。其眼眸燃烧着金色的催眠光辉，似能刺穿幻象与谎言。小巧的弯曲角冠于头顶，华丽的衣袍上绣有地狱符号，悬垂时展现出贵族般的精准。

每一次移动都散发出自信与算计的威胁；它挺胸直立，兼具优雅与恐惧。淡淡的硫磺雾气环绕其身，周围的空气微微颤动，散发出地狱的余温。这位邪魔的存在无疑充满魅惑，却又令人胆寒，宛如一位被残忍狡诈与黑暗力量束缚的恶魔贵族。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil fiend, a towering rakshasa standing nearly ten feet tall with the commanding poise of a dark sovereign. Its physique is powerfully muscled, yet sleek and fluid, each motion possessing the silent precision of a seasoned predator. The creature’s lithe form is draped in fur patterned like flowing tiger stripes — midnight black and deep amber that shimmer subtly in dim light. Its hands, turned backward in grotesque inversion, end in long, polished claws that gleam like obsidian blades.  

The rakshasa’s face is that of a regal tiger, the features humanlike enough to be unsettling — tapering muzzle, sharp white fangs, and a hint of cruel intellect in its predatory grin. Its eyes burn with a golden, hypnotic glow that seems to pierce through illusions and lies alike. Small, curved horns crown its head, and its elaborate garments — threaded with infernal symbols — hang with aristocratic precision.  

Every movement exudes confidence and calculated menace; it stands straight-backed, radiating both elegance and dread. A faint sulfurous haze clings to its form, and the air around it ripples subtly with infernal warmth. This fiend’s presence is undeniably charismatic yet terrifying, a vision of demonic nobility bound to cruel cunning and dark power.
damageVulnerabilities: piercing from magic weapons wielded by good creatures

monsters.name: 百足魔兽
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,颤动感知 60 尺,被动察觉 10
monsters.description:
百足魔兽在一片蒸汽云雾中从冰雪之下冲出, 其体内却涌动着炼狱之火。翼状鳍在其头部向后张开, 它的巨嘴边缘则布满锯齿状的尖牙。

极地狩猎者 Arctic Predators。百足魔兽生活在严寒的气候中。它们捕食麋鹿、白熊和一切生活在该领地的其他生物。它们体内长着像火炉一样生热的器官来抵御寒冷, 这反而让它们无法忍受温暖的天气。百足魔兽单独狩猎时,会在冰雪深处掘洞埋伏, 等待生物从其上方经过时传来的微小震动。隐藏冰雪之下时, 百足魔兽会主动降低体温, 以免自己将冰面融化。

幼兽 Young Ones。霜巨人猎手会在冰冷的荒地中搜寻百足魔兽的巢和卵,这些巨人们将百足魔兽的幼虫视若珍宝,从幼虫孵化起就训练它们服从命令,用其守卫霜巨人冰冷的城堡。与成虫不同,百足魔兽幼虫会啃咬受害者,而不是将其整个吞下。

specialAbilities.name: 灼热之躯Heated Body
specialAbilities.description: 在百足魔兽周边 5 尺范围内触碰或对其发动近战攻击命中时, 该攻击生物将受 10 (3d6) 的火焰伤害

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+11,触及 10 尺,单一目标。 伤害:40(6d10+7)的穿刺伤害,外加 10(3d6)的火焰伤害。 如果目标是一个生物, 则目标被擒抱 (逃脱 DC 17), 直至擒抱终止前目标被束缚,且百足魔兽不能再对其他目标使用啃咬攻击。

actions.name: 吞咽Swallow
actions.description:
百足魔兽对正被它擒抱的中型或更小体型生物发动一次啃咬攻击。若该攻击命中,则目标被吞下并终止其擒抱状态。目标被吞下时陷入目盲且被束缚,其对于百足魔兽身体外的攻击或效应视为处于全身掩护, 并在每次该百足魔兽的回合开始时受 21(6d6)的强酸伤害。
如果百足魔兽在同一回合总计受到 30 点来自其体内的伤害, 则该魔兽在该回合结束时必须成功通过一次 DC 15 的体质豁免否则将吐出所有被其吞咽的生物, 并使其摔下倒地于魔兽周边 10 尺范围内 如果该百足魔兽死亡,则被吞下的生物将不再受束缚, 且可以消耗 15 尺移动力逃出, 然后在尸体旁现身并陷入倒地状态。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只无阵营的怪异生物，体型庞大，身长逾三十尺，宛如活生生的雪崩在雪原上盘旋。它的躯体如巨蛇般蜿蜒且肌肉发达，每一节都覆以厚重的几丁质甲板，呈深冰色，交织着红橙色的炽热血脉纹路。甲板之间的裂缝不断喷出蒸汽，仿佛熔融的火焰在冰封的外壳下翻滚。背部排列着刀锋般的脊刺，尖端覆霜，基部燃起血红的光辉。

它的头部宽阔且具捕食者的凶猛，左右各有一对弧形、似翼的鳍片，冲出雪层时会张开。口部张得极大，边缘布满锯齿状的牙齿，犹如冻结的玻璃，足以劈裂岩石。两只无眼睑的眼睛直视前方——淡蓝色、永不眨动，寒冷却充满致命的警觉。

无数条腿的末端各有锐利的钩爪，动作既诡异又迅捷，轻易抓牢冰冷的地面。尽管外形令人作呕且怪异，它的移动却流畅而精准，散发出残暴的活力。其周围的空气因热气与霜冻相碰而闪烁，每一次呼吸都化作上升的蒸汽波纹——这是一种将寒冬与火焰融合于血肉之中的恐怖存在。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is an unaligned monstrosity of enormous scale, a towering creature over thirty feet long that coils through the snow like a living avalanche. Its body is serpentine and powerfully muscled, each segment covered in thick, chitinous plates the color of deep ice streaked with glowing veins of red-orange heat. Steam constantly hisses from the cracks between its armored ridges, giving the impression that molten fire roils beneath its frozen shell. Along its back run knife-like spines that shimmer with frost at the tips and burn crimson at their bases.  

The creature’s head is broad and predatory, flanked by curved, winglike fins that flare when it emerges from the snow. Its mouth gapes wide, rimmed with jagged, saw-edged teeth glistening like frozen glass, capable of splitting stone. Two lidless eyes glare forward—pale blue and unblinking, cold yet filled with deadly alertness.  

Its numerous legs, each ending in sharp, hooked claws, move with unsettling grace and speed, effortlessly gripping the icy terrain. Despite its repulsive and monstrous form, its movements are fluid and precise, exuding a brutal vitality. The air around it shimmers with heat against the frost, and every breath it exhales curls upward in waves of steam—a terrifying fusion of winter and flame embodied in living flesh.

monsters.name: 还魂尸
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 13
monsters.description: 生前是施法者的还魂尸可以重获曾经所有或部分的施法能力。 与之类似的情况是, 一些还魂尸还会着装生前所用的护甲或持用曾经的武器。

specialAbilities.name: 再生 Regeneration
specialAbilities.description: 还魂尸在其自己的回合开始时恢复 10 点生命值。如果其受到火焰或光耀伤害, 则该还魂尸的该特质在其下一回合开始时无法生效。还魂尸的躯体只有在其以 0 生命值开始其自己回合,且无法使用再生特质时才会被摧毁

specialAbilities.name: 复生 Rejuvenation
specialAbilities.description: 还魂尸的躯体被摧毁时灵魂仍逗留在原处。 在经过 24 小时后,其灵魂就会在同一位面中找到另一具尸体进行寄生,同时恢复其所有生命值。当其灵魂处于游离状态时,法术祈愿术 wish 可以用来迫使该灵魂往生不再复返

specialAbilities.name: 免疫驱散 Turn Immunity
specialAbilities.description: 还魂尸免疫驱散不死生物的效应

specialAbilities.name: 复仇追猎者 Vengeful Tracker
specialAbilities.description: 还魂尸知晓阻碍其寻得复仇之人所在的方位和距离, 哪怕这些生物和其复仇对象在另一存在位面也无法幸免。如果还魂尸所追踪的生物死亡,则还魂尸也能立即知晓

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 还魂尸发动两次拳击攻击。

actions.name: 拳击 Fist
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+7,触及 5 尺,单一生物。伤害:11(2d6+4)的钝击伤害。如果该目标生物是还魂尸的誓仇对象,则目标额外受 14(4d6)的钝击伤害。还魂尸也可以选择不造成伤害,而是擒抱该生物 (逃脱 DC 14),前提是该目标体型必须为大型或更小体型。

actions.name: 复仇怒视 Vengeful Glare
actions.description: 还魂尸指定其周边 30 尺内一个它能看见的生物, 或指定其誓仇对象。该目标必须进行一次 DC 15 的感知豁免。豁免失败则目标陷入麻痹直至还魂尸对其造成伤害, 或持续至还魂尸的下一回合结束。麻痹状态终止时, 该目标被该还魂尸恐慌 1 分钟。该被恐慌目标可以在自己的每个回合结束时再次进行该豁免,如果此时它能看到该还魂尸则豁免具有劣势。 豁免成功则终止其自己身上的恐慌状态。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立亡灵生物——一具约六尺高、如战士再生般的还魂尸。其身躯肌肉发达、结实坚固，肩宽体均衡，行动时展现出异常精准的姿态，兼具力量与敏捷。皮肤苍白且略带半透明，紧绷在分明的肌肉之上，血管隐约可见，散发出暗灰绿的淡淡色泽，仿佛被残存的死亡能量所笼罩。  

面容锋利且具有人类特征，比多数亡灵更为逼真——高耸的颧骨、坚毅的下颚线，双眼散发出柔和的幽蓝光辉。眼神灵活而警觉，始终在周围进行有计划的扫描。嘴角保持着冷静而坚定的表情；当张开时，淡淡的墓雾从灰色的唇间逸出。  

它身披破烂的盔甲残片，昔日精良却已满布伤痕与风化——雕刻钢片与暗色皮甲与其亡灵肉体无缝融合。盔甲表面刻有符文，微弱的奥术能量在其间脉动，呼应着过去的魔法威能。  

还魂尸直立稳固，姿态既庄严又凶险，散发出低调而克制的力量。其存在带有一种诡异的宁静——一个目标明确、善恶不分的存在，蕴含死亡的无尽耐力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral undead creature, a revenant standing roughly six feet tall with the physique of a warrior reborn. Its frame is muscular and solid, broad-shouldered and balanced, moving with an unnatural precision that betrays both strength and agility. The skin is pale and slightly translucent, stretched taut over defined muscle, veins faintly visible with a dull gray-green hue as if shadowed by lingering death energy.  

The face bears sharp, human-like features, more lifelike than most undead — high cheekbones, a strong jawline, and eyes that glow softly with a spectral blue light. Those eyes move intelligently, always alert, scanning the surroundings with calculated awareness. The mouth is set in a calm, determined expression; when opened, faint wisps of grave mist escape from between gray lips.  

It wears tattered remnants of armor, once fine but now scarred and weathered — pieces of engraved steel and dark leather fused seamlessly with its undead flesh. A faint shimmer of arcane energy pulses through runes etched across the armor’s surface, echoing past magical prowess.  

The revenant stands upright and steady, posture regal yet menacing, radiating a quiet, restrained power. Its presence carries an eerie calm—a being of purpose, neither good nor evil, imbued with the relentless endurance of death.

monsters.name: 鹏鸟
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 14
monsters.description:
乍看之下,鹏鸟的身影与其他的猛禽很相似。然而,随着它降落, 其惊异骇人的体型便表露无遗。鹏鸟在飞行时翼展 200 多吃。这种与古龙比肩的巨鸟歇息时,必定栖息在其山峰顶端的巢穴中。

空中泰坦 Sky Titans。早在巨人与龙族争夺世界霸权的远古时代, 巨人父神安南 Annam 创作了鹏鸟, 以便其崇拜者可以挑战龙族在空中的统治地位。战争结束后,鹏鸟便从巨人的控制中解脱, 并开始在世界各地繁衍生息。

虽然云巨人和风暴巨人有时会驯服这些大鸟,但鹏鸟们也会巨人视为猎物。它们会飞到很远的地方觅食, 云层之上便是它们最爱的狩猎场。鹏鸟很少捕猎敏捷或小型的生物, 也不会选择猎物容易藏身的城镇和森林。而当它锁定一个巨大、缓慢移动的目标时 (比如巨人、鲸鱼或大象), 鹏鸟便会俯冲下来, 用去巨大的爪子抓住猎物。

偏远和孤独 Remote and Alone。鹏鸟是一种寿命长达几个世纪的独居动物。它们四处带来树木、帐篷、破船和商队残骸互相纠结成巨大鸟巢, 并设置在山崖上低等生物难以触及的裂缝之中。

有时候, 鹏鸟的巢穴中会保存着其遭其洗劫商队或船只的珍宝, 而这些生物并不在意这些小玩意。鸟巢中还会有比人类还高的鸟蛋, 只是鹏鸟甚少交配产卵因此这种情况更为罕见。

specialAbilities.name: 敏锐视觉 Keen Sight
specialAbilities.description: 巨鹏在依赖视觉的感知（Perception）感知检定上具有优势。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 巨鹏进行两次攻击：一次用喙，一次用爪。

actions.name: 喙击 Beak
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+13命中，触及10尺，单一目标。命中：27（4d8 + 9）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 爪击 Talons
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+13命中，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：23（4d6 + 9）挥砍伤害，且目标被擒抱（逃脱DC 19）。直到该擒抱结束前，目标处于束缚（restrained）状态，且巨鹏不能用其爪攻击另一个目标。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只中立的巨型怪异生物。鹏鸟高耸于天地之上，栖息时身躯超过三十尺，高耸入云，双翼展开几乎达两百尺之宽。浓密的粗糙暴风灰羽毛下肌肉起伏，羽毛微微闪烁着蓝色光泽，宛如被远方闪电点亮的雷云。它那巨大的胸腔随缓慢而有力的呼吸起伏，每一次呼吸都在空气中发出低沉的呼啸声。生物的头部锋利且充满掠夺性——巨大的喙呈钩状，漆黑如黑曜石，足以碾碎岩石。凶猛的金色眼睛闪烁着野性的本能警觉，虽不狡黠，却燃烧着原始的专注。

鹏鸟的双腿粗壮，筋脉交织，末端是如投石机弹丸般大小的爪，每只爪因长期使用而散发金属光泽。它的翅膀在如此规模下仍保持惊人的平衡，宽阔的翼面边缘被历经风暴的破损撕裂所点缀。站立时，它保持一种支配而自然的姿态，羽毛在看不见的风中轻轻颤动。即便没有敌意或恶意，它的存在本身便让天空充满敬畏与恐惧，宛如一位凭借纯粹力量与体型统治苍穹的远古捕食者。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral gargantuan monstrosity. The roc towers over the landscape, its body more than thirty feet tall when perched, with wings that stretch out nearly two hundred feet from tip to tip. Muscles ripple beneath dense layers of coarse, storm-gray feathers that shimmer faintly with a bluish sheen, like thunderclouds lit by distant lightning. Its colossal chest rises and falls with slow, powerful breaths, each movement releasing a deep whooshing sound through the air. The creature’s head is sharp and predatory—its beak enormous, hooked, and dark as obsidian, capable of crushing stone. Fierce golden eyes glint with a wild, instinctive alertness, lacking cunning but burning with primal focus.  

The roc’s legs are thick and corded with sinew, ending in talons the size of ballista bolts, each claw gleaming with a metallic luster from constant use. Its wings flex with remarkable balance for their scale, broad vanes edged with tatters from storms survived. When standing, it holds a dominating yet natural stance, feathers ruffling in unseen wind. Even without menace or malice, its sheer presence fills the sky with awe and dread, an ancient predator that rules the air by sheer power and size alone.

monsters.name: 树绳妖
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 16
monsters.description:
贪食的树绳妖生活在遍布幽暗地域的洞穴和岩窟中, 以他们能够抓到的所有东西为食。从幽暗地域的野兽到冒险者和他们的装备,树绳妖们对于食物毫不挑剔。

树绳妖的外表近似于石钟乳或石笋, 而这也让其发动袭击时更有优势。这种生物能够依靠底座下的数千根纤毛缓缓的移动, 慢慢的爬上洞穴的墙壁并沿着石质天花板移动, 寻找最适合攻击的位置。

幽暗猎手Underdark Hunters。树绳妖是一种高度进化的成熟捕猎者, 他们拥有石头一样的外表和以此为基础的捕猎技巧。 一只树绳妖可以长时间保持静止, 再闭上它唯一的眼睛从而让自己看起来和一块平凡的石头一模一样。靠太近的生物常常惊讶于它突然睁开的眼睛和飞射而出的卷须。伴随着可怖的喉音,树绳妖会卷起挣扎的猎物并将其拖向自己, 打算用自己石牙发动致命咬击。

除铂金、宝石和魔法物品外, 树绳妖可以消化它吞下的任何东西。而那些无法消化之物则可以在树绳妖死后在其砂囊中找到。 树绳妖的消化液也十分珍贵, 一些用它做溶剂的炼金术师往往会愿意以不菲的价钱收购这种物品。

致弱卷须 Weakening Tendrils。一只树绳妖全身有 6 处瘤包, 从里面伸出的黏糊卷须会黏上任何接触到的物体。每根卷须长着毛发一样的凸起, 可以穿透生物的血肉汲取其力气。正因如此, 被卷起的猎物挣扎时总会逐渐变得无力。如果一根卷须被切断或被破坏, 树绳妖也会迅速长出新的卷须作替代。

specialAbilities.name: 伪装外表 False Appearance
specialAbilities.description: 当腐藤怪保持静止不动时，它与普通的洞穴地貌（例如石笋）无法区分。

specialAbilities.name: 攫握触须 Grasping Tendrils
specialAbilities.description: 腐藤怪同时最多可拥有六条触须。每条触须都可以被攻击（AC 20；10生命值；免疫毒素和心灵伤害）。摧毁一条触须不会对腐藤怪造成伤害；腐藤怪可以在其下一回合挤出一条替代触须。触须也可以被折断：若一名生物使用一个动作，并对其进行一次DC 15力量检定且成功，即可折断该触须。

specialAbilities.name: 蜘蛛攀爬 Spider Climb
specialAbilities.description: 腐藤怪可以攀爬困难表面（包括在天花板上倒挂移动），且不需要进行属性检定。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 腐藤怪用其触须进行四次攻击，使用一次卷拉（Reel），并用其啃咬进行一次攻击。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+7命中，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：22（4d8 + 4）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 触须 Tendril
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+7命中，触及50尺，单一生物。命中：目标被擒抱（逃脱DC 15）。直到该擒抱结束前，目标处于束缚（restrained）状态，且在力量检定和力量豁免上具有劣势，并且腐藤怪不能用同一条触须擒抱另一个目标。

actions.name: 卷拉 Reel
actions.description: 腐藤怪将每个位于其擒抱中的生物沿直线向它拉近至多25尺。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的怪异生物，潜伏于黑暗之中，身高近十尺，体积相当于一块巨石。它那庞大、结节状的躯体从一个宽阔且不平整的基座升起，基座似半石半肉，犹如活体与岩石的交织。躯干表面粗糙斑驳，灰色与板岩蓝交织其间，点缀着湿润的苔藓状生长，微光中隐隐闪烁。锯齿状的脊岭和矿物般的突起让它的皮肤宛若栖息洞穴的岩壁。

从它鼓胀的身体上伸出六根粗壮、光亮的触须，每根长度相当于一名人类的臂展，表面覆有黏稠的黏液。触须沿线布满细小的钩状绒毛，随时颤动卷曲，准备紧扣猎物。上半身中央有一只巨大的无眶眼，瞳孔狭长且如抛光黑曜石般玻璃光亮。眼下是一张宽阔的圆形巨口，裂开时可见排成行的石质锯齿牙齿，足以碾碎盔甲。

绞索怪保持低伏盘卷的姿态，犹如一根休眠的石笋，但其沉重身躯之下隐隐荡漾着不安的张力。它的静止更像是捕猎的警戒而非安宁，滴落的黏液声在暗处回响，进一步加深了那古老而耐心的饥饿感，随时准备发动致命一击。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil monstrosity that lurks in darkness, standing nearly ten feet tall and occupying the space of a boulder. Its massive, knotted body rises from a broad, uneven base that seems half stone and half living flesh. The surface of its torso is rough and mottled, blending gray and slate-blue hues with patches of wet, lichen-like growth that glisten faintly in the dim light. Jagged ridges and mineral-like protrusions make its hide resemble the walls of the caverns it inhabits.  

From its bulbous body extend six thick, glistening tendrils, each as long as a human arm span and coated with sticky slime. Along the tendrils’ length are tiny hooked bristles that twitch and curl, ready to latch onto prey. A single large, lidless eye glares from the upper half of the creature, its pupil narrow and glassy like polished obsidian. Below it, a wide, circular maw splits open to reveal rows of stony, jagged teeth capable of crushing armor.  

The roper holds itself low and coiled, like a dormant stalagmite, but an unsettling tension ripples beneath its heavy form. Its stillness is predatory rather than calm, and the faint sound of dripping slime only heightens the sense of an ancient, patient hunger waiting to strike.

monsters.name: 锈蚀怪
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 11
monsters.description:
“毁掉我锤子和斧子的事儿是它干的。把我的

测验搞砸的事儿也是它那天干的。”

——杜马松 Dumathoun 的矮人圣武士,布

朗·雷石 Brawn Thunderstones

大多数矮人宁可面对一大队兽人也不愿遭遇一只锈蚀怪。这些时而温顺的奇特生物能够侵蚀黑色金属, 并对着生成的锈体狼吞虎咽。而它们已经以此摧毁了无数冒险者的护甲、盾牌和武器。

锈蚀怪身上披覆着厚重的波浪状甲壳, 长长的尾巴末端有一个骨质的突起,昆虫般的头部长着两根羽状的触角。

地底拾荒者 Underground Scavengers。锈蚀怪漫步于地下通道, 寻找各种黑色金属 (比如铁、钢、精金、秘银) 作为食物。 它们无视那些身上不带类似金属的生物, 但会对带有铁质武器和护甲的生物表现出攻击性。锈蚀怪能在远处闻到食物的味道, 然后立即冲向气味的源头以侵蚀并享用那些物品。

锈蚀怪并不介意他们享用的锈体是来源自长钉还是短剑。因此, 冒险者可以在身后扔下铁质物品从而转移锈蚀怪的注意力。

地下漫游者 Subterranean Wanderers。锈蚀怪时常独自狩猎或以小团体行动, 很少发现有大规模的聚居。它们漫步于地道和洞穴之间, 寻找合适的黑色金属供自己享用。也正因为这种游荡的习性, 其他栖息在幽暗地域的生物经常可以接触到这种无害而又难以摄食的物种。因此, 锈蚀怪也会生活在非常靠近其他地底怪物的栖息地。此外, 获得良好的照料和喂食的锈蚀怪也有可能成为友好的伙伴或宠物。

specialAbilities.name: 铁腥嗅觉 Iron Scent
specialAbilities.description: 锈蚀兽可以通过嗅觉精确定位其30尺内的含铁金属所在位置。

specialAbilities.name: 锈蚀金属 Rust Metal
specialAbilities.description: 任何非魔法的金属武器若命中锈蚀兽都会被腐蚀。在造成伤害后，该武器的伤害掷骰承受一个永久且可累积的-1减值。若其减值降至-5，则该武器被摧毁。命中锈蚀兽的非魔法金属弹药在造成伤害后被摧毁。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+3命中，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d8 + 1）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 触角 Antennae
actions.description:
锈蚀兽腐蚀其能看见且位于其5尺内的一件非魔法含铁金属物体。若该物体未被穿戴或携带，则该触碰会摧毁其一个1尺立方体的部分。若该物体正被某生物穿戴或携带，则该生物可以进行一次DC 11敏捷豁免以避免锈蚀兽的触碰。
若被触碰的物体是正在被穿戴或携带的金属护甲或金属盾牌，则其所提供的AC获得一个永久且可累积的-1减值。护甲的AC被降低至10或盾牌的加值降至+0时即被摧毁。若被触碰的物体是一把被持握的金属武器，则其如“锈蚀金属（Rust Metal）”特性所述生锈。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立怪异生物，体长约六尺（从口鼻至尾部），站立时约五尺高，依靠拱形的昆虫状腿支撑。它的全身覆盖着厚实、相互重叠的护甲板，形似波纹起伏的锈红色甲壳。暗光下，表面散发出微弱的油腻腐蚀光泽，仿佛整个生物正被氧化蚕食。背部的外壳向上隆起，形成不规则的脊 ridge，隐约像破损金属的磨损边缘。

头部呈楔形，具昆虫特征，拥有狭窄的口部和两根不断抽动的羽状触角，嗅探空气中的铁痕。眼睛是小而暗淡的黑色球体，深嵌于眼窝中，传递出一种本能的饥饿而非智慧。四肢强壮且关节分明，末端是钩状爪，适合在石板地面上快速爬行并紧贴洞壁。后体伸出一条鞭状尾巴，尾端带有一根骨质带刺的突起，平时懒散摆动，感知猎物时则骤然甩出。

锈蚀怪的移动呈现出快速而抽动的动作——警觉却不自然。虽然它的出现并不显得凶恶，但它所携带的无声腐蚀气息，却是一种潜伏的恐惧，专门侵蚀一切金属制品。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral monstrosity, roughly six feet long from snout to tail, and stands about five feet tall on its arched, insectoid legs. Its body is covered in thick, overlapping plates of armor, shaped like rippling segments of rust-red chitin. The surface gleams faintly in dim light with an oily, corroded sheen, giving the impression that the creature itself is half-eaten by oxidation. Along its back, the shell rises into uneven ridges that vaguely resemble the worn edges of broken metal.

The head is wedge-shaped and insect-like, with a narrow mouth and two feathery antennae twitching constantly, tasting the air for traces of iron. Its eyes are small, dull black orbs set deep into sockets, conveying a simple, instinctive hunger rather than intellect. The limbs are strong and jointed, ending in hooklike claws suited for scuttling across stone floors and clinging to cave walls. From its hind body extends a long whip-like tail tipped with a bony, spiked protrusion that swings lazily, then sharply when the creature senses prey.

The rust monster moves with quick, jerking motions—alert yet unnatural. Though its presence is not overtly menacing, the aura it carries is one of silent corrosion, a creeping dread for anything forged of metal.

monsters.name: 沙华鱼人
monsters.alignment: 或对沙华鱼人具威胁的社群。仅是马林提存在的苗头就足以激起海精灵间的多虑与怀疑
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 120 尺,被动察觉 15

specialAbilities.name: 嗜血狂暴 Blood Frenzy
specialAbilities.description: 鲨鱼人对任何未处于满生命值的生物进行近战攻击检定时具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 有限两栖 Limited Amphibiousness
specialAbilities.description: 鲨鱼人能够呼吸空气与水，但它必须至少每4小时浸没一次于水中，否则会窒息。

specialAbilities.name: 鲨鱼心灵感应 Shark Telepathy
specialAbilities.description: 鲨鱼人能以魔法通过有限的心灵感应指挥其120尺内的任何鲨鱼。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 鲨鱼人进行两次近战攻击：一次用其啃咬，一次用其利爪或长矛。

actions.name: 啃咬 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：3（1d4+1）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 利爪 Claws
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：3（1d4+1）挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 长矛 Spear
actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺或射程20/60尺，单一目标。命中：4（1d6+1）穿刺伤害；若以双手进行近战攻击，则命中：5（1d8+1）穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只守序邪恶的人形生物，属于沙华鱼人族类。身高约六尺，拥有 unmistakable 的捕食性海洋生物形态，能够在水下与陆地上皆自如生存。其躯体强壮有力，肩膀宽阔，绷紧的肌肉在光滑、覆鳞的皮肤下起伏。鳞片在绿与深青绿的色调中闪烁，向下渐变为如沙与珊瑚斑驳的苍白腹部。修长的四肢以蹼足收尾，指爪为黑色利爪，锋利得足以撕裂鱼肉或血肉。

沙华鱼人的面容宛如深渊噩梦——拉长而棱角分明，颈部沿线布满脉动的鳃裂。宽大的口中排列着一排排针状牙齿，怒吼时湿润闪光。圆鼓且玻璃质的深翡翠色眼睛如鲨鱼之眸，捕捉每一道光辉，映射出冷峻而算计的意识。一条短小的背鳍自头骨顶部沿脊柱向下延伸，随其移动轻微摆动。

此生物保持警觉而绷紧的姿态，每一次动作都受控且刻意，展现出捕食者的优雅而非柔美。其存在散发出威慑却有序的气息——一位受残酷秩序束缚的顶级猎手，持续散发着对其水域统治的静默、恒久威胁。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil humanoid of the sahuagin kind. Standing about six feet tall, it possesses the unmistakable form of a predatory sea creature adapted for life both underwater and on shore. Its body is powerfully built, with broad shoulders and corded muscles that ripple beneath slick, scaled skin. The scales shimmer in shades of green and dark turquoise, fading to a pale underside mottled like sand and coral. Its long limbs end in webbed hands and feet tipped with black claws sharp enough to tear fish or flesh.  

The sahuagin’s face is that of a nightmare from the deep—elongated and angular, with gill slits pulsing along its neck. Its wide mouth bristles with rows of needlelike teeth that gleam wetly when it snarls. Bulbous, glassy eyes of deep emerald reflect every glint of light like those of a shark, betraying a cold and calculating awareness. A short dorsal fin runs from the top of its skull down its spine, flexing subtly as it moves.  

The creature stands alert and tense, every motion controlled and deliberate, suggesting predatory grace rather than elegance. Its presence is menacing but disciplined—an apex hunter bound by cruel order, exuding the quiet, constant threat of something that knows it rules its watery domain.

monsters.name: 火蜥蜴
monsters.description:
火蜥蜴是一种生活在炽热火山洞穴和熔岩河岸的中型元素生物。它们的鳞片呈现出炽红的色泽，仿佛燃烧的岩浆在其体表流动。火蜥蜴天生对火焰有强大的亲和力，常在炽热的环境中觅食，捕食掉入熔岩的生物或利用炽热的体温将猎物烤熟。它们的出现往往预示着火山的活跃或地下热流的涌动，因而被冒险者视为危险的先兆。

火蜥蜴性情凶猛且自私，属于中立邪恶阵营。它们不会主动攻击除非受到挑衅，但一旦被激怒，便会利用自身的火焰能力进行毁灭性的打击。火蜥蜴擅长在暗处潜伏，利用暗视在黑暗的岩洞中追踪猎物，随后以迅猛的爪击和炽热的火焰喷射将其撕裂。尽管体型仅为中型，但其火焰本质使其在战斗中拥有不容小觑的威胁。

specialAbilities.name: 火焰抗性 Fire Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 对火焰伤害具有抗性，受到的火焰伤害减半。

specialAbilities.name: 暗视 Darkvision
specialAbilities.description: 在黑暗中可见至60尺，视为明亮的环境。

specialAbilities.name: 元素形态 Elemental Nature
specialAbilities.description: 对非魔法的物理攻击具有免疫，免疫毒素和疾病。

actions.name: 爪击 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+4命中，触及5尺。命中造成1d6+2点穿刺伤害，并附加1d6点火焰伤害。

actions.name: 火焰喷射 Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: 火蜥蜴向前方60尺的锥形喷射炽热火焰。每个在范围内的生物必须进行一次DC 12的敏捷豁免，豁免成功则受到2d6点火焰伤害，失败则受到2d6+2点火焰伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的元素生物，由活火与熔融岩石构成。它约六尺高，拥有纤细却结实的类人体格，身躯如盘旋的力量，宛若蓄势待发的捕食者。光滑的深红黑色鳞片覆于其皮肤，每一片鳞甲都闪烁着仿佛热量自内部散发的光辉。发光的橙色血脉纹路在其胸膛与手臂上微微跳动，犹如被困于表层之下的岩浆河流。

它的头部狭长且似爬行动物，后方拱起的弯曲角脊环绕其侧，热浪使周围空气扭曲。两只发光的黄眼在深陷的眼窝中燃烧，目光锐利且算计。口部裂成一排锯齿状的黑曜石牙齿，似永燃的赤热，呼出的每一次嘶息都伴随微弱的余烬光辉。

细长而有力的手臂以爪形之手收尾，爪锋如冷却的熔岩般黑曜且裂纹，能够快速而精准地动作。它的腿为趾行结构，肌肉弹性十足，随时可猛然冲刺；一条蛇形尾巴在身后扫动，闪烁着火花。该生物姿态半蹲且警惕，所有动作流畅而充满克制的威胁感。其周围环绕着摇曳的热气光环，仿佛连空气也因其存在而退缩。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil elemental creature composed of living fire and molten stone. Standing about six feet tall, it has a lean yet muscular humanoid frame, its body built with coiling strength like a predator poised to strike. Glossy, crimson-black scales cover its skin, each plate glimmering as though heat radiates from beneath. The patterns of glowing orange veins pulse faintly across its chest and arms, resembling rivers of magma trapped beneath the surface.  

Its head is narrow and reptilian, framed by curved horn ridges that arch backward, heat distorting the air around them. Two luminous yellow eyes burn within deep sockets, their stare sharp and calculating. The mouth splits into a line of jagged, obsidian teeth that seem perpetually red-hot, a faint ember glow escaping with every hissed breath.  

Long, sinewy arms end in clawed hands with talons blackened and cracked like cooled lava, capable of swift and precise movement. Its legs are digitigrade, coiled with elastic muscle for sudden lunges, and a serpentine tail sweeps behind it, shimmering with sparks. The creature’s posture is half-crouched and wary, every motion fluid and alive with restrained menace. A wavering aura of heat shimmers around it, giving the impression that the air itself recoils from its presence.

monsters.name: 火蛇
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10

specialAbilities.name: 灼热之躯Heated Body
specialAbilities.description: 生物触碰火蛇,或者在其周边 5 尺范围内以近战攻击命中火蛇时,将受到 3(1d6)的火焰伤害

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 火蛇发动两次攻击:一次啃咬攻击和一次尾击。

actions.name: 啃咬Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+3,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:3(1d4+1)的穿刺伤害,外加 3(1d6)的火焰伤害。

actions.name: 尾击 Tail
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+3,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:3(1d4+1)的钝击伤害,外加 3(1d6)的火焰伤害。

actions.name: 灼热之躯Heated Body
actions.description: 生物触碰火蜥蜴,或者在其周边 5 尺范围内以近战攻击命中火蜥蜴时,将受到 7(2d6)的火焰伤害。

actions.name: 灼热武器 Heated Weapons
actions.description: 火蜥蜴持用任何金属质近战武器命中目标时, 都可以额外造成 3(1d6)的火焰伤害(已包含在攻击条目中)。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的元素生物，由活火与熔融本质构成。约有六尺长，形似巨大的巨蛇，身体柔软灵活，盘旋扭曲，宛如液态火焰。形体纤细却充满力量，每一次动作都在空气中留下热浪的涟漪。外表面闪烁着燃烧的橙色与深红色交替的光纹，皮肤的裂缝中透出熔化的金色核心。鳞片如玻璃般半透明，偶尔会脱落火星，向上飘散如细小的余烬。

其头部呈楔形，细长的颚部排满闪亮的熔融獠牙。两道明亮的白焰裂缝充当眼睛，燃烧着充满智慧的凝视。呼吸时，鼻孔中偶尔会闪现火舌。蛇的动作流畅而精准，盘绕并以惊人的速度发动攻击。热浪扭曲环绕其身，犹如活生生的光环，扭曲周围的空气。

整体存在令人不安却又令人陶醉——宛如火山之心锻造的捕食者，动作优美却散发致命危机。它爬行的每一路径都会留下暗淡的余烬，炙烤的土地与淡淡的烟雾气味标记着它的行踪。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil elemental creature formed of living flame and molten essence. About six feet long, it resembles a great serpent with a sinuous, agile body that coils and twists as if made of liquid fire. Its form is lean but powerful, every movement leaving ripples of heat in the air. The outer surface glows with alternating streaks of burning orange and deep crimson, while fissures in its hide expose a core of molten gold. Its scales appear glassy and half‑translucent, occasionally shedding sparks that drift upward like tiny embers.  

The creature’s head is wedge‑shaped, with elongated jaws lined by gleaming, molten fangs. Twin slits of bright white flame serve as eyes, burning with an intelligent focus. Occasionally, tongues of fire flicker from its nostrils as it breathes. The serpent’s movements are smooth and precise, coiling and striking with startling speed. Heat distortion surrounds its body like a living aura, warping the air around it.  

Its overall presence is unsettling yet mesmerizing—a predator wrought from the heart of a volcano, beautiful in motion but radiating danger. Dull embers trace its path wherever it slithers, marking its passage with scorched earth and the faint scent of smoke.

monsters.name: 半羊人
monsters.description:
半羊人（Satyr）是居住在森林深处的妖精族群，以放荡不羁、热爱音乐与酒宴而闻名。它们拥有上半身的人形与下半身的山羊特征，长有弯曲的角和蹄子，常在月光下弹奏竖琴或笛子，引诱旅人进入迷幻的舞蹈中。半羊人对自然与自由有着强烈的执念，常在森林中设下陷阱或用迷惑的歌声引导敌人走向死亡，却也会在合适的时机帮助那些尊重自然的冒险者。

在战斗中，半羊人利用其敏捷的身手与天生的魔法抗性，轻巧地在战场上跳跃，利用短弓进行远程攻击，或用锐利的角进行近战冲锋。它们的狂欢本性使其行为不可预测，常在战斗间隙发出嘲讽的笑声，扰乱敌人的注意力。尽管体型不大，但半羊人的妖精血脉赋予了它们对魔法的天然抵抗，使其在面对法术时拥有不小的优势。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 萨堤对抗法术与其他魔法效应的豁免检定具有优势。

actions.name: 撞角 Ram
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：6（2d4+1）钝击伤害。

actions.name: 短剑 Shortsword
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：6（1 d6+3）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 短弓 Shortbow
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：命中+5，射程80/320尺，单一目标。命中：6（1d6+3）穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱中立的妖精生物，身高约五尺半，体形优雅地融合了人类与山羊的特征。上半身纤细却结实，光滑的黄褐色皮肤在林冠下微微泛光。前臂和肩部覆有细密的毛发，暗示其野性血脉。颞部向外延伸出一对短而光亮的角——深棕色且有棱纹，宛如山羊的角。其面容极为俊美，栗色的凌乱发丝环绕，永恒的嘲讽笑容散发出玩世不恭的自信。

其眼睛闪烁着琥珀金色的光辉，活泼而警觉，眼中带着顽皮的火花，透露出狡黠的思虑。下半身逐渐转为粗糙的深色毛皮，围绕着强壮的山羊腿，脚端是黑色的分趾蹄。每一次移动都带着敏捷的节奏，轻盈而精准，仿佛随无形的音乐而舞。周身弥漫着淡淡的林叶与酒香，姿态随意却随时准备弹跳。

这只半羊人的存在充满活力且难以预测——既不邪恶也不仁慈——散发出磁性的魅力和原始的自由感，呼应着其诞生之野性的混沌脉动。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral fey creature standing about five and a half feet tall, its frame a graceful blend of human and goat-like traits. The upper body is lean yet well-toned, with smooth tawny skin that glows faintly beneath the forest canopy. Fine trails of hair cover its forearms and shoulders, hinting at its wild lineage. From its temples curve a pair of short, polished horns—dark brown and ridged, like those of a mountain ram. Its face is strikingly handsome, framed by tousled locks of chestnut hair and a perpetual smirk that exudes playful confidence.  

The creature’s eyes gleam amber-gold, lively and alert, with a mischievous spark that reveals cunning thought. Its lower half transitions into coarse, dark fur that thickens around powerful goat legs ending in black cloven hooves. Each movement carries an agile rhythm, light and precise, as if timed to unseen music. A faint scent of woodland leaves and wine drifts around it, and its posture is casual yet ready to spring into motion.  

The satyr’s presence feels vibrant and unpredictable—neither sinister nor benevolent—radiating a magnetic charm and primal freedom that matches the chaotic pulse of the wild from which it came.

monsters.name: 稻草人
languages: 稻草人理解其创造者所掌握的语言
但不会说挑战等级:1(200 XP)
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10 语言:稻草人理解其创造者所掌握的语言,但不会说挑战等级:1(200 XP)
monsters.languages_text: 稻草人理解其创造者所掌握的语言,但不会说挑战等级:1(200 XP)
monsters.description:
每到收获季节, 各种枯败又再度造访盖满暮色的世界, 夏季的鲜花也枝头低垂的枯萎。怪异的稻草人矗立在空旷的原野,守望着夜空。伴随其不朽的耐心,这些坚忍的哨兵无论刮风下雨都站在其主人指定的岗位上, 渴望用自己的麻布丑脸吓傻猎物, 再用剃刀利爪撕开它们的肉体。
![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_255_0_362_858_1777_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_255_0_362_858_1777_0.jpg)
精魄驱动构装体 Spirit-Powered Constructs。稻草人的活力来自一个被杀死的邪恶生物所遗留的精魄, 它也会从中获取行动的目标与动机。这种来自死亡彼岸的诡异存在本身即赋予了稻草人借由凝视激起恐惧的能力。鬼婆或者巫师常常将恶魔的精魄束缚在稻草人中,而事实上任何邪恶的精魄都可以生效。尽管作为原料的精魄其人格的某些方面可能会浮现出来, 但稻草人的精魄无法回忆起它曾作为生物时的记忆, 而它的意念完全专注于服侍它的创造者。如果创造者死去, 栖居于稻草人内的精魄有可能继续执行主人最后的命令, 或是寻机为创造者复仇, 还有可能选择自我毁灭。
构装本质 Construct Nature。稻草人不需要空气, 饮食和睡眠。
稻草人 Scarecrow

specialAbilities.name: 拟形 False Appearance
specialAbilities.description: 静止不动的稻草人和普通非活化的稻草人几乎一模一样

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 稻草人发动两次爪击。

actions.name: 爪击Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+3,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:6(2d4+1)的挥砍伤害。如果目标是一生物,则目标必须进行一次 DC 11 的感知豁免, 豁免失败则陷入恐慌直到稻草人的下一回合结束。

actions.name: 恐惧怒视 Terrifying Glare
actions.description: 稻草人指定其周边 30 尺内一个它能看见的生物。如果目标也可以看到稻草人,则目标必须成功通过一次 DC 11 的感知豁免否则陷入魔法的恐慌,其效应持续至稻草人的下一回合结束时终止。该被恐慌目标同时陷入麻痹。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱邪恶的构造体，属于中型稻草人，由黑暗巫术所驱动。它约有六尺高，骨架由粗糙捆绑的木杆与细长稻草组成，全部用腐烂的麻绳紧紧缠绕。破旧的麻布衣物残片仍附着在其身上——补丁衬衫、破烂裤子，以及一顶歪斜、因潮湿而老化的帽子。它的体形瘦削，却以令人不安的人形比例呈现，内部的稻草在颤动中显得活泼而不安。

稻草人的面孔是一只下垂的麻袋，用粗糙的黑线缝成似笑非笑的形状。两侧空洞的眼窝微微发光，燃烧着诡异的橙色光芒，闪烁如垂死的余烬。它移动时嘴部的缝线会颤动，营造出怪诞的表情。其手臂以扭曲的木质手收尾，指尖长着锈蚀的爪状指甲，能够进行抽搐却迅捷的攻击。

它的姿态半弯腰，仿佛悬挂在看不见的横梁上，却能以突然而诡异的速度冲刺。潮湿的稻草和泥土黏附在四肢上，腐败的淡雾随其步伐弥散。此生物散发出可怕的耐心与沉默的威胁气息，讽刺地模仿着曾经的农夫守护者。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil construct, a medium-sized scarecrow animated by dark sorcery. It stands about six feet tall, its frame made of roughly lashed wooden poles and wiry straw bound together with rotting twine. Fragments of old burlap clothing cling to its form—patched shirts, torn trousers, and a crooked hat that droops with damp age. Its body is lean yet unsettlingly human in proportion, the straw within shifting with a twitching, life-like restlessness.  

The scarecrow’s face is a sagging sack stitched with crude black thread into the semblance of a grin. Two hollow eye sockets glow faintly from within, burning with an eerie orange light that flickers like dying embers. The seams of its mouth twitch when it moves, giving the illusion of grotesque expressions. Its arms end in gnarled wooden hands tipped with rusty, claw-like nails, capable of jerky yet swift movements.  

Its posture is half-slouched, as if hung from an invisible crossbeam, but it can lunge with sudden, uncanny speed. Damp straw and soil cling to its limbs, and a faint mist of decay follows its steps. The creature exudes an aura of dreadful patience and silent menace, a mockery of the farmers’ guardian it once was.

monsters.name: 幽影
monsters.skills: 隐匿+4(微光光照或黑暗环境中为+6)
damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10 语言: 一挑战等级:1/2 (100 XP)
monsters.description:
幽影是有如类人生物夸张化影子一样的不死生物。

暗影习性 Dark Disposition。来自黑暗的幽影会掠食活体生物的精力。它们可以摄食任何活物,却尤其偏爱尚未被邪恶污染的个体。生活在善良与虔诚中的生物会将自己所有的卑鄙念头和最大的欲求舍弃到黑暗之中,而幽影们也在这片黑暗中饥饿难耐。 幽影慢慢吸干受害者的力量和物理形体后, 受害者的影子也随之逐渐加深, 并开始按照其自己的意志行动。直至该生物死亡, 其影子将获得自由, 成为一只新的不死幽影继续掠食其他生命。

如果一个曾经产生幽影的生物以某种方式死而复生, 则其不死幽影会感应到他的回归。这个幽影会前去纠缠或杀死其本体。 而除非该幽影愿意追随其对应的活体生物, 否则该生物将不再投射出影子,直到其幽影被摧毁才能恢复原状。

不死本质 Undead Nature。幽影不需要空气, 饮食和睡眠。

specialAbilities.name: 无定形 Amorphous
specialAbilities.description: 影魔可以穿过最窄至1英寸宽的空间而无需挤压通过。

specialAbilities.name: 暗影潜行 Shadow Stealth
specialAbilities.description: 当处于微光或黑暗中时，影魔可以用一个附赠动作执行躲藏动作。其潜行加值也提升至+6。

specialAbilities.name: 阳光虚弱 Sunlight Weakness
specialAbilities.description: 当处于阳光下时，影魔的攻击检定、属性检定与豁免检定具有劣势。

actions.name: 力量汲取 Strength Drain
actions.description:
近战武器攻击：命中+4，触及5尺，单一生物。命中：9（2d6+2）黯蚀伤害，且目标的力量属性值降低1d4。若此效果使目标的力量降至0，则目标死亡。否则，该降低持续至目标完成一次短休或长休为止。
若一个非邪恶的人形生物因该攻击而死亡，则在其尸体上会于1d4小时后升起一只新的影魔。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种混乱邪恶亡灵生物，体型约等于人类，身高约六尺。其形体是一副扭曲的类人形轮廓，仿佛从黑暗之墙上被撕裂后拉伸、扭曲而成。躯体纤细而柔韧，四肢细长，末端收拢成由阴影般的烟雾塑成的爪形手。尽管身形脆弱，却每一次动作都异常流畅——迅捷、无声且充满捕食性，宛若失重。

其表面犹如凝固的黑夜——漆黑中带有淡淡的灰色波纹，犹如被扰动的水面。看不见真正的血肉或骨骼，只有层层流动的阴暗。面部所在之处只剩空洞的轮廓：淡淡的颧骨印记、一张冻结在无声饥渴中的嘴巴，以及两只苍白而雾状的眼睛，宛若垂死余烬般微光闪烁。这双眼睛从黑暗中刺出，凝视不眨。

它的双腿化作烟雾状的触须，在靠近地面时逐渐消散，似在滑行而非行走。移动时，形体的边缘会被撕裂，留下如星光点缀的淡淡烟迹。一层微弱的寒意环绕其周身，伴随光线仿佛被驱逐的错觉。整体而言，这生物散发出无声捕猎的光环——一种纯粹由阴影构成的生命的幽幽映像。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil undead creature, roughly the size of a human, standing about six feet tall. Its form is a distorted silhouette of a humanoid, stretched and twisted as though torn from a wall of darkness. The body is thin and wiry, with elongated limbs that taper into clawlike hands made of shadowy smoke. Despite its frail frame, every movement is unnervingly fluid—swift, silent, and predatory, as if weightless.  

Its surface looks like solidified night—black with faint ripples of gray that shift like disturbed water. No true flesh or bone is visible, only layers of shifting gloom. Where its face should be, there is a hollow contour: faint impressions of cheekbones, a mouth frozen in soundless hunger, and two pale, misty eyes that gleam like dying embers. These eyes pierce from the darkness, fixed and unblinking.  

The creature’s legs blur into smoky tendrils that dissolve near the ground, suggesting it glides rather than walks. When it moves, the edges of its form fray, leaving faint trails like smoke threaded with starlight. A faint chill surrounds it, accompanied by the impression that light itself recoils. Overall, the creature carries an aura of silent predation—a haunting reflection of life made purely of shadow.

monsters.name: 蔓生怪
monsters.skills: 隐匿+2 伤害抗性:冷冻,火焰伤害免疫:闪电状态免疫:目盲,耳聋,力竭感官:盲视 60 尺(该区域外视为目盲),被动察觉 10 语言:一挑战等级:5 (1800 XP)

monsters.description:
蔓生怪有时也被称为蹒跚者 Shambler, 它拖着沉重的步伐行走于荒凉的湿地、阴冷的沼泽和雨林之中, 以路过的一切有机体为食。这个由活化的植物纠缠在一起组成的腐烂堆积体, 其上半部分直立有近一人高,最顶部是则是它没有面孔的 “头”。
全面贪食者All-Consuming Devourers。蔓生怪以所有的有机体为食, 不知疲倦的进食其前进路上的植物和未及逃脱的动物。 它们仍未破坏整个生态系统的唯一原因是其罕见性和缓慢的速度。尽管如此, 他们的存在依然不停损害着动植物赖以生存的自然环境, 而这种饥饿不停的恐怖存在也使得林地和沼泽里弥漫着不安的寂静。
无形猎手 Unseen Hunter。蔓生怪身上覆盖着腐烂的树叶、 藤蔓、根茎和其他森林与沼泽的天然堆积物, 使其能够很好地融入环境之中。由于移动速度缓慢,蔓生怪很少主动追逐和捕捉猎物。它们更倾向停留在同一位置, 一边吸收周遭环境提供的养分一边等待猎物前来。生物靠近蔓生怪或在其身上落脚时, 它就会重新活跃,进而捆绑并吸收这些不谨慎的猎物。
闪电滋养 Spawned by Lightning。蔓生怪由普通沼泽植物经受闪电或妖精魔法激活而生。这些植物获得新生时,便会杀死周围所有的动植物并将它们的残骸堆积在根部附近。直到有一天, 它的根须放弃了对泥土的依恋, 便开始引导蔓生怪前去寻找新的食物来源。
行走的野草 The Weeds that Walks。驱使蔓生怪行动的本能源于那掩埋在其笨重身躯里的中心主茎。而蔓生怪不断累积和分解的腐殖物质则构成了它的余下部分, 而这些身体组成也可以为主茎提供保护, 还能用来拍击和绞缠其他生物。
蔓生怪厚重的身体阻挡了寒冷和火焰的效果。而闪电则反而会使根茎进一步激活, 进而强化蔓生怪并刺激其进食本能。
在其怪兽般的外表外, 蔓生怪其实还是一株需要空气和养分的活化植物。尽管蔓生怪不需要睡眠,但它在继续出发寻找食物前也可能会进行一段时间的休眠。
再生威胁 A Resurgent Menace。蔓生怪对抗强敌而濒临死亡时,它的主茎能够假装死亡并控制其余下部分轰然倒下。如果没被摧毁, 主茎就会深深植入蔓生怪的余下部分并缓慢恢复其完整的身体, 然后再次上路, 进食一切触及的生物。这也正是那些认定已经消灭的蔓生怪总会在一段时间后重新滋生的真正原因。 蔓生怪 Shambling Mound

specialAbilities.name: 闪电吸收 Lightning Absorption
specialAbilities.description: 每当腐沼怪受到闪电伤害时，它不受伤害，并恢复等同于造成的闪电伤害数值的生命值。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 腐沼怪进行两次重击攻击。若两次攻击均命中一个中型或更小的目标，则目标陷入被擒抱状态（逃脱DC 14），且腐沼怪对其使用吞没。

actions.name: 重击 Slam
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：13（2d8+4）钝击伤害。

actions.name: 吞没 Engulf
actions.description: 腐沼怪吞没一个被其擒抱的中型或更小生物。被吞没的目标陷入目盲、受束缚，并且无法呼吸；且其必须在腐沼怪每个回合开始时进行一次DC 14的体质豁免，失败则受到13（2d8+4）钝击伤害。若腐沼怪移动，被吞没的目标也随之移动。腐沼怪同时只能吞没一个生物。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立的植物生物，体型庞大，几乎高达十尺，横跨一块密集的 10×10 尺沼泽地。它的整体形态是一团纠结的湿藤、苔藓与根系，紧密交织，宛如一座摇摇晃晃的腐烂植被丘。粗壮的常春藤藤蔓和纤维状触须缠绕在其内部隐藏的树干般核心周围，微微搏动，仿佛在为这具潮湿的躯体输送生命。表面覆满水渍与泥土，闪烁着光泽，点缀着深绿、棕色和霉黑色的腐败斑块。

它的“头部”是一块无形的上部隆起——除了一些微弱的开口，像呼吸通风口般张开外，毫无特征。没有真正的眼睛或嘴巴，只有滴着的地衣丝垂挂，如同腐败的胡须。沉重的类肢体附肢向外伸展，由藤蔓束和半埋的根系构成，末端是撕裂的触须，能够抓握或碾压。每一次移动，整座丘体都以迟缓的柔韧性摇摆，泄漏出腐烂的叶片碎屑和沼泽污秽。

尽管行动缓慢，它仍散发出令人窒息的存在感——一种无意识、饥饿的自然之力。这座巨大的、无情的活体生长堆如同伪装成森林本身的原始捕食者，在雾气和停滞的水面中投射出怪诞且不可阻挡的轮廓。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral plant creature of formidable size, towering nearly ten feet tall and sprawling across a dense 10-by-10-foot patch of marshy ground. Its entire form is a tangled mass of wet vines, moss, and roots, woven together so tightly that it resembles a shambling hill of rotting vegetation. Thick cords of ivy and fibrous tendrils coil around a central trunk-like core hidden within its bulk, pulsing faintly as if pumping life through the creature’s soggy body. The surface glistens with water and mud, streaked by patches of dark green, brown, and mold-black decay.  

Its “head” lies as a shapeless upper bulge — featureless except for faint openings that gape like breathing vents. No true eyes or mouth appear, only dripping strands of lichen that hang like a beard of decomposition. Heavy limb-like appendages jut outward, formed of vine bundles and half-buried roots, each ending in shredded tendrils that clutch or crush. With every movement, the mound’s body shifts with sluggish flexibility, leaking fragments of decayed leaves and swamp filth.  

Despite its slow pace, it exudes a suffocating presence — a mindless, hungry force of nature. This massive, unfeeling heap of living growth looms like a primal predator disguised as the forest itself, its silhouette grotesque and unstoppable amidst mist and stagnant water.

monsters.name: 构装盾卫
languages: 理解用任何语言下达的命令但不会说
monsters.senses_text: 盲视 10 尺,黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 10
monsters.languages_text: 理解用任何语言下达的命令但不会说
monsters.description:
法师和其他施法者会制作构装盾卫来保护自己。这些构装盾卫会尾随它的主人,为其排除危险,并让主人尽可能保持安全。

主控护符 Master's Amulet。每个盾卫都与唯一的一个魔法护符相连, 一旦护符被摧毁, 盾卫也会随之陷入失能状态直至替代的护符制作完成。未被着装或携带的盾卫护符可以直接作为攻击对象。盾卫护符拥有 AC 10,10 点生命值,且免疫毒素和心灵攻击。制造一个盾卫护身符需要 1 周时间和 \( {1000}\mathrm{{gp}} \) 的材料。

构装盾卫唯一关注的就是如何保护盾卫护符的持有者。盾卫护符的持有者可以命令盾卫攻击敌人或协助抵抗攻击。即使距离甚远, 构装盾卫也会舍身前来抵挡将要命中护符持有者的攻击。

施法者可以将一项法术储存在盾卫体内, 并让其在受其命令或满足特定条件是施展。时常听到有人会埋怨法师的构装盾卫忽然施展强大魔力时并没能帮助抗敌,而是只能吓唬人。

可观财富 Magnificent Treasure。因为盾卫的所有权可以通过盾卫护符的转移而变更, 某些法师会通过为王公贵族和犯罪头目制造盾卫而赚取大量金钱。同时, 盾卫对那些杀死其主人而得到盾卫护符的人也是一件价值不菲的战利品。

构装本质 Construct Nature。构装盾卫不需要空气, 饮食和睡眠。

specialAbilities.name: 绑定 Bound
specialAbilities.description: 盾卫以魔法与一枚护符绑定。只要盾卫与其护符处于同一存在位面，护符的佩戴者就能以心灵感应召唤盾卫前来，并且盾卫知晓护符的距离与方向。若盾卫位于护符佩戴者60尺内，则佩戴者所受伤害的一半（向上取整）会转移至盾卫。

specialAbilities.name: 再生 Regeneration
specialAbilities.description: 若盾卫至少剩余1点生命值，则其在自己回合开始时恢复10点生命值。

specialAbilities.name: 法术储存 Spell Storing
specialAbilities.description: 佩戴盾卫护符的施法者可使盾卫储存一个4环或更低的法术。为此，佩戴者必须对盾卫施放该法术。该法术不产生效果，但会被储存在盾卫体内。当佩戴者下令，或当出现由施法者预先设定的情形时，盾卫会以原施法者设定的任何参数施放该储存法术，且不需要任何成分。当该法术被施放或有新法术被储存时，任何先前储存的法术都会消失。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 盾卫进行两次拳击攻击。

actions.name: 拳击 Fist
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：11（2d6+4）钝击伤害。

reactions.name: 护盾 Shield
reactions.description: 当一个生物对盾卫护符的佩戴者进行一次攻击时，若盾卫位于佩戴者5尺内，则盾卫使佩戴者的AC获得+2加值。

monsters.appearance:
这是一具中立构装体，身高近十尺，专为不懈守卫而铸。其躯干庞大而结实，由厚重的暗色光亮金属板拼接而成，犹如粗糙的盔甲相互叠覆。每个关节皆以粗壮的机械铰链加固，兼具力量与出人意料的灵活。金属表面布满凹痕、划痕以及绿锈斑点，暗示它历经无数战斗。

面孔是对人类的扭曲模仿——宽阔而棱角分明的下颚、凹陷的面颊以及一块宽阔平坦的鼻板。成对的圆形眼睛散发出暗淡而稳固的琥珀光，深嵌于如装甲眉毛般的硬钢骨脊之下。嘴巴固定在一副阴沉、不可动摇的皱眉之中，狭窄的裂口后可见锯齿状的金属牙齿。

手臂如钢梁般粗壮，末端是带有钝重指头的大手，每根指头都装有短钩，以便抓握盾牌和武器。其粗壮的双腿专为平衡与耐久而设计，脚部宽阔平坦的金属足每一步都重重砸向地面。它站姿高挑，肩部方正，胸前紧握盾牌，散发出不可动摇的威慑气息——外形丑陋却毫无疑问地令人畏惧。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral construct, towering at nearly ten feet tall, built to guard with unwavering vigilance. Its frame is massive and muscular, shaped from heavy plates of dark, burnished metal that overlap like crude armor. Each joint is reinforced with thick mechanical hinges, giving it both power and surprising agility. The metal surface is marred with dents, scratches, and patches of verdigris, hinting at countless battles endured.  

Its face is a grotesque imitation of humanity—wide, angular jaw, sunken cheeks, and a broad, flat nose plate. Twin circular eyes glow a dim, steady amber, set deep beneath a bony ridge of hardened steel that resembles an armored brow. The mouth is fixed in a grim, unmoving scowl, with jagged metallic teeth visible behind narrow slits.  

Arms like steel beams end in large hands with blunt, crushing fingers, each tipped with short hooks for gripping shields and weapons. Its thick legs are built for balance and endurance, ending in broad, flat metal feet that slam into the ground with each step. The creature stands tall, shoulders squared, shield clasped tightly against its chest, exuding an aura of implacable menace—ugly yet undeniably formidable.

monsters.name: 骷髅
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺, 被动察觉 9
monsters.languages_text: 理解深渊语, 但不会说

specialAbilities.name: 冲击 Charge
specialAbilities.description: 如果骷髅在顶撞攻击之前向目标直线移动至少10尺,则目标将受额外9(2d8)的穿刺伤害,如果目标是生物,则其必须进行一次DC 14的力量豁免,豁免失败则被推开至多10尺并应击倒地。

actions.name: 巨斧 Greataxe
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+6,触及 5 尺,单一目标。 伤害:17(2d12+4)的挥砍伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只守序邪恶的亡灵生物。它约有六尺高，形似人形，却全身由发黄、风化的骨骼构成。每根肋骨和关节都被腐烂的筋腱残余紧紧束缚，使骷髅拥有坚固、结实的框架，暗示出超乎常理的力量。四肢比例恰当但纤细，骨骼厚实而坚硬，在任何光线下都微微发光，仿佛多年不安的运动已将其抛光。它的动作异常精准——每一步都刻意、受控且无声，流露出死者中罕见的诡异敏捷。

头骨上有淡淡的裂纹和深深的岁月刻痕，空洞的眼眶中闪烁着暗红的微光，犹如垂死余烬的闪烁。破碎的牙齿排列在下颚，形成一个永恒的、扭曲的恶意笑容。锈蚀的盔甲碎片紧贴在胸膛和肩部，沾染着干涸的血迹与腐蚀痕迹，而一件破烂的斗篷松散地垂在身后，宛如实体的阴影。

它的姿态笔直而严肃，几乎带有军纪般的规矩，散发出亡灵的冷峻秩序。其周围的空气沉重而压抑，仿佛被这生物的无声恶意所吸引——这是一种静默却可触的证据，表明这位亡灵战士服从于黑暗且坚定不移的使命。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil undead creature. It stands about six feet tall, humanoid in form but composed entirely of yellowed, weathered bones. Each rib and joint is tightly bound by remnants of decayed sinew, giving the skeleton a robust, solid frame that suggests unnatural strength. The limbs are proportionate but lean, the bones thick and sturdy, gleaming faintly under any light as if polished by years of restless motion. Its movements are unnervingly precise—each step deliberate, controlled, and silent, betraying an eerie agility rarely found in the dead.  

The skull bears faint cracks and deep etchings of age, its empty eye sockets glowing with a dim crimson light that flickers like dying embers. Broken teeth line its jaw, forming a grotesque grin frozen in eternal malice. Rusted fragments of armor cling to its torso and shoulders, streaked with dried blood and corrosion, while a tattered cloak hangs loosely behind it like a shadow in physical form.  

Its posture is upright and disciplined, almost military, exuding the cold order of undeath. The air around it feels heavy and oppressive, as if drawn by the creature’s silent malevolence—a quiet but tangible proof that this undead warrior obeys a dark, unwavering purpose.

monsters.name: 史拉蟾
monsters.description:
史拉蟾（Slaadi）是源自混沌位面——混沌平原（Limbo）的原始异怪，拥有强大的变形与繁殖能力。它们的身体呈蛙状，皮肤光滑且常带有鲜艳的色彩，红色史拉蟾尤其凶猛且好战。史拉蟾的出现往往伴随着空间的扭曲与混沌能量的泄漏，它们在寻找新的领地时会穿越次元裂隙，将混沌的种子播撒到凡间世界的每一个角落。

作为混乱中立的生物，史拉蟾既不会主动追随善恶，也不受任何秩序束缚。它们的社会结构极其简单：强者统治弱者，弱小者则被吞噬或转化为新的史拉蟾。红色史拉蟾以其凶残的攻击手段和对魔法的天然抵抗而闻名，常在沼泽、深渊或被遗忘的古老遗迹中潜伏，等待不慎闯入的冒险者成为它们的猎物。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 (Magic Resistance)
specialAbilities.description: 对法术和其他魔法效果进行的豁免检定具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 两栖 (Amphibious)
specialAbilities.description: 可以在水中和陆地上呼吸，且在水下移动速度不受影响。

specialAbilities.name: 心灵感应 (Telepathy 120 ft.)
specialAbilities.description: 能够在120尺范围内以心灵方式与其他生物交流，语言限制为史拉蟾语言或通用语。

actions.name: 咬击 (Bite)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中加值 +6，范围 5 尺，一个目标。命中造成 13 (2d8+4) 点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 利爪 (Claws)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中加值 +6，范围 5 尺，一个目标。命中造成 9 (1d8+4) 点挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 尾击 (Tail)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中加值 +6，范围 10 尺，一个目标。命中造成 9 (1d8+4) 点钝击伤害。

monsters.appearance:
它是一种混乱中立的异常生物。该生物约有十英尺高，呈笨重的两栖形态，诞生于另一位面的翻腾混沌之中。它的身体粗壮而肌肉发达，覆有光滑、闪亮的皮肤，颜色如湿润的赤红黏土，交织着斑驳的紫色和绿色纹理。其肉体带有淡淡的半透明感，隐约可见交错的肌肉绳索和跳动的血管。每一次动作都迅捷且难以预测——它的四肢以异常的柔韧性弯曲，仿佛能够以惊人的速度跃起或扭转。

它的头宽大且似蟾蜍，张开的巨口排列着一排排锯齿状的牙齿，闪耀如磨光的骨骼。鼓胀的眼球从颅骨中凸出，琥珀与翠绿的色彩在其中旋转，永不平静。它的口缘始终湿润，滴落的黏稠液体触地时发出嘶嘶声。粗壮的爪子从指尖和脚趾弯曲而出，表面有细小裂纹，在微光中闪烁。

它半蹲的姿态随时准备弹射，肌肉在光亮的皮肤下紧绷如弹簧。一种令人不安的不稳定光环环绕其身——原始的活力混杂着异界的威胁，仿佛它的存在扭曲空气，威胁着将周围的现实撕裂。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration. The creature stands roughly ten feet tall, a hulking amphibian shape born from the swirling chaos of another plane. Its body is thickset and muscular, covered in slick, glistening skin the color of wet crimson clay streaked with mottled shades of purple and green. The flesh has a faint translucence, revealing knotting cords of muscle and pulsing veins beneath. Each movement is quick and unpredictable—its limbs bend with unnatural flexibility, suggesting a creature that can leap or twist with uncanny speed.  

Its head is wide and toadlike, with a gaping maw lined by rows of jagged teeth that gleam like polished bone. Bulbous eyes protrude from its skull, swirling with hues of amber and viridian that never hold still. The edges of its mouth seem constantly wet, dripping with viscous strands that hiss as they touch the ground. Thick claws curve from its fingers and toes, etched with small fractures that catch the dim light.  

Its stance is half-crouched and ready to spring, muscles coiled beneath its glistening hide. An unsettling aura of instability clings to it—raw vitality mixed with alien menace, as if the creature’s very presence bends the air and threatens to unravel reality around it.

monsters.name: 史拉红蟾
monsters.senses_text: 黑暗视觉 60 尺,被动察觉 11
monsters.languages_text: 史拉蟾语, 心灵感应 60 尺

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 史拉蟾为抵抗法术和其它魔法效应而作的豁免检定具有优势

specialAbilities.name: 再生 Regeneration
specialAbilities.description: 史拉蟾在其自己的回合开始时恢复 10 点生命值, 前提是它至少有 1 点生命值

actions.name: 多重攻击Multiattack
actions.description: 史拉蟾发动三次攻击:一次啃咬,以及两次爪击。

actions.name: 啃咬Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+6,触及 5 尺,单一目标。伤害:8(2d4+3)的穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 爪击 Claws
actions.description: 近战武器攻击:命中+6,触及 5 尺,单一目标。 伤害:7(1d8+3)的穿刺伤害。如果目标是一类人生物,则其必须成功通过一次 DC 14 的体质豁免否则感染疾病——史拉蟾微卵 minuscule slaad egg。

actions.name: 一个类人生物一次只能携带一枚史拉蟾卵
actions.description: 三个月后, 卵移动到胸腔,并孵化形成史拉蟾蝌蚪。诞生前 24 小时,宿主开始感觉不适,因此速度减半,其攻击检定、属性检定和豁免检定具有劣势。诞生时, 蝌蚪吃穿生命器官并在 1 轮内遁出体外, 并在此过程中杀死宿主。

monsters.appearance:
它是一种混乱中立的异常生物，体型庞大，身高接近十尺，散发着怪异的活力。它的身体是一团绳状、脉动的肌肉，皮肤紧绷在躯体上，宛如湿润的皮革。皮肤光滑呈血红色，斑驳着暗色斑块，在光线下微微闪烁，呈现出近似两栖动物的光泽。粗壮的四肢以带爪且有蹼的手足收尾，既像是用来撕裂肉体，也适合在浑浊沼泽中跳跃。它宽阔的躯干呈弓形，似乎始终绷紧，随时准备弹射或冲刺。

它的头部宽大且似蟾蜍，张开的无唇口中排列着锯齿状、不规则的牙齿。凸起的眼睛呈淡黄色，瞳孔狭长，闪烁着不安的警觉，却缺乏真正的智慧，散发出野性且令人不安的凝视。骨质脊 ridge 沿背部和头骨延伸，皮肤坚韧、满是伤疤与老茧，似经千百场战斗磨砺。它移动时，肌肉起伏，蕴含原始的兽力，尽管体型庞大，却仍显灵活。

它身上弥漫着潮湿血液与沼泽的腐臭，其存在散发出混乱的威胁——原始饥渴与野蛮暴力的活生生化身。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration, a hulking creature that stands nearly ten feet tall and looms with monstrous vitality. Its body is a mass of corded, pulsating muscle, the hide stretched tight over its frame like wet leather. The skin is a slick, crimson red, mottled with darker patches that shimmer faintly under light, giving it an almost amphibian sheen. Thick limbs end in clawed, webbed hands and feet that look made for both rending flesh and leaping through murky swamps. Its broad torso rises into a hunched posture, as if always tensed to spring or lunge.

The creature’s head is wide and toad-like, with a gaping, lipless mouth lined with jagged, irregular teeth. Bulbous eyes—pale yellow with slitted pupils—gleam with restless awareness yet lack true intellect, giving it a feral, unsettling stare. Bony ridges run along its back and skull, and its skin appears tough, scarred, and calloused from countless battles. When it moves, its muscles ripple with raw, animal power, agile despite its bulk. A foul odor of damp blood and marsh clings to it, and its presence exudes chaotic menace—a living embodiment of primal hunger and untamed violence.

monsters.appearance: 史拉蓝蟾是一种混乱中立的异形，身高约十尺，拥有笨重的蟾蜍形体，肌肉密布，起伏有致。它的躯干宽阔而弓背，既适合蛮力的猛击，也能在瞬间完成流畅的移动。全身皮肤呈深蔚蓝色，斑驳着更暗的斑块，表面湿润且布满疙瘩，在光线下闪烁着如同永沾水汽的光泽。粗壮的四肢以带爪的蹼状指尖收尾，既能撕裂血肉，也能在浑浊沼泽中划水前进。头部宽而矮，鼻口钝圆，口中布满锯齿状、不规则的内弯獠牙。两只硕大的眼睛散发出令人不安的智慧光芒，瞳孔细长且不断快速转动，仿佛在计算周围的每一次动静。脊柱沿线有细小的棱脊，随姿势的变化轻微抽动。呼吸时发出湿润、低沉的喘息声，伴随远处的呱鸣在喉间回荡。长而有力的尾巴拖在身后，行进时在地面留下凹槽。整体给人的印象是一只强大、异域的捕食者——躁动不安、难以预测且极具危险性，散发出原始活力与混沌威胁的气息。
monsters.appearanceEn: This is a chaotic neutral aberration, towering about ten feet tall with a hulking, toadlike frame that ripples with dense muscle. Its body is broad and hunched, built for both brutal strength and sudden, fluid motion. The creature’s skin is a deep cerulean blue, mottled with darker patches and a slick, warty texture that glistens under light as though perpetually damp. Thick limbs end in clawed, webbed digits capable of rending flesh or propelling it through murky swamps. The head is wide and squat, with a blunt snout and a mouth full of jagged, uneven fangs that curve inward. Two bulbous eyes gleam with unsettling intelligence, their pupils narrow and constantly flicking as if calculating every movement around them. Small ridges trace along its spine, twitching slightly as it shifts its stance. Breathing comes in wet, guttural huffs, accompanied by distant croaks that echo in its throat. A long, muscular tail trails behind, dragging grooves in the ground as it moves. The overall impression is that of a powerful, alien predator—restless, unpredictable, and dangerous, exuding an aura of raw vitality and chaotic menace.

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱中立的畸形生物，体型庞大的绿史拉德。它约有十尺高，弓背的身躯由强壮、似青蛙般的四肢支撑，四肢肥厚，肌腱绷紧。它的身体宽厚且胸膛宽大，暗示着惊人的体力，却又以令人不安的敏捷移动，每一次动作都像被绷紧的弹簧，随时准备弹射。

它的皮肤呈斑驳的绿色，背部为深翡翠色，腹部则是病态的橄榄绿，光滑且布满疙瘩，宛如两栖动物的皮肤。沿脊柱的浅沟泛着淡淡的黏液光泽，在微光下闪烁。它的头宽而矮，中心是一张巨大的口腔，里面排满了锯齿状、发黄的獠牙。小鼻孔位于口腔上方微微张开，眼睛圆而无睑，淡红色的瞳孔闪烁着一种空洞而令人不安的光辉。

它的长臂以爪形手掌收尾，既能抓握也能撕裂；后肢粗壮且关节发达，适合弹跳。身体散发出淡淡的沼泽腐败气味。它低伏蹲踞，每一次动作既流畅又难以预测，散发出一种混沌而凶险的气场，暗示着潜伏在其皮革般外壳下的猛烈力量随时可能爆发。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration, a large creature known as a Green Slaad. It stands roughly ten feet tall, its hunched frame supported by powerful, frog‑like limbs thick with muscle and sinew. Its body is bulky and broad-chested, the proportions hinting at immense physical strength, yet it moves with unsettling agility, every motion coiled and ready to spring.  

The creature’s skin is a mottled green, ranging from dark emerald on its back to a sickly olive along the belly, slick and warty like that of an amphibian. Shallow ridges run down its spine, glistening with a faint, mucous sheen that catches dim light. Its head is wide and squat, dominated by a cavernous mouth filled with rows of jagged, yellowed fangs. Small nostrils flare above the mouth, and its eyes—round, lidless, and pale red—glimmer with an unsettling, vacant intensity.  

Its long arms end in clawed hands capable of both grasping and rending, while its hind legs are thick and jointed for leaping. A faint reek of swamp and decay emanates from its body. The creature crouches low, every movement both fluid and unpredictable, exuding a chaotic and menacing aura that warns of sudden, violent power barely restrained beneath its leathery hide.

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱中立的异常生物，诞生于变动的混沌与原始活力之中。它约有六尺高，灰色史拉灰蟾拥有强壮的两栖体格——皮肤呈斑驳的灰色皮革状，光滑微湿，犹如雨后石面，肌肉在其下鼓胀起伏。宽阔的肩膀与细长而有力的四肢赋予它既强大又出乎意料的速度，每一次动作都异常流畅，尽管它的身躯如此沉重且有力。  

它的背部向前拱起，呈捕食者的蹲伏姿态，仿佛随时准备弹射或猛击。手足上长出巨大的蹼状爪子，指尖收成黑色、弯曲的爪锋，闪烁着潮湿的光泽。头部宽大且似蟾蜍，口中布满锋利且参差不齐的牙齿，一双发光的橙色眼睛燃烧着算计的觉悟。沿脊柱向下的细小棱脊与结节坚硬如骨，赋予它粗犷、历经战斗的质感。  

灰色史拉灰蟾的存在散发出不可预测的威胁感——既非彻底的怪物，也非文明的存在，而是一种原始且聪慧的混沌捕食者，徘徊在野蛮与狡诈之间。每一次呼吸似乎都携带着暴力来临前的寂静，仿佛现实本身都在努力遏制这只变形的异常生物。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration, a creature born of shifting chaos and raw vitality. Standing about six feet tall, the gray slaad possesses a powerfully built, amphibian frame—its muscles bunch and ripple beneath leathery, mottled gray skin that glistens with a faint slickness, like stone after rain. Its broad shoulders and long, sinewy limbs give it both strength and unexpected speed, each motion unnervingly fluid for something so dense and powerful.  

Its back arches forward in a predatory crouch, suggesting constant readiness to spring or strike. Large webbed claws extend from its hands and feet, the digits ending in black, curved talons that gleam with a wet edge. Its head is wide and toadlike, with a maw full of sharp, uneven teeth and a pair of glowing orange eyes that burn with calculating awareness. Small ridges and nodules run down its spine, hard as bone, giving it a rugged, battle-worn texture.  

The gray slaad’s presence radiates unpredictable menace—neither wholly monstrous nor civilized, but something primal and intelligent, a chaotic predator poised between savagery and cunning. Each breath seems to carry the hush before violence, as if reality itself strains to contain this shifting aberrant being.

monsters.name: 史拉亡蟾
monsters.description:
史拉亡蟾（Death Slaad）是来自混沌位面的蓝色蟾蜍族（Blue Slaadi）在遭遇强大的死灵能量后产生的变异体。它们的皮肤呈现暗紫色，布满腐烂的斑点，眼中散发出幽幽的死亡光辉。传说中，亡蟾是死神的随从，被召唤到凡间以传播死亡与腐败，它们在沼泽、墓地或被诅咒的洞穴中潜伏，等待猎物的到来。

作为大型异怪，史拉亡蟾拥有惊人的再生能力和对魔法的天然抵抗。它们的舌头能够伸出数尺，将猎物捕捉并注入致命的腐蚀性毒素。即使受到重创，亡蟾仍能凭借体内的死灵能量快速愈合，使得它们在战场上极具韧性。冒险者若不慎直视其凝视，往往会感受到死亡的压迫，陷入恐惧与衰竭之中。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 Magic Resistance
specialAbilities.description: 对所有法术检定拥有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 两栖 Amphibious
specialAbilities.description: 可以在水中和陆地上自由呼吸并移动。

specialAbilities.name: 锐利嗅觉 Keen Smell
specialAbilities.description: 在距离60尺内可以感知隐藏或潜行的生物，进行感知（嗅觉）检定时拥有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 死亡凝视 Death Gaze
specialAbilities.description: 每回合一次，史拉亡蟾可以用目光锁定30尺内的一个目标。目标必须进行一次DC 14的体质豁免，失败则受到2d8+4点死灵伤害并陷入恐惧状态，持续1分钟（可在结束其回合时进行一次DC 12的意志豁免以结束恐惧）。成功则仅受到一半伤害且不产生恐惧。

specialAbilities.name: 再生 Regeneration
specialAbilities.description: 在每个自己的回合结束时，史拉亡蟾恢复5点HP。如果受到的是神圣伤害，则本回合不触发再生。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 史拉亡蟾进行一次咬合攻击，然后可以进行两次爪击。

actions.name: 咬合 Bite
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+7 命中，距离5尺，单一目标。命中时造成1d8+4点穿刺伤害，并附加1d6点死灵伤害。

actions.name: 爪击 Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+7 命中，距离5尺，单一目标。命中时造成1d6+4点挥砍伤害。若目标在本回合已受到咬合伤害，则此爪击造成额外1d4点腐蚀伤害。

actions.name: 死亡冲击 Death Strike
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+7 命中，距离5尺，单一目标。此攻击视为一次额外的咬合攻击，若命中，则目标必须进行一次DC 14的体质豁免，失败则受到额外2d8点死灵伤害。此动作只能在史拉亡蟾的先攻回合使用一次。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混乱中立的异常生物，巨大的死亡斯莱德，身高近十尺，呈现出扭曲的两栖体格。它的身体肌肉发达却畸形，覆以厚实、疙瘩状的暗紫色皮肤，在微光下散发出病态的光泽。腐烂的斑块露出如肌腱般的肉体，隐隐散发腐败的淡淡气息。其比例令人不安——宽阔的肩膀向驼背收拢，强壮的四肢绷紧，随时准备跳跃或扑击。手脚以长而钩状的爪子收尾，爪面覆满污垢和干涸的血污。

它的头部庞大且似蟾蜍，颚部宽阔足以吞噬整个人。锯齿状的牙列在皮革般的唇间闪耀，肿胀的舌头不停抽动，覆有腐蚀性黏液。眼睛散发出冷峻的苍白光辉——空洞却警觉，环视四周，仿佛在猎捕看不见的猎物。头骨上冠以角状脊，淡淡的腐尸雾环绕其轮廓，像烟雾般摇曳。

它的呼吸沉重，胸腔中发出嘎吱声，每一次动作都散发出野性的紧张感——既混乱又掠食。其周身的光环压抑沉重，混合了死亡与沼泽腐败，警告所有与之目光相接者，这怪物的唯一目的就是散布腐朽与毁灭。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration, a towering death slaad that stands nearly ten feet tall and looms with a grotesque, amphibian bulk. Its body is muscular yet malformed, covered in thick, warty skin of dark violet that glistens with a sickly sheen under dim light. Rotting patches reveal sinewy flesh beneath, oozing faint fumes of decay. The creature’s proportions are unsettling—broad shoulders taper into a hunched back, powerful limbs flexed and ready to leap or pounce. Its hands and feet end in long, hooked claws crusted with grime and dried ichor.  

The slaad’s head is massive and toadlike, the jaws wide enough to engulf a man whole. Rows of jagged teeth gleam between leathery lips, and a swollen tongue twitches restlessly, slick with corrosive slime. Its eyes glow with a cold, pale luminance—empty yet alert, scanning the surroundings as if hunting unseen prey. Horn-like ridges crown its skull, and faint necrotic mist clings to its outline, wavering like smoke.  

Its breathing is heavy, rattling in its chest, and every movement exudes feral tension—both chaotic and predatory. The aura around it feels oppressive, a mixture of death and swamp-born corruption, warning any who meet its gaze that this monster exists only to spread decay and ruin.

monsters.appearance:
史拉蟾蝌蚪  

这是一只混沌中立的畸形生物，体型仅略大于家猫，鼻尖至细长、光滑尾巴末端的全长约一英尺。它的身体紧凑而结实，覆盖着一层薄薄的半透明黏液皮肤，在昏暗光线下呈现湿润的光泽。皮肤的色调在病态的绿斑与泥灰之间交错，隐约流动的脉冲色彩暗示其外星起源。  

它的头部宽大且圆润，中心是一张张开的、似蟾蜍般的口腔，口中布满不规则的针状牙齿，即使闭合仍可见突起。两只无眼睑的小眼睛散发出暗黄的微光，凝视时显得空洞而令人不安。颈部两侧各有一对柔软的褶皱，呼吸时轻轻颤动。  

四条细长的肢体从躯干伸出——前臂以带蹼、爪尖的手掌收尾，后腿则专为突发的抽搐式冲刺而构造。它常保持低姿，身体绷紧，充满不安的活力，仿佛随时准备跃起或疾奔离去。尽管体型微小，却散发出淡淡的混沌与错位感，宛如本不该出现在此世的异类。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic neutral aberration, a creature scarcely larger than a house cat, measuring about one foot from the tip of its snout to the end of its slick, tapering tail. Its body is compact and muscular beneath a thin layer of translucent, mucous-covered skin that shimmers wetly in dim light. The skin’s tone shifts between mottled shades of sickly green and muddy gray, veined with faintly pulsing colors that suggest alien origins.  

Its head is broad and bulbous, dominated by a gaping, toadlike mouth filled with uneven, needlelike teeth that protrude even when closed. Two small, lidless eyes glimmer with a dull yellow hue, giving it a vacant yet unsettling stare. A pair of soft frills runs along the sides of its neck, quivering as it breathes.  

Four thin limbs splay from its body—two front arms ending in webbed, claw-tipped hands and two hind legs built for sudden, twitching bursts of movement. It crouches low, body tensed with restless energy, twitching as though always half-ready to leap or scuttle away. Despite its small size, a faint sense of chaos and wrongness hangs about it, as if it were something that should never have been born into this world.

monsters.description:
作祟幽灵是是另一种不同的幽灵。它们是还未意识到自己如何死去精魄, 而化成让人困惑的隐形姿态。一个作祟幽灵用它破碎的心灵力量四处抛掷生物和物件来抒发自己的愤怒。

作祟幽灵的挑战等级为 2(450 XP)且获得以下特质:

隐形 Invisibility。作祟幽灵处于隐形状态。

作祟幽灵获得以下动作项代替幽灵的吸取生命:

斥力猛击 Forceful Slam。近战武器攻击:命中+4,触及 5 尺,单一生物。伤害:10(3d6)的力场伤害。

念力推挤 Telekinetc Thrust。作祟幽灵指定自身 30 尺范围内的一个生物或无关联物件, 目标是生物时必须为中型或更小体型, 物件则不能超过 150 磅。

如果目标是个生物, 则作祟幽灵进行一次魅力检定, 以对抗目标的力量检定。如果作祟幽灵胜出,则它将目标向着任意方向 (包括向上) 直线推出至多 30 尺。如果目标撞上了一处硬质表面或沉重的物件, 则目标每移动 10 尺受 1d6 点伤害。

如果目标是个为被着装或携带的物件, 则向任意方向丢出至多 30 尺。作祟幽灵可以将该物件用作一件远程武器, 攻击任何在其移动路径上的生物 (命中+4),命中时造成 5 (2d4)钝击伤害。

![bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_266_835_11_818_931_0.jpg](images/bo_d3vep83ef24c73d2ihb0_266_835_11_818_931_0.jpg)

specialAbilities.name: 虚体移动 Incorporeal Movement
specialAbilities.description: 幽魂可以穿过其他生物与物体移动，视同其为困难地形。如果它在某个物体内部结束其回合，它将受到5（1d10）点力场伤害。

specialAbilities.name: 阳光敏感 Sunlight Sensitivity
specialAbilities.description: 在阳光下时，幽魂的攻击检定具有劣势，并且其依赖视觉的感知（Perception）感知检定（Wisdom）也具有劣势。

actions.name: 生命汲取 Life Drain
actions.description: 近战法术攻击：命中+4，触及5尺，单一生物。命中：10（3d6）点黯蚀伤害。目标必须成功通过一次DC 10的体质豁免，否则其生命值上限减少一个等同于所受伤害的数值。此减少持续到该生物完成一次长休。若此效果将目标的生命值上限降至0，则目标死亡。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只混沌邪恶的中型亡灵，身高约五至六英尺，悬浮在地面上方数英寸，而非站立。其形体瘦削枯槁，骨骼在半透明的暗影薄雾中若隐若现。全身似乎失去重量，像被风卷起的烟雾般摇曳闪烁，形状不断变换，仿佛在挣扎着维系自身。它的“皮肤”并非实体肉体，而是一团不安的蒸汽，染上深靛与幽灰的色调，光线掠过时微微闪烁。

面容是一片令人不安的模糊——有时几乎像人类，有时又被拉伸成无声的尖叫。空洞的眼窝中闪烁着蓝白色的微光，宛如垂死的星辰，透露出敏锐而不安的智慧。口部在张合之间漂移，唇已被撕成雾状，牙齿只是模糊的阴影，永远无法完全凝固。

细长的手臂松散地悬在两侧，末端是锥形的爪状指头，由凝聚的雾气构成，时而旋转着力场能量，甚至会扭曲周围的空气。该生物的移动异常迅捷且不规则，在空中疾驰、盘旋，展现出敏捷的优雅。一层淡淡的寒冷敌意光环环绕其周，空气中充斥着恶意与无形的压迫感，仿佛有看不见的手随时准备将一切卷入其怒火之中。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a chaotic evil undead of medium size, roughly five to six feet tall, hovering inches above the ground instead of standing. Its form is thin and gaunt, bones faintly visible through translucent wisps of shadow. The body seems weightless, shifting and flickering like smoke caught in a draft, constantly changing shape as though struggling to hold itself together. The texture of its “skin” is not solid flesh but a restless vapor tinted with shades of dark indigo and ghostly gray, faintly glimmering where the light catches it.  

Its face is an unsettling blur—sometimes nearly human, sometimes stretched into silent screams. Hollow sockets gleam with traces of blue-white light like dying stars, revealing a keen and restless intelligence. The mouth drifts between open and closed, lips torn away into mist, the teeth vague shadows that never fully solidify.  

Slender arms float loosely at its side, ending in tapering, clawlike fingers made of condensed haze, swirling with force energy that occasionally distorts the air around them. The creature’s movement is unnervingly swift and erratic, darting and coiling midair with an agile grace. A faint aura of cold hostility surrounds it, the atmosphere heavy with malice and invisible pressure, as if unseen hands were ready to hurl anything caught in its fury.

monsters.name: 斯芬克斯
monsters.description:
斯芬克斯是古老沙漠与废墟中守护失落宝藏与禁忌知识的神秘生物，常被奉为死亡与审判的象征。它们以高超的智谋与冷酷的计谋闻名，乐于以谜语诱捕冒险者，使其在答错之际陷入致命的陷阱。中立邪恶的本性让它们既不主动追逐善良，也不轻易帮助恶徒，只在满足自身兴趣或守护神秘时才会介入。

外形上，斯芬克斯具有人类的面孔，狮子的强壮身体以及巨大的鹰翼，皮毛呈金黄或暗铜色，眼中闪烁着古老的智慧光辉。它们的声音如同低沉的雷鸣，能够在广袤的沙漠中回荡，令人不寒而栗。斯芬克斯常栖息于古墓入口或荒原的石台上，以其谜语与强大的魔法威慑任何试图闯入的入侵者。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法抗性 (Magic Resistance)
specialAbilities.description: 对所有法术检定具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 传奇抗性 (Legendary Resistance)
specialAbilities.description: 如果斯芬克斯失败一次豁免，则可以使用此能力使其成功，最多可使用 3 次/日。

specialAbilities.name: 天生施法 (Innate Spellcasting)
specialAbilities.description:
斯芬克斯的法术储备为 4 级法术位，使用以下法术：
- 每日可施放 1 次 隐形术 (1st)；
- 每日可施放 1 次 魅惑人类 (2nd) 与 火焰冲击 (2nd)；
- 可随意施放 1 次 侦测魔法 (0) 与 预言 (3)。
施法时使用智力为施法属性，DC 15，+7 命中。

actions.name: 爪击 (Claw)
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：+8 命中，射程 5 尺，一名目标。命中时造成 2d8+5 斩击伤害。

actions.name: 狮吼 (Roar)
actions.description: 充能 (5-6)。斯芬克斯发出震耳欲聋的狮吼，所有在 30 尺内的生物必须进行 DC 15 恐惧豁免，失败者在下一回合内陷入恐慌状态，无法进行主动攻击。

actions.name: 谜语挑战 (Riddle Challenge)
actions.description: 充能 (6)。斯芬克斯向一名可见的生物提出谜语。若目标在 1 分钟内未能正确回答，则受到 4d6 心灵伤害，并被定身 1 分钟。若回答正确，目标免疫此伤害并获得 1d6 经验值。

monsters.appearance:
这是一种中立邪恶的魔法类人形。它身高约六尺，从狮爪一直到类人头颅的顶部，拥有一副结实的肌肉体魄，覆以短而金色至暗铜色的光滑皮毛。肩膀宽阔且强壮，支撑着一对巨大的鹰翼，羽毛边缘带有抛光的青铜色光泽，闪耀着光线。类人的面孔庄严而令人不安——光滑、对称的特征被浓密的鬃毛环绕，鬃毛与狮身融为一体，锐利的琥珀色眼睛以令人不安的精准注视着观察者。

强壮而灵活的四肢以弯曲的爪子取代了手，能够抓握或撕裂，而猫科的后腿为爆发性运动而生，肌肉紧绷。其类人面孔的皮肤看似完美，却略带日晒的痕迹，暗示着严酷的沙漠风暴。姿态直立却随时准备弹射，翅膀半展，仿佛随时可以冲向天空或俯冲猎物。

它身上笼罩着一种威胁的气场——宏伟的美感与捕食的准备交织——既迷人又致命。在它的存在下，空气似乎变得沉重，仿佛在挑衅挑战者靠近，冒险面对那爪与翼的力量。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil magical humanoid. Standing about six feet tall from leonine paws to the crown of its human-like head, the creature possesses a body of sinewy muscle beneath a sleek coat of short golden to dark copper fur. Its shoulders are broad and powerfully built, supporting a pair of vast eagle-like wings, each feather edged with burnished bronze hues that catch the light. The humanoid face is regal yet unsettling—smooth, symmetrical features framed by a thick mane blending into the lion’s body, with piercing amber eyes that fix on observers with unnerving precision.  

Strong, flexible limbs end in curved talons instead of hands, capable of grasping or rending, while its feline hind legs are built for explosive movement, wrapped in taut muscle. The skin of its human visage appears flawless but faintly sun-weathered, hinting at harsh desert winds. Its posture is upright yet poised to spring, wings half-spread as though ready to launch into the air or descend upon prey.  

An aura of menace clings to it—a mixture of imposing beauty and predatory readiness—making it both captivating and dangerous. In its presence, the air seems heavier, as if daring challengers to approach and risk the power in those claws and wings.

monsters.name: 男面斯芬克斯
monsters.description:
男面斯芬克斯（Androsphinx）是古老的沙漠守护者，常栖息于废墟的金字塔与失落的神庙之间。它们的身体如狮子，头部却拥有人类的面孔，眉宇间刻着古老的符文，眼中闪烁着对知识与秩序的渴望。数千年来，男面斯芬克斯以谜语守护宝藏与通道，凡是敢于踏入其领地的冒险者，若不能解开其谜题，便会在炽热的爪击与炽焰中灰飞烟灭。

作为守序中立的存在，男面斯芬克斯对契约与誓言极为重视。它们会与旅行者交易信息或指引，前提是对方必须表现出足够的智慧与诚意。若对手企图欺骗或挑衅，斯芬克斯会动用其强大的法术与原始力量，确保正义与秩序不被破坏。它们的出现往往预示着一场考验——不仅是对身体的，更是对心智的。

specialAbilities.name: 莫测高深 Inscrutable
specialAbilities.description: 斯芬克斯免疫任何能够感知其情绪或读取其思想的效果，也免疫其所拒绝的任何预言系法术。用以判断斯芬克斯意图或真诚性的感知（Insight）洞悉检定（Wisdom）具有劣势。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法武器 Magic Weapons
specialAbilities.description: 斯芬克斯的武器攻击视为魔法。

specialAbilities.name: 施法 Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
斯芬克斯是一名12级施法者。其施法关键属性为感知（法术豁免DC 18，法术攻击命中+10）。它施放其法术时不需要材料成分。斯芬克斯准备了如下牧师法术：

戏法（随意）：sacred flame，spare the dying，thaumaturgy
1环（4个法术位）：command，detect evil and good，detect magic
2环（3个法术位）：lesser restoration，zone of truth
3环（3个法术位）：dispel magic，tongues
4环（3个法术位）：banishment，freedom of movement
5环（2个法术位）：flame strike，greater restoration
6环（1个法术位）：heroes' feast

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 斯芬克斯进行两次爪击攻击。

actions.name: 爪击 Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+12，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：17（2d10 + 6）点挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 咆哮 Roar
actions.description:
斯芬克斯发出一次魔法咆哮。在其完成一次长休之前，它每多咆哮一次，咆哮会更响亮且效果不同，如下所述。每个在斯芬克斯500尺内且能够听到咆哮的生物都必须进行一次豁免。

第一次咆哮。每个未能通过DC 18感知豁免的生物将陷入恐慌状态1分钟。恐慌的生物可以在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，成功则结束其自身所受的该效果。

第二次咆哮。每个未能通过DC 18感知豁免的生物将陷入耳聋状态并恐慌1分钟。恐慌的生物将陷入麻痹状态，并且可以在其每个回合结束时重复该豁免，成功则结束其自身所受的该效果。

第三次咆哮。每个生物进行一次DC 18体质豁免。豁免失败时，生物受到44（8d10）点雷鸣伤害并倒地。豁免成功时，生物受到一半伤害且不会倒地。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只守序中立的怪异体，身高近十尺，庞大的形体兼具狮子的力量与人类的威严。它的身体在短而黄褐色的皮毛下起伏着结实的肌肉，阳光照射时犹如抛光的青铜微微闪光。宽阔的胸膛和粗壮的前肢以能碾碎岩石的利爪收束，然而它的动作却出奇地优雅，每一步都沉稳而平衡。强壮的肩胛支撑着宽大的覆羽翼，翼羽呈深金色与褐黑相间，展开时在地面掠过一阵沙漠尘土的低语。

它的人类面孔俊朗且对称，鬃毛自然过渡到狮子的皮毛。面部的皮肤被岁月的阳光烘烤得光亮如金，眉间与两颊上隐约刻有如古代符文般的细微纹饰。锐利的蓝宝石色眼眸散发出警觉的智慧，似乎在审视周围的一切举动。嘴唇紧闭，表情平静而威严。

这生物的姿态高贵而坚定，散发出纪律化的力量与永恒的权威。即便静止不动，也能感受到一股沉甸甸的力量光环——审判与审视的气息，使得其周围的空气都为之颤抖。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful neutral monstrosity that stands nearly ten feet tall, its massive form blending the power of a lion with the regal bearing of a man. Its body ripples with sinewy muscle beneath a coat of short, tawny fur that glints faintly in the sun like polished bronze. A broad chest and thick forelimbs end in deadly claws that could crush stone, yet its movements are unnervingly graceful, each step deliberate and balanced. Powerful shoulders support wide, feathered wings of deep gold and umber, their span sweeping the ground with a whisper of desert dust.  

Its human face is striking and symmetrical, framed by a mane that merges seamlessly into its lion’s fur. The skin of its visage is burnished, as if touched by sunlight for centuries, and across its brow and cheeks run faint traces of carved sigils shaped like ancient runes. Eyes of piercing sapphire radiate alert intelligence, seeming to judge every motion around it. The mouth is firm, lips set in a calm yet commanding expression.  

The creature’s stance is noble and unyielding, exuding disciplined strength and timeless authority. Though motionless, it emanates a palpable weight of power—an aura of test and judgment that makes even the air tremble near its presence.

legendaryActions.description: 斯芬克斯每轮可以执行3次传奇动作，从下列选项中选择。一次只能执行一个传奇动作，且只能在另一生物回合结束时执行。斯芬克斯在其回合开始时恢复已消耗的传奇动作。

actions.name: 爪击攻击 Claw Attack
actions.description: 斯芬克斯进行一次爪击攻击。

actions.name: 传送 Teleport（消耗2次动作）
actions.description: 斯芬克斯将自身以及其穿戴或携带的任何装备以魔法传送至最多120尺内其可见的一处未被占据空间。

actions.name: 施放法术 Cast a Spell（消耗3次动作）
actions.description: 斯芬克斯从其准备法术列表中施放一个法术，正常消耗一个法术位。

damageImmunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

monsters.name: 女面斯芬克斯
monsters.description: 女面斯芬克斯（Gynosphinx）是沙漠深处古老神殿的守护者，她们以谜语与智慧审判来者的灵魂。她们拥有狮身、鹰翼与女性的面容，眼中闪烁着千年积蓄的魔法光辉。自古以来，她们被奉为王权的象征，常被王族雇佣为宫廷的顾问与审判官，亦会独自守卫埋藏着失落王朝宝藏的陵墓。\n\n女面斯芬克斯极为自律，遵循古老的律法与契约，任何违背誓言的生物都将受到她们冷酷而精准的审判。她们的声音如同沙漠的风暴，能够在瞬间压垮敌人的意志；而她们的谜语则是致命的陷阱，答错者往往在精神与肉体上双双崩溃。尽管外表威严，她们对待真正的求知者却会提供指引与帮助，只要对方能在她们的考验中展现足够的智慧与勇气。

specialAbilities.name: 莫测高深 Inscrutable
specialAbilities.description: 斯芬克斯免疫任何能够感知其情绪或读取其思想的效果，也免疫其所拒绝的任何预言系法术。用以判断斯芬克斯意图或真诚性的感知（Insight）洞悉检定（Wisdom）具有劣势。

specialAbilities.name: 魔法武器 Magic Weapons
specialAbilities.description: 斯芬克斯的武器攻击视为魔法。

specialAbilities.name: 施法 Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
斯芬克斯是一名9级施法者。其施法关键属性为智力（法术豁免DC 16，法术攻击命中+8）。它施放其法术时不需要材料成分。斯芬克斯准备了如下法师法术：

戏法（随意）：mage hand，minor illusion，prestidigitation
1环（4个法术位）：detect magic，identify，shield
2环（3个法术位）：darkness，locate object，suggestion
3环（3个法术位）：dispel magic，remove curse，tongues
4环（3个法术位）：banishment，greater invisibility
5环（1个法术位）：legend lore

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 斯芬克斯进行两次爪击攻击。

actions.name: 爪击 Claw
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+9，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：13（2d8 + 4）点挥砍伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一只守序中立的怪异生物。它身高近十尺，威严的体格将狮子的光滑强壮躯体与鹰的宽阔雄伟羽翼完美融合。短而金黄的皮毛下肌肉起伏，每一次动作都显露出肩部与臀部的轻而易举的力量。翅膀覆以层层光亮的长羽，羽色在光线下呈现青铜与深金的光辉，展开的翼展足以遮蔽一名成年男子。

面容是一位诱人的人类女性，浓密的暗发如瀑布般垂至狮子的肩部。雕刻般的颧骨、王者般的下颌线以及丰满的双唇赋予其美丽，而熔融的琥珀色锐利双眼则以不容置疑的专注审视一切。那凝视既带有审判，也蕴含指令。

前肢以巨大的弯曲爪收尾，爪面磨至暗淡光泽，足以撕裂岩石。后腿结实紧凑，专为在沙地上突发的高速冲刺而生。尾巴细长而柔软，随步伐摆动，展现出猫科动物的平衡与控制。

它保持着雕像般的姿态，翅翼半展开，目光抬起，仿佛在守护那不可见的法则。其存在既优雅又令人畏惧，宛如活生生的哨兵，散发出权威与不可阻挡的意志。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful neutral monstrosity. Standing nearly ten feet tall, the creature’s imposing frame combines the sleek, powerful body of a lion with the broad, majestic wings of an eagle. Its musculature ripples beneath a coat of short, golden fur, each movement revealing the effortless strength in its shoulders and haunches. The wings are layered with long, burnished feathers that catch the light in hues of bronze and deep gold, their span wide enough to eclipse a man.  

The face is that of an alluring human woman, framed by a cascade of thick, dark hair flowing down to the lion’s shoulders. Sculpted cheekbones, a regal jawline, and full lips lend beauty, while piercing eyes of molten amber regard all with unerring focus. The gaze conveys both judgment and command.  

Its forelimbs end in massive, curved claws polished to a dull sheen, capable of rending stone. The hind legs are sturdy and compact, built for sudden bursts of speed across the sands. The tail is long and sinuous, swaying with feline balance and control.  

The creature holds a poised, statuesque stance, wings partially unfurled, gaze lifted as though guarding unseen laws. Its presence is both elegant and intimidating, a living sentinel radiating authority and inexorable will.
