actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击：命中+4，触及5尺或射程20/60尺，单一生物。命中：4（1d4+2）穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名守序邪恶的类人邪教狂信者，体型为中型，身高约六尺，身形瘦削却结实。其躯体显露出热忱耐力的痕迹——皮肤因长期仪式性自我鞭笞而硬化并带有淡淡的伤痕，线条分明的肌肉透露出纪律与狂热的活力。面色苍白，几近蜡质，仿佛被长时间烛光的虔诚所耗尽。静脉在皮肤下若隐若现，为本已健康的外观增添一抹病态的底色。

其面容棱角分明且表情丰富——颧骨高耸，眼神炽烈而凹陷，却闪烁着令人不安的坚定。额头上挂着淡淡的汗珠光泽，映射出摇曳的火把光。瞳孔可能隐约发光，呈现不自然的热忱，介于灰色与金色之间。嘴唇薄而常常挂着狂热的笑容，露出被草药酊剂染色的牙齿。

他身着磨损的皮甲，上面刻有神秘符号，每个符号或以血红颜料绘制，或用仪式刀刻划。双手灵活，指细长而熟练，因不断的祈祷手势和匕首练习而得。站立笔直，姿态僵硬，散发出受控却不可否认的威胁感。周身环绕着阴郁的信仰与克制的力量光环，暗示其坚定的虔诚随时可能爆发成暴力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful evil humanoid cult fanatic of medium size, standing around six feet tall with a lean yet wiry frame. Their body bears the signs of zealous endurance—toughened skin, faintly scarred from ritualistic self-flagellation, and sinewy muscles that hint at both discipline and fanatic vigor. The fanatic’s complexion is pallid, almost waxen, as though drained by long candlelit devotion. Veins stand out faintly beneath the skin, giving a sickly undertone to their otherwise healthy appearance.  

Their face is sharp and expressive—cheekbones high, eyes intense and sunken but gleaming with unsettling conviction. A faint sheen of sweat clings to the forehead, reflecting flickering torchlight. The irises may glow subtly with unnatural zeal, hovering between gray and gold. Lips are thin and often curled into a fervent smile, exposing teeth stained by herbal tinctures.  

They wear worn leather armor marked with occult sigils, each symbol painted in crimson or carved with ritual knives. Hands are agile, fingers long and deft from constant prayer gestures and dagger practice. The fanatic stands upright, posture rigid, exuding a controlled but unmistakable menace. An aura of grim faith and restrained power surrounds them, suggesting their unwavering devotion could turn violent in an instant.

monsters.name: 德鲁伊
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 14
monsters.languages_text: 德鲁伊语,外加任意两门语言

specialAbilities.name: 施法 Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
该德鲁伊是一名4环施法者。其施法关键属性为感知（法术豁免DC 12，法术攻击命中+4）。它准备了以下德鲁伊法术：

- 戏法（随意）：druidcraft，produce flame，shillelagh
- 1环（4个法术位）：entangle，longstrider，speak with animals，thunderwave
- 2环（3个法术位）：animal messenger，barkskin

actions.name: 木杖 Quarterstaff
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+2（施放shillelagh时命中+4），触及5尺，单一目标。命中：3（1d6）钝击伤害；若双手持用则为4（1d8）钝击伤害；或在shillelagh作用下为6（1d8+2）钝击伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一位中立的类人，种族不限，契合自然平衡。身高约六英尺（约1.8米），体格修长却结实，显示出既有沉思亦有在野外地形中不断奔走的生活痕迹。其皮肤被风日侵蚀，带有淡淡的泥土污渍和因荆棘、野兽而留下的细小伤痕。肌肉在衣物下流畅起伏，暗示耐力与实用的力量，而非蛮力。

德鲁伊的发丝散乱，掺杂苔绿与土棕的色调，常以树枝、羽毛或细小骨骼编织，随动作轻轻摇摆。双眼闪烁着平静的智慧光芒——敏锐、警觉，洞悉四周。眼角有淡淡的细纹，乃无数季节在户外度过的印记。

其衣着为层叠的天然纤维长袍，染以柔和的绿、灰、棕色，轻易与森林环境融为一体。颈部或腰间悬挂的护符由藤蔓、雕刻木制符文以及动物牙齿制成，暗示其与野性的交流。双手老茧厚实，指尖因耕作土壤与施展原始魔法而显得粗糙。

站姿稳健而放松，却随时准备行动，散发出宁静自信的气场，同时带有一丝隐隐的危险——宛如林中暴风雨前的寂静。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid of any race, attuned to the balance of nature. Standing about six feet tall, the druid’s body is lean yet well-toned, showing a life spent both in thought and constant movement through wild terrain. Their skin is weathered by wind and sun—bearing faint marks of soil stains and small scars earned from brambles and beasts. Muscles shift smoothly beneath their garb, suggesting endurance and practical strength rather than brute power.  

The druid’s hair is untamed, touched with shades of moss green and earthen brown, braided with twigs, feathers, or tiny bones that sway with each motion. Their eyes gleam with calm intelligence—keen, alert, and observing everything around them. Faint lines trace the corners of those eyes, the mark of countless seasons spent outdoors.  

They wear robes of layered natural fibers, dyed in muted greens, grays, and browns, blending easily with forest surroundings. Around the neck or waist, charms made of vines, carved wooden runes, and animal teeth hint at their communion with the wild. Their hands are calloused and strong, fingertips rough from tending soil and casting primal magic.  

Their stance is steady and relaxed yet ready, exuding quiet confidence and an aura that feels both peaceful and faintly dangerous—like the stillness before a storm in the woods.

monsters.name: 角斗士
languages: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 11
monsters.languages_text: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)

specialAbilities.name: 勇敢 Brave
specialAbilities.description: 角斗士对抗陷入恐慌状态的豁免检定具有优势。

specialAbilities.name: 蛮力 Brute
specialAbilities.description: 当角斗士用一把近战武器命中时，该武器的伤害额外增加一颗该武器的伤害骰（已包含在攻击中）。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 角斗士进行三次近战攻击或两次远程攻击。

actions.name: 长矛 Spear
actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺或射程20/60尺，单一目标。命中：11（2d6+4）穿刺伤害；若以双手进行近战攻击，则为13（2d8+4）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 盾击 Shield Bash
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+7，触及5尺，单一生物。命中：9（2d4+4）钝击伤害。若目标为中型或更小体型生物，则其必须通过DC 15力量豁免，否则将被击倒（prone）。

reactions.name: 招架 Parry
reactions.description: 角斗士针对一次将命中它的近战攻击，将其AC提高3。为此，角斗士必须能看见攻击者且正挥持一把近战武器。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中等身材的中立人形战士，身高略超过六尺。其身体线条如同精雕细琢的运动员，每块肌肉皆在无休止的战斗中锤炼而成。浓密的肌腱在被阳光晒成古铜色的皮肤下起伏，旧伤疤点缀其上，昭示着生存与纪律的痕迹。角斗士的姿态挺拔警觉，体重均匀分配，仿佛随时准备冲刺或防御。

其眼眸闪烁着锐利的钢灰色光辉，冷静而算计，透露出练就的专注而非狂怒。坚毅的下颚与棱角分明的容貌赋予其威严的气场，短而整齐的发丝沾满汗水与尘土，冠于一张被冲突硬化的面孔之上。胸口与肩部横跨的磨损皮革束带支撑着光亮却已受损的板甲——每一道凹痕与划痕都讲述着曾在欢呼观众面前浴血的战役。

老茧遍布的双手紧握精制的三叉戟与盾牌，指尖动作迅捷而稳健。闪耀的青铜胫甲与护臂保护着灵活的四肢，在火把的光辉下折射出微弱而令人畏惧的光泽。尽管体格魁梧，角斗士的移动却充满了衡量后的优雅，每一个动作都精准而刻意。一层淡淡的紧张气息环绕其身——危险被克制，力量待发，一位随时准备在无尽生存竞技场中再度奋战的冠军。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral human-like warrior of medium stature, standing just over six feet tall. Its body is carved with athletic precision, every muscle honed through relentless combat. Dense cords of muscle ripple beneath sun-browned skin marked by old scars, proof of survival and discipline. The gladiator’s posture is upright and alert, weight balanced evenly as though always ready to lunge or defend.  

Its eyes gleam a sharp steel gray, calm yet calculating, revealing practiced focus rather than fury. A strong jaw and angular features give it a commanding presence, while short-cropped hair, damp with sweat and dust, crowns a face hardened by conflict. Across its chest and shoulders stretch worn leather straps supporting polished but battered plate pieces—each nick and dent telling of battles fought before cheering crowds.  

Calloused hands grip a finely crafted trident and shield, fingers quick and sure in their movements. Greaves and bracers of gleaming bronze protect agile limbs, reflecting torchlight with a subtle, intimidating glint. Despite its imposing physique, the gladiator moves with measured grace, every motion precise and deliberate. A faint aura of tension surrounds it—danger held in restraint, strength waiting for release, a champion prepared to fight again in the endless arena of survival.

monsters.name: 警卫
languages: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 12
monsters.languages_text: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)

actions.name: 长矛 Spear
actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺或射程20/60尺，单一目标。命中：4（1d6+1）穿刺伤害；若以双手进行近战攻击，则为5（1d8+1）穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中立的人形战士，身高约六尺，拥有适合长途巡逻和厚重盔甲的结实体格。他的身形坚实而肌肉发达，宽阔的肩膀撑满了一件合身的链甲衫，虽有使用痕迹，却被细致地保养着。风化的皮肤和老茧的双手暗示着多年刀盾训练的历练。他的动作精准而从容，姿态如同随时准备在瞬间做出反应的战士。

方正的下颚和坚定的目光赋予他一种纪律严明、毫不妥协的外观。双眼锐利且警觉，持续扫描四周；其中闪烁着宁静的智慧与久经沙场的警觉。短而实用的发型与修剪整齐的胡须勾勒出一张被阳光与风霜刻画的面孔，表情平凡却可靠。

他携带一柄长矛和一面刻有简约徽记的小圆盾，更多是实用而非仪式性的装饰。金属的暗淡光泽在盔甲和头盔上捕捉光线，显露出过去交锋留下的划痕。整体印象是一名专业的警卫——坚定、警惕且脚踏实地——既不英雄化也不邪恶化，却体现出忠于守望的稳固能力。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid warrior standing about six feet tall, with the sturdy frame of one accustomed to long patrols and heavy armor. His physique is solid and muscular, broad shoulders filling out a fitted chain shirt that shows signs of use but is kept meticulously maintained. Weathered skin and calloused hands hint at years of training with blade and shield. His movements are precise and deliberate, the stance of someone ready to react at a moment’s notice.  

A square jaw and steady gaze give him a disciplined, no-nonsense appearance. His eyes are sharp and alert, constantly scanning his surroundings; they gleam with quiet intelligence and seasoned awareness. Short, practical hair and a close-trimmed beard frame a face marked by sun and wind, ordinary but dependable in expression.  

He carries a spear and a small round shield embossed with a modest emblem, more functional than ceremonial. The dull gleam of metal catches the light on his armor and helmet, revealing scratches from past encounters. The overall impression is of a professional guard—resolute, vigilant, and grounded—neither heroic nor sinister, but embodying the steadfast competence of one devoted to keeping watch.

monsters.name: 骑士
languages: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 10
monsters.languages_text: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)

specialAbilities.name: 勇敢 Brave
specialAbilities.description: 骑士对抗陷入恐慌状态的豁免检定具有优势。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 骑士进行两次近战攻击。

actions.name: 巨剑 Greatsword
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：10（2d6+3）挥砍伤害。

actions.name: 重弩 Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：命中+2，射程100/400尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d10）穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 领导 Leadership
actions.description: 持续1分钟，骑士可以在其30尺内它能看见的一名非敌对生物进行一次攻击检定或豁免检定时，说出一段特殊命令或警告。只要该生物能听见并理解骑士，就可以在其掷骰结果上加上1d4。同一时间，一名生物只能从一个“领导骰”中获益。若骑士陷入失能（incapacitated），该效果结束。

reactions.name: 招架 Parry
reactions.description: 骑士针对一次将命中它的近战攻击，将其AC提高2。为此，骑士必须能看见攻击者且正挥持一把近战武器。

monsters.appearance:
这是一位守序善良的类人骑士，身高约六尺，头至脚全身披覆闪耀的板甲，银光在光线下微微流转。甲面带有淡淡的划痕和狮子、日轮纹的仪式性雕纹，既显示出实用的磨损，也彰显其高贵血统。沉重的护甲之下，他的体格宽阔且肌肉发达，乃多年剑术训练与持盾耐力的结晶。他的动作严谨而精准——每一次移动都经过深思熟虑，既不迟缓也不炫耀。

面罩敞开的头盔下，露出一张历经风霜却仍坚毅的面孔：古铜色的皮肤、方正的下巴、被尘土与汗水染暗的短发。左颊上有一道淡淡的伤疤，昭示着浴血奋战的往事。双眼呈锐利的灰色，警觉而善于计算，目光随时捕捉到的任何动静，仿佛在衡量威胁与机遇。

粗糙的手握着一把抛光至镜面光泽的长剑，剑柄因频繁使用而被磨得光滑圆润。他的站姿稳固，却随时准备应变，散发出宁静的自信。一条深红色的斗篷垂挂在肩头，布料沉重，随着每一步轻轻摆动。整体气场严肃而强大——一名荣誉之士兵，其存在散发出受控的力量与不动摇的警戒。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a lawful good humanoid knight standing roughly six feet tall, clad head to toe in gleaming plate armor that reflects light with a silvery sheen. The armor bears faint scratches and ceremonial engravings of lions and sunbursts, marking both practical wear and noble heritage. Beneath the heavy plating, his physique is broad-shouldered and muscular, built from years of sword drills and shield-bearing endurance. He moves with disciplined precision—every motion deliberate, neither sluggish nor boastful.  

His face, visible through an open-faced helm, shows weathered but enduring strength: tanned skin, a square jaw, and short hair darkened by dust and sweat. A faint scar traces his left cheek, testament to hard-fought battles. His eyes are keen grey, alert and calculating, flicking toward movement as if measuring threat and opportunity alike.  

Calloused hands grip a longsword polished to a mirror finish, its hilt worn smooth by constant use. His stance is firm, yet poised to react, exuding quiet confidence. A deep crimson cloak drapes from his shoulders, the cloth heavy, stirring slightly with each step. The overall aura is disciplined and formidable—a soldier of honor whose presence radiates controlled power and unwavering vigilance.

monsters.name: 魔法师
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 11

specialAbilities.name: 施法 Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
法师是一名9环施法者。其施法关键属性为智力（法术豁免DC 14，法术攻击命中+6）。法师已准备以下法师法术：

- 戏法（随意施放）：fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
- 1环（4个法术位）：detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield
- 2环（3个法术位）：misty step, suggestion
- 3环（3个法术位）：counterspell, fireball, fly
- 4环（3个法术位）：greater invisibility, ice storm
- 5环（1个法术位）：cone of cold

actions.name: 匕首 Dagger
actions.description: 近战或远程武器攻击：命中+5，触及5尺或射程20/60尺，单一目标。命中：4（1d4+2）穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一位中立的人形施法者，身高约六尺，体格更像受过良好训练的学者，而非战士。其身形修长却结实，暗示出敏捷与耐力，而非蛮力。无论是人类、精灵或其他种族的皮肤，都带有长时间研读所致的淡淡苍白，表层之下隐约可见银色血管微微闪光，仿佛映射出奥术能量的余痕。

施法者的双眼闪烁着锐利的智慧光芒，始终在四周搜寻细节。表情专注且略带警惕，薄薄的唇线紧绷，透露出静默的专注。发色随血统而异，但常因长时间的实验而显得凌乱——发束似被看不见的风轻拂。

他们身着层叠的长袍，袍面刻有魔法符文，布料微微起伏，仿佛有生命般呼吸。前臂上留有淡淡的灼伤痕迹，乃施法时留下的痕迹，指间佩戴的几枚刻有符文的戒指在光线下闪烁。施法者的动作极为精准——每一步都保持平衡，每一个动作都高效而不浪费。

虽然外表并不惊艳，却有一种无形的紧张感环绕其周身，宛如雷霆来临前的宁静，暗示着这位看似平凡的身躯中蕴藏着巨大的魔法力量。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid spellcaster, standing about six feet tall with the proportions of a well-trained scholar rather than a soldier. The mage’s frame is lean yet toned, hinting at agility and endurance rather than brute strength. Their skin, whether human, elf, or another race, bears the faint pallor of one who spends long hours in study, and faint veins of silver shimmer just beneath the surface, echoing traces of arcane energy.  

The mage’s eyes gleam with sharp intelligence, constantly shifting to observe details around them. Their expression is focused, almost wary, with thin lips set in quiet concentration. Hair color varies by heritage but is often unkempt by long hours of experimentation—strands stirred as if touched by unseen wind.  

They wear layered robes imbued with magical sigils, the fabric subtly rippling as though alive. Along their forearms are faint burn marks from spellwork, and a few rings engraved with runes glint on their fingers. The mage moves with deliberate precision—each step balanced, each motion efficient.  

Though their outward appearance is not striking, an intangible tension lingers around them, like the calm before a thunderclap, hinting at the immense magical power they command despite their unassuming form.

monsters.name: 贵族
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 10

actions.name: 细剑 Rapier
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+3，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d8+1）穿刺伤害。

reactions.name: 招架 Parry
reactions.description: 贵族针对一次将命中它的近战攻击，将其AC提高2。为此，贵族必须能看见攻击者且正挥持一把近战武器。

monsters.appearance:
这是一位中立型类人，种族不限，身高约在五尺六寸至六尺之间。贵族拥有精致且均衡的体格，紧致的肌肉在合身的精细服装下若隐若现。其姿态自信，背脊挺直、肩膀放松，既显纪律亦透优雅。皮肤因血统而异——人类肤色苍白光滑，精灵肤色洁白如光，矮人皮肤经风霜洗礼却坚实有质感——但无一例外都被细心呵护。双眸明亮警觉，常带着智慧的光辉和对周围环境的熟练洞察。

发式整齐，梳理至光泽盈盈——或是利落的波浪，或是盘绕的辫子，并点缀细致的珠饰。面容对称且富有表情，唇形端正，言语中透出受过教育的思考。双手稳健洁净，佩戴象征血脉的戒指或纹印；指尖动作刻意而精准。其衣装采用华贵面料——天鹅绒、丝绸、细毛——色调柔和，以深蓝、深红或金色为主，并饰以纹章刺绣。

整体给人的印象是平静的指挥感，而非威胁。虽不显露凶悍，贵族却散发出宁静的威严与一种优雅，使人不由自主地注意到他——这是一种与生俱来的、配得上受人认可与尊敬的气场。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid of any race, standing about five and a half to six feet tall. The noble possesses a refined and well-balanced physique, showing toned muscles beneath fine clothing tailored to fit perfectly. Their posture is confident, back straight and shoulders relaxed, suggesting both discipline and grace. Skin varies by ancestry—human pale and smooth, elf fair and luminous, dwarf weathered with a sturdy texture—but is always meticulously cared for. Eyes are bright and alert, often glinting with intelligence and a practiced awareness of their surroundings.  

Hair is groomed, brushed to a lustrous sheen—perhaps styled in neat waves or coiled braids decorated with subtle jewelry. The face is symmetrical and expressive, lips shaped with thought and speech born of education. Hands are steady and clean, ornamented with rings or signets denoting heritage; the fingers move with deliberate precision. Their garments are crafted from rich fabrics—velvet, silks, fine wool—colored in subdued tones of deep blue, crimson, or gold, embossed with heraldic embroidery.  

The overall impression exudes calm command rather than menace. Though not overtly threatening, the noble radiates a quiet authority and a certain elegance that makes others take notice, an aura befitting one accustomed to recognition and respect.

monsters.name: 祭司

actions.name: 硬头锤 Mace
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+2，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：3（1d6）点钝击伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中立邪恶的类人生精灵，身高约六尺，体格纤细却比例匀称。其身形兼具耐力与柔韧，瘦削而线条分明的肌肉隐约可见于苍白、几近银色的皮肤之下。前臂上淡淡的血管纹路暗示他更倾向于仪式的自律，而非蛮力的搏斗。面容棱角分明，颧骨锐利，下颚线条狭窄；他的表情带着算计的平静，而非同情。

他的眼睛呈冷灰绿，犹如风暴中翻腾的水面，始终以寂静的警觉扫视四周。细白的发丝整齐垂至肩下，部分编入细黑皮绳。双唇保持中性，既不友好亦不亲切，额头两侧有一对淡淡的仪式伤痕，宛若新月形的印记。

他身着暗色仪式长袍，内衬暗淡的金属刺绣，暗示着被遗忘的符文，衣料随他刻意而有节奏的动作轻轻摆动。双手修长而慎重，握着一根细木法杖，杖头镶嵌着一枚失色的银色纹章。其周围的空气显得沉闷而警惕，仿佛在平静的虔诚之下潜藏着隐蔽的恶意——他是秘密的祭司，而非救赎的使者。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil humanoid elf, standing about six feet tall with a wiry but well-proportioned frame. His physique shows a balance of endurance and flexibility, muscles lean and defined beneath pale, almost silver-tinted skin. Veins trace faintly across his forearms, suggesting a life of ritual discipline rather than brute combat. His face is angular, the cheekbones sharp and the jawline narrow; his features hold a calculating calm rather than compassion.  

His eyes are a cold gray-green, reflective like storm-tossed water, always scanning with quiet alertness. Fine white hair falls neatly past his shoulders, braided in places with thin cords of dark leather. His lips rest in a neutral expression, neither welcoming nor kind, and a pair of faint ritual scars curve like crescent marks across his temples.  

He wears dark ceremonial robes lined with dull metal embroidery that hints at forgotten runes, the fabric moving lightly with his deliberate, measured motion. His hands, long-fingered and careful, grip a slender wooden staff capped with a tarnished silver sigil. The air around him feels stagnant and watchful, as though quiet malice is veiled beneath calm devotion—a priest of secrets rather than salvation.

specialAbilities.name: 神圣威能 Divine Eminence
specialAbilities.description: 以一个附赠动作，牧师可以消耗一个法术位，使其近战武器攻击在命中目标时额外造成10（3d6）点光耀伤害。此增益持续至该回合结束。若牧师消耗的是2环或更高环阶的法术位，则每高于1环1个环阶，额外伤害增加1d6。

specialAbilities.name: 施法 Spellcasting
specialAbilities.description:
牧师是一名5环施法者。其施法关键属性为感知（法术豁免DC 13，法术攻击命中+5）。牧师准备了以下牧师法术：

- 戏法（随意施放）：light，sacred flame，thaumaturgy
- 1环（4个法术位）：cure wounds，guiding bolt，sanctuary
- 2环（3个法术位）：lesser restoration，spiritual weapon
- 3环（2个法术位）：dispel magic，spirit guardians

monsters.name: 斥候
languages: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 15
monsters.languages_text: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)

specialAbilities.name: 敏锐听觉与视觉 Keen Hearing and Sight
specialAbilities.description: 斥候在依赖听觉或视觉的感知（察觉）检定上具有优势。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 斥候进行两次近战攻击或两次远程攻击。

actions.name: 短剑 Shortsword
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+4，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d6 + 2）点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 长弓 Longbow
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：命中+4，射程150/600尺，单一目标。命中：6（1d8 + 2）点穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中立的类人斥候。身高约六尺，体形修长匀称，筋肉紧绷却更显灵活而非蛮力。斥候的动作受控而轻盈，每一次移动都刻意而寂静，仿佛习惯在森林或废墟中潜行而不被察觉。他们的皮肤呈久经风霜的古铜色，略显粗糙，因无数小冲突而留下淡淡的伤痕。一件沾染了暗绿与棕色的旅行披风披在肩上，与自然环境融为一体。

面容警觉且线条分明，锐利的双眼闪烁着警觉与智慧的光芒。视线平滑地扫过四周，宛如猎手般精准。薄唇与笔直的鼻梁呈现出实用而不张扬的表情——既不美丽也不令人不快，只是被经验磨砺得坚硬。头发随意束起或短剪，沾满尘土，随风轻扬。

斥候的双手因拉弓弦与挥刀而长满老茧，稳固而随时待命。轻型皮甲紧贴身躯，便于快速移动；靴子采用软底设计，以消音步声。整体而言，他们散发出一种平静、熟练且暗藏威胁的气场，宛如一位熟悉荒野与战场的老练旅者。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid scout. Standing roughly six feet tall, the figure has a lean, balanced build with wiry muscle that suggests agility rather than brute strength. The scout’s movements are controlled and quiet, every motion deliberate, as if accustomed to traveling unseen through forests or ruins. Their skin bears the tone of someone long exposed to the elements—tanned, weathered, and faintly scarred from countless skirmishes. A travel-worn cloak of muted greens and browns drapes over their shoulders, blending with natural surroundings.  

Their face is alert and sharply defined, with keen eyes that glint with awareness and intelligence. The gaze shifts smoothly, scanning the environment with a hunter’s precision. Thin lips and a straight nose lend a practical, unassuming expression—neither beautiful nor unpleasant, simply hardened by experience. Their hair, tied loosely or cropped short, carries dust and wind-tossed strands.  

The scout’s hands are calloused from bowstring and blade, steady and ready. Light leather armor fitted close to the body allows for quick motion; boots are soft-soled to silence steps. Overall, the presence they project is calm, competent, and quietly threatening, like a seasoned traveler who knows both wilderness and war.

monsters.name: 密探
monsters.skills: 欺瞒+5,洞察+4,调查+5,察觉+6,游说+5,巧手+4, 隐匿+4
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 16

specialAbilities.name: 狡诈动作 Cunning Action
specialAbilities.description: 在其每个回合中，间谍可以用一个附赠动作执行疾走、脱离或躲藏动作。

specialAbilities.name: 偷袭（每回合1次） Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
specialAbilities.description: 当间谍以武器攻击命中一个目标，且其攻击检定具有优势时，或当目标在一名未陷入失能状态的间谍盟友5尺内、且间谍的攻击检定不具有劣势时，间谍额外造成7（2d6）点伤害。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 间谍进行两次近战攻击。

actions.name: 短剑 Shortsword
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+4，触及5尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d6 + 2）点穿刺伤害。

actions.name: 手弩 Hand Crossbow
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：命中+4，射程30/120尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d6 + 2）点穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中立的人形密探，体型为中等生物，约有六尺高。其身形瘦削而健硕，肌肉分布均衡，暗示着不断运动与静默耐力的生活。肤色为暗淡的古铜色，前臂和指关节上有细微的伤疤，乃严格训练和无数遭遇的痕迹。他们穿着暗色、轻便的衣物——哑光皮革与阴影织物相混合——紧贴身体以便无声行动。头部常被兜帽遮蔽，然而几绺暗发仍会逸出，拂过锐利的颧骨和光洁的下巴。

双眼微眯且警觉，闪烁着敏锐的智慧光芒，捕捉每一道光的闪动。表情沉着、算计却自信，散发出自制而非温情的气息。手套遮住了灵巧的指尖，这双指尖擅长撬锁与悄然抽出匕首，靴子则在石面或泥土上轻柔踏步。细腰带系着小型投掷匕首和袋子，排列得井然有序。密探的姿态放松却随时待命——体重平衡，肩略微转向，一只手靠近武器但并不显得威胁。其周围的空气宁静、克制且充满危险，仿佛有一个在被注意之前就已致命的存在。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid spy, a medium creature standing roughly six feet tall. Their physique is lean and athletic, with balanced musculature suggesting a life of constant motion and quiet endurance. The skin tone is a muted tan with subtle scars across the forearms and knuckles, marks of rigorous training and countless encounters. They wear dark, lightweight clothing – matte leather blended with shadowy fabric – fitted close to the body for silent movement. A hood often shrouds the head, though strands of dark hair escape, brushing against sharp cheekbones and a clean-shaven jaw.

The eyes are narrowed and alert, glimmering with keen intelligence and measuring every flicker of light. Their expression is composed, calculating yet confident, radiating self-control rather than warmth. Gloves hide deft fingers skilled in lockpicking and the silent draw of a dagger, and boots soften every step on stone or earth. A thin belt holds small throwing knives and pouches, arranged with meticulous order. The spy's stance is relaxed yet ready—balanced weight, shoulders slightly turned, one hand near a weapon but not overtly threatening. The air around them feels quiet, measured, and dangerous, the presence of someone who kills before being noticed.

monsters.name: 暴徒
languages: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)
monsters.senses_text: 被动察觉 10
monsters.languages_text: 任意一门语言(通常是通用语)

specialAbilities.name: 群袭战术 Pack Tactics
specialAbilities.description: 如果目标生物5尺内至少有一名暴徒的盟友，且该盟友未陷入失能状态，则暴徒对该生物进行的攻击检定具有优势。

actions.name: 多重攻击 Multiattack
actions.description: 暴徒进行两次近战攻击。

actions.name: 硬头锤 Mace
actions.description: 近战武器攻击：命中+4，触及5尺，单一生物。命中：5（1d6 + 2）点钝击伤害。

actions.name: 重弩 Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: 远程武器攻击：命中+2，射程100/400尺，单一目标。命中：5（1d10）点穿刺伤害。

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中立邪恶的类人，身材中型的暴徒，约有六尺高。其体格结实且肌肉发达，肩部宽厚，手臂筋骨分明，显露出长期苦工与粗暴格斗的痕迹。站姿略微前倾，既带有捕食者的凶猛，也有防御者的警觉，随时准备在受到挑衅时出手。皮肤呈暗褐灰色，因风霜而斑驳，布满旧伤疤与尘土，质感如同磨损的皮革。

面容方正粗犷，胡渣尚存数日，紧绷的下颚下是一只多次折断的歪鼻。双眼锐利而警觉，灰白或暗棕色的瞳孔不时扫视四周，流露出不安的猜疑。浓密的眉毛与常挂的怒容加深了其威慑感。薄唇常带着习惯性的轻蔑，露出因缺乏护理而染污的缺牙。

他身披不匹配的碎片盔甲——在染污的束身上衣外覆补丁皮甲，铁护腕上布满划痕与凹坑。双手肥大且长满老茧，指尖常呈弯曲状，仿佛随时准备紧握武器。沾满泥土与污垢的靴子为其粗犷形象画上句点。其周身散发出紧绷且敌意十足的气场，透露出一名习惯于暴力与求生的城市掠食者，在昏暗的火把光下潜伏的凶狠气息。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral evil humanoid, a medium-sized thug standing roughly six feet tall. His physique is solid and muscular, with thick shoulders and sinewy arms showing the life of hard labor and rough fights. His posture leans forward slightly, both predatory and defensive, ready to strike if challenged. His skin bears a weathered, tan-gray tone, mottled with old scars and dirt, the texture rough as worn leather.  

His face is square and coarse, stubbled with days-old beard, jaw set tight beneath a crooked nose that has been broken more than once. His eyes are sharp and watchful, pale gray or dull brown, scanning every movement with restless suspicion. Thick brows and a permanent scowl deepen his intimidating appearance. His lips thin into an expression of habitual disdain, revealing chipped teeth stained from neglect.  

He wears mismatched scraps of armor—patched leather over a stained tunic, iron bracers scuffed and dented. His hands are large and calloused, fingers curled as if always ready to grip a weapon. Boots heavy with mud and grime complete his rugged figure. The aura around him is tense and hostile, the presence of one used to violence and survival, an urban predator lurking under dim torchlight.

monsters.appearance:
部族武者

这是一名中型类人，种族不限，其阵营不明，受部族生活而非道德律法所塑。身高约六尺，战士的躯体刻满了不懈求生的痕迹——在被阳光晒黑的皮肤下，肌肉如绳索般紧绷，肩膀因长期持矛与盾而宽阔。其动作流畅而警觉，每一个姿势都保持平衡，随时准备弹射。

晒黑的皮革与毛皮拼接盔甲紧贴其身，粗糙的兽皮因战斗而磨损、染污。宽大的双手握着一根木矛，矛尖镶嵌锋利的石头或金属；老茧的指尖透露出多年战斗的痕迹。战士的面容被风霜硬化——棱角分明的颧骨、笔直的鼻梁以及狭长的眼睛，警惕而聪慧地审视四周。编织的长发间串着珠子与小骨，象征被猎杀的野兽或受敬的祖先。

他的表情既不残忍也不慈善，而是警觉且务实，展现出一个由生存而非虚荣塑造的存在。前臂与胸膛上交错的伤疤，既是纪律的印记，也是反抗的标记。虽仅有人类体型，战士却携带着捕食者的隐隐紧张感，其存在感更多来源于随时待发的准备，而非单纯的威胁，暗示其生命紧系于狩猎的节律与部族的意志。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a medium humanoid of any race, its alignment indeterminate and shaped by tribal life rather than moral law. Standing about six feet tall, the warrior’s body bears the marks of relentless survival — muscles corded beneath sun‑darkened skin, shoulders broad from wielding spears and shields. Its movements are fluid and alert, every stance balanced and ready to spring.  

Tanned leather and fur patchwork armor cling to its frame, the rough hide scuffed and stained from battle. Broad hands grip a wooden spear with a sharpened stone or metal point; calloused fingers betray years of combat. The warrior’s face is hardened by the elements — angular cheekbones, a straight nose, and narrow eyes that scan surroundings with wary intelligence. Braided hair is threaded with beads and small bones, symbols of beasts slain or ancestors honored.  

Its expression is neither cruel nor kind, but watchful and pragmatic, revealing a creature shaped by survival rather than vanity. Scars cross its forearms and chest, marks of both discipline and defiance. Though merely human‑sized, the warrior carries the quiet tension of a predator, its presence weighted more by readiness than menace, suggesting a life bound to the rhythms of the hunt and the will of the tribe.

monsters.appearance:
这是一名中立的类人形老兵，历经数十年战火的洗礼而变得坚硬。身高约六尺，体格结实匀称，肌肉在风化的盔甲下依旧紧绷分明。皮肤被晒得黝黑且布满伤疤，诉说着在烈日与钢铁下进行的无数战役。每一次动作都显示出受控的精准——高效、从容且平衡，毫无浪费的力量。老兵的面容虽有皱纹，却神采敏锐；钢灰色的锐利双眼在宁静的警戒中扫视四周。短短的发丝掺杂着银灰，衬托出一副坚定而低调的下巴。

盔甲虽有凹痕与划痕，却被细心维护，紧贴宽阔的肩膀和厚实的胸膛。髋部悬挂着一把因频繁磨砺而磨损的长剑，剑柄因多年使用而光滑圆润。强壮的双手布满老茧，粗糙而有力，轻放在武器的握柄旁，随时待命却从不绷紧。

这位经验丰富的战士散发出克制的威慑气息——稳重、纪律严明且自信，而非傲慢。尘土和干涸血迹的淡淡痕迹附着在靴子和护手上，彰显出不屈的耐力。无论是人类、矮人还是精灵，这位老兵的姿态与目光都 unmistakably 标记出他是一名幸存者——一位未被击碎的士兵，以平静的准备迎接危险。
monsters.appearanceEn:
This is a neutral humanoid veteran, hardened by decades of battle. Standing about six feet tall, the figure bears a sturdy, well-proportioned frame, muscles toned and defined beneath weathered armor. The skin, tanned and scarred, speaks of many campaigns fought beneath sun and steel. Each movement shows controlled precision—efficient, deliberate, and balanced, with no wasted energy. The veteran’s face is lined but alert; sharp eyes of steely gray scan the surroundings with calm vigilance. Short-cropped hair, streaked with gray, frames a jaw set in quiet determination.  

The armor, dented and scratched but carefully maintained, fits snugly over broad shoulders and a thick chest. At the hip hangs a longsword worn from constant sharpening, the pommel smooth from years of use. Strong hands, calloused and rough, rest near the weapon’s grip, ready but never tense.  

This seasoned warrior carries an air of restrained menace—steady, disciplined, and confident rather than arrogant. Dust and faint traces of dried blood cling to boots and gauntlets, giving a sense of relentless endurance. Whether human, dwarf, or elf, this veteran’s posture and gaze mark them unmistakably as a survivor—an unbroken soldier who meets danger with calm readiness.

specialAbilities.name: Shapechanger
specialAbilities.description:
If the vampire isn't in sun light or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.
While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.
While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

specialAbilities.name: Legendary Resistance
specialAbilities.description: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

specialAbilities.name: Misty Escape
specialAbilities.description:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.
While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

specialAbilities.name: Regeneration
